UMkhize, ongowokudabuka e-Richards Bay, wathweswa iziqu zakhe Zesitifiketi Sikazwelonke Sokwakhiwa Kwengqalasizinda Kagesi (Somsebenzi Wezandla) ngowezi-2017. Ngaphezu kokufunda kwangaphakathi esikoleni, futhi kwakudingeka ukuthi aqedele ukuqeqeshwa kwasemsebenzini futhi aphumelele ukuhlolwa ngokwamakhono omsebenzi. Ngasekuqaleni kwezifundo zakhe, uMkhize waba nethuba eliyingqayizivele lokusebenzisa ikhono alifundelayo emsebenzini wangempela, ukuqinise kisa ukuthi uyawathemba amakhono ayisisekelo ayewathuthukisa. “Njengomfundi osenza unyaka wokuqala, bese ngivele ngisiza ngezinkinga zikagesi endaweni yangakithi.

Kuthweswe iziqu abahlengikazi bezilwane bokuqala baseNingizimu Afrika. UMnu. Mthimkhulu usanda kuthweswa iziqu ze-Bachelor of Veterinary Nursing eNyuvesi yasePitoli (UP), okuyisona kuphela isikhungo esiqeqesha lolu hlobo lokwelashwa kwezilwane ezweni lonke. Uveze injabulo yakhe uMthimkhulu ethi, "Angikakholwa namanje."

Kukhuthazwa imiphakathi ukuba isize ekunqandeni ukuzibulala kwabantu ukuze kusindiswe izimpilo eziningi. Ngokwezibalo zakamuva zeNhlangano Yezempilo Emhlabeni (i-WHO), kubonakale ukuthi bangaphezu kwezi-700 000 abantu abashona ngokuzibulala unyaka nonyaka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kukhona owodwa oshona ngokuzibulala kwabantu iyikhulu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukunikeza ukwesekwa nokunakekela abo ababhekana nezinkinga zengqondo ukuze kuncishiswe lezi zibalo.

U-Wayne Mansfield, omdala iminyaka engama-33 wasePaarl, owake wasebenza njengomdayisi kamalume wakhe eMakethe, uyisibonelo esikhulu sokuthi ukulima kungashintsha impilo. Ngokusekelwa nguHlelo Lokwesekwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi, uMansfield ukwazile ukuqala uhambo lwakhe olusha lwezokulima olumlethe empumelelweni. Indaba yakhe iqinisekisa ukuthi ngisho noma impilo ikujikijela ngolamula, ukutshala kuyindlela ephumelelayo yokuziphilisa nokunqoba izinselelo. Lolu hlelo luqhubeka nokunika intsha amandla okuzimela ngokusebenza emhlabathini.

Wake wasebenza esuphamakethe yendawo isikhashana, kodwa umse-benzi wokuba yisicishamlilo wamkhanga. “Ngabona izicishamlilo zidlubhe umfaniswano wazo, zihamba ngamaloli akhona abomvu namakhulukazi. Ngaleso sikhathi ngaqala ukuba nentshisekelo futhi ngafuna ukwazi kabanzi ngalo mse-benzi,” kusho u-Arendse. U-Arendse wayengomunye wababephothule izifundo zabo esikhungweni sikahulu-meni waseNtshonalanga Kapa sohlelo lokuthuthukisa intsha, i-Chrysalis Academy ngowe-zi-2016.

Sekuvuliwe ngokusemthethweni ukufakwa kwezicelo ze-NSFAS zonyaka we-2023. Kukhona umkhankaso omusha ohloso yawo wukuthuthukisa indlela nenqubo yokufaka izicelo ukuze ibe lula kakhulu kubafakizicelo. UNgqongqoshe uNzimande uthi kulo nyaka, i-NSFAS isiqale izinhlelo ezintsha ezizokwenza inqubo ihambe kahle futhi ibe lula kakhulu.

Ukuze kuvikelwe ukukhula nokuthuthuka kwabesifazane abasebancane, kubaluleke kakhulu ukuba banikwe imfundo efanele mayelana nezempilo kocansi. Nakuba kukhona ababona ukuthi ukuzilwa kocansi kuyindlela esedlulile, kuyisinqumo esivikela ikusasa labo ngokuvimbela ukukhulelwa kwesikhathi esincane. Kubalulekile ukuthi abazali nomphakathi babambe iqhaza ekusekeleni lezi zintombi ukuze kugwazwe konke okungaba ngumshweshwe ekufikeleleni emaphusheni abo nemfundweni.

Ngesikhathi u-Beverly eyothenga amaqanda esitolo, akazange azi ukuthi lokhu kuzoba ukuqala kohambo lwakhe lwebhizinisi eliphumelele. Ukufuya izinkukhu akukona nje ukunikeza ukudla, kodwa kuyisenzo esinekhono esidinga ukuzinikela nolwazi olunzulu kubalimi basekhaya. Le ndlela yokuziphilisa ivulela abaningi amathuba okukhulisa imindeni yabo ngokusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakala emakhaya.

USithibe manje usephila impilo ejulile nenenjabulo, ebonakala eqhakaza kakhulu ngebala lakhe elimhlophe. Naphezu kokuthi kwakukhona ukungaqondi ukuthi ungubani, ukhombise ukuthi ungumuntu njengabo bonke abantu ngokuzihlanganisa emikhakheni eminingi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ubuntu abubheki ukubukeka kodwa bubheka indlela omphatha ngayo omunye. Impilo yakhe namuhla iyisibonelo sokunqoba nokwamukeleka emphakathini.

Ukudla okutholakala esikoleni kubanikeza umdlandla wokufunda, bakwazi ukugxilisa umqondo kanye nokuzibandakanya eklasini.” Ukubhaliswa esikoleni kanye nokuya esikoleni kwabafundi kuthuthukile ngenxa yohlelo lokuhlinzekwa kwezingane ngokudla. Kamuva nje, iKhabhinethi igunyaze ukushicilelwa koMbiko Wokuhlola i-NSNP odidiyewe uMnyango Wezokuhlela, Ukuqapha kanye Nokuhlola (i-DPME). Lo mbiko ubonakalisa impumelelo kanye nezinyathelo ezithathiwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe lolu hlelo. UMqondisi Wezokuhlola ku-DPME, uJabu Mathe, uthe inhlosongqangi yokuhlola wukuhlola ukuthi ingabe i-NSNP iqaliswa ngendlela engaholela emphumeleni omuhle ozohlomulisa abafundi maqondana nezempilo kanye nezemfundo.

Kuyinkambiso entsha nezimangalisayo ukubona abahlengikazi bezilwane bokuqala baseNingizimu Afrika bethweswa iziqu eNyuvesi yasePitoli (UP). UMthimkhulu usanda kuthweswa iziqu ze-Bachelor of Veterinary Nursing kule nyuvesi, okuyisona kuphela isikhungo esiqeqeshela ukwelashwa kwezilwane eNingizimu Afrika. Ngenkathi egubha lolu phumelelo olungavamile, utshe wathi: “Angikakholwa namanje.”

Ngalesi sikhathi sasebusika, ubungozi bokusha buyanda kakhulu emakhaya. Kubalulekile ukuthi abazali nabanakekeli baqaphele kakhulu izinto ezishisayo ukuze kuvikelwe ukulimala. Qiniseka ukuthi izingane zihlala kude nomlilo nanoma yiziphi izinto ezingashisa. Ngokukhetha indlela ephephile yokufudumeza, singavikela imindeni yethu ekusheni okungashayiwe.

Njengengxenye yohlelo lwethu Lokwakha Kabusha kanye Nokuvuselelwa Komno tho, sizoqhubeka sisebenze ngokuzikhandla ukuze si nwebe utshalomali olubheke lele ingqalasizinda kanye ne nguquko kwezokuxhumana kwezimboni zethu. Uma ngabe ukuvakashela eThekwini bekungaba ne nto obekungayishiya emqo ndweni wami, bekungaba ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika banekhono lokuphu melela kwimisebenzi emini ngi ebalulekile futhi emikhu lu. Izifiso zethu kumele zili ngane nezinselele zethu. Ngenqubekela-phambili esi yenze Echwebeni laseThekwi ni, futhi ngamakhono avuse lelekile esinawo kwaTransnet , man je sesinamandla anele ukuthi siqhubekele phambili.

UMnyango Wemfundo EyiSisekelo (DBE) usethule ngokusemthethweni uhlelo lweWoza Matrics ukuze lusize abafundi baka-Matric ababhekane nezinselelo ngenxa ye-COVID-19. Lolu hlelo lwenzelwe ukunikeza abafundi ukusekelwa okwengeziwe kanye nezinsiza zokufunda ukuze baphumelele ezivivinyweni zabo zokugcina. Inhloso yalo ukugcwalisa izikhala zolwazi ezishiywe wukuvalwa kwezikolo ngenxa yesifo segciwane. Ngale ndlela, abafundi bayakwazi ukuthola ukusekelwa okufanele ukuze bafinyelele emaphusheni abo emfundo.

Njengoba idolobha ligxile emizamweni yokulwisana nosuku lokuntuleka kwamanzi, lithe lidinga ukulungiselela isimo lapho lizokwazi ukulawula uhlelo lwedolobha lokuthunyelwa kwamanzi ukuze kuze kufike ubusika. “Sizokuvala ukuthunyelwa kwamanzi kompompi uma amadamu ethu efika ezingeni elingu-13.5%. Uma izinga lamadamu lifika ku-13.5%, bazoqala ukuvala amapayipi athumela amanzi, ngaphandle kwezindawo zezamabhizinisi ezisemqoka kanye nezikhungo, ezifana nezibhedlela,” ngokulandisa kwedo-lobha esitatimendeni salo. Uma sekufika lesi sikhathi, izakhamuzi zizokwazi ukuthola amanzi ezizindeni eziphakela ngamanzi edolobheni lonkana.

Nakuba emaningi amanxusa amanzi azimisele asebenzayo ukusiza ukunqanda usuku lokuntuleka kwamanzi, idolobha licele izakhamuzi ukuba zidlale indima yazo ekongeni amanzi. “Sifuna bonke abasebenzisa amanzi bajoyine imizamo ye-Dolobha laseKapa,” ngokusho kwePhini likaSodolobha waseKapa u-Ian Neilson. Amasu okonga amanzi • Vala umpompi uma uxubha, ushefa noma ugcoba insipho ezandleni • Ngena eshaweni isikhashana futhi usebenzise amanzi amancane uma ugeza • Gwema ukusebenzisa amanzi athengwayo. Imoto • Washa imoto yakho ngebhakede nesiphontshi kuphela.

Uhulumeni uthathe igxathu elivelele nelifinyelela kude ekuvuseleleni umnotho osebenzayo. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokutshala izimali zikahulumeni ukuze abe ngumsunguli nomhlinzeki wemisebe nzi yokuthuthuka. Lolu hlelo luyingxenye yomzamo kaMongameli wokusingula imisebenzi eminingi ezweni.

Siyazi ukuthi ukutholakala kwama-PPE abasebenzi basemkhakheni wezempilo akusiyo kuphela inselele abasebenzi ababhekene nayo. Ezweni lonke imitholampilo nezi-bhedlela zibhekene nokushoda kwabasebenzi. Le nkinga siya-yilungisa. Ukweseka umsebenzi owe-nziwa ngabasebenzi bethu abahamba phambili kule mpi ezweni lonke, sithume oNgqongqoshe namaPhini oNgqongqoshe esifundeni ngasinye ezweni ukuze baye kobona izingqinamba zakulezi zifunda nokusebenzisana nezikhulu zezempilo zasezifundazweni.

UDkt Nhlakanipho Gumede, onguMphathi Womtho lampilo esibhedlela se-Harry Gwala Regional Hospital eMgu ngundlovu, unikela ulwazi olubalulekile mayelana nesithuthwane. Ugcizelela ukuthi isithuthwane akukona ukungasebenzi kwengqondo, isifo, noma isimo esidinga ukwelashwa ngokwemithi yesibhedlela. Lokhu kusiza kakhulu ekubutheliseni umphakathi ukuze kugwemeke ukungaqondi kahle nokwesaba ngokungadingeki ngalesi simo.

Kodwa manje, ukudlondlobala kwesibalo sabantu abanegci-wane esasitshelwe ngako yizazi zezempilo, sekuphezu kwethu. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abangaphezu kwekota lesigidi sebetheleleke ngegciwane le-co-rona, futhi siyazi ukuthi baningi abanye abatheleleke ngalo leli gciwane kodwa abangabonakali. Njengamanje njalo ngosuku sithola abantu abangaphezu kwezi-12,000 abanaleli gciwane.Kusukela ekuqaleni kwalo mbhedukazwe ngoNdasa, okungenani abantu abayizi-4,079 sebebulewe yigciwane leCOVID-19. Njengoba izingxenye ezithile zezwe lethu zihlaselwe isimo se-zulu esiletha amakhaza ashubisa umnkantsha eqhamuka ngasoLwandle lwe-Antilathikhi kulesi sikhathi sonyaka, kunezinye izingxenye ezimbalwa zezwe ezingeke zichaphazelwe yileli gciwane le-corona.

• Umfaki-sicelo kumele anike umuntu wesithathu imvume yokuba abheke imininingwane yakhe kanti uma benga vumelani ngalokhu, ngeke bavunyelwe ukuba baqhubeke nokufaka isicelo. • Ngenxa yesizathu sobhubhane lwegci wane lecorona, abafaki-zicelo ngeke kudingeke ukuba bathumele noma bafake incwadi yemvume. Ukunalokho, bazocelwa ukuba bamukele imigomo ne mibandela kwifomu lemvume ngezobu chwepheshe, okuhambisana nemigomo nemibandela yoxhasomali. • Abafundi kusafanele bathumele amaphepha aseka izicelo zabo (umazisi womfundi, incwadi engubufakazi bema lingeniso kamzali/ umnakekeli womfundi, umazisi kamzali/ umnakekeli womfundi, nefomu A labafaki-zicelo abakhubaze kile.

Ngaleso sizathu, sihlala njalo sikhohlwa ukuthi sibuya kuphi ekusebenzi seni izimiso eziyisisekelo soMthethosisekelo wethu futhi ezenanela imica bango nezimfundiso zika-Steve Biko. Ngowe-1977, umbuso ongenanhliziyo wabulala omunye wabaholi bezwe owayenekusasa ngokumncisha ukudla, amanzi kanye namakhambi okwelapha ayewadinga ngokuphuthuma ngenxa yokushaywa ngesihluku ngamaphoyisa obandlu lulo. Emva kweminyaka engamashumi amabili, kwisahlulelo senkantolo sangowe-1997, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo yathi ukuphelelisa ama lungelo ayisisekelo azo zonke izakhamuzi kanye nokusebenzela ukuzuza amalungelo abo ezenhlalo-mnotho kunguphawu lompha kathi wentando yeningi labantu ohlose ukubuyisa isithunzi esalahleka. Namuhla eNingizimu Afrika, siyaqhubeka nokusebenza ukuphelelisa amalungelo ayisisekelo awowonke umuntu waseNingizimu Afrika ukuze bezophila impilo esezingeni engenazo izifo, indlala kanye nokuswela.

Ukudla kwesintu kwesiZulu sekubeke isikhumbuzo esikhulu eKapa, lapho indawo yokudlela entsha ibonisa ubuciko bokupheka kwesiZulu. Umnikazi walolu hlelo uchaza ukuthi isinqumo sakhe sishone ekutheni izivakashi ezifika eKapa zingakwazi ukubona ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinjani ngokusebenzisa ukudla kwesintu. Lolu hlelo luhlose ukugqugquzela amasiko nobunjalo bezizwe ukuze kwaziwe kabanzi ngamagugu ethu. Lokhu sekudonsa abantu abaningi, okwenza ukuba kube nokuziqhenya okukhulu ngamasiko esiZulu kuleli dolobha.

Umthetho Obhekelele U dlame Lwasekhaya uzi vikela ngokugcwele izisulu zodlame lwasekhaya. Ukuhlukumeza kwe nzeka ngezindlela ezahlu kene futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abantu besifazane bazi izindlela ezahlukene zokuhlukumeza ukuze ba zivikele. Udlame lwasekhaya lwe nzeka uma umuntu ehle lwa yilokhu:Ukushaywa: Isibonelo, uma ushaywa noma wesatshiswa ngodlame. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngoko cansi: Uma isisulu sidlwe ngulwa noma siphoqwa ukuthi senze noma sibukele okuphathelene nocansi okwe hlisa isithunzi.

Lokhu kubandakanya ukhetho lohulumeni base khaya, ingqungquthela yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu ye-COP26 kanye noMbukiso Wezohwebo Wamazwe ase-Afrika. Esinye sezizathu esiba lulekile sokuyibamba ngonyaka ozayo ukuthi bazobe sebebaningi abantu asebegomele iCOVID-19 ngaleso sikhathi, okuzo kwenza kube lula uku hamba kanye nokubuthana.Nakuba iNgqungquthela yesine Yotshalomali isiba mbezeleke ngezinyanga ezi mbalwa, umkhankaso we thu wokutshalwa kwezi mali usaqhubeka. Ngisho namaphakathi kwesimo somnotho esiyinselelo esi dalwe wubhubhane lwe COVID-19 , esabhebhe thekiswa udlame nezidube ezenzeka ezingxenyeni ezithile zezifundazwe i-KwaZulu-Natali kanye ne-Gauteng ngoNtulikazi, izinkampani ziyaqhubeka nokwenza kahle ezibo phezelweni zazo futhi zibheke amanye amathuba okutshalwa kwezimali eNingizimu Afrika. Ngonyaka ophelile uwo dwa nje, cishe izigidigidi eziyi-R120 zezibophezelo zotshalomali zaya eku sungulweni noma ekuqhu tshweni kwemiklamo.

Umsebenzi wokucozula u-Eskom uyaqhubeka, futhi njengoba le nkampani yakwazi ukuhlangabezana nomnqamulajuqu kaZibandlela wezi-2021 wokusungulwa kweNkampani Kazwelonke Yokudluliswa Kukagesi. NgoZibandlela kulo nyaka siyathemba ukuthi sizophothula ukucozulwa kweziphehlimandla kanye nezigaba zokuthunyelwa kukagesi zakwa-Eskom. Umbiko wekota ugqamisa impumelelo ebalulekile eningi, kanjalo nezindawo lapho umsebenzi omkhulu uqhubeka khona. Emkhakheni wamanzi, umkhankaso iOperation Vulindlela ubulokhu uhlinzeka ngosizo lobuchwepheshe kuMnyango Wamanzi Nokuthuthwa Kwendle ukuqalisa uhlelo lokulungisa isimo sokukhishwa kwezimvume zokusebenzisa amanzi, ngenhloso yokucubungula izicelo ezingama-80% ezinsukwini ezingama-90.

Uthi intsha efisa ukulandela ezinyathelweni zikaMthimkhulu ngokubhalisela iziqu zebachelor's degree yokuqala e-UP kudingeka ukuba ibe neSitifiketi sikaMatikuletsheni (i-NSC), noma iziqu ezilingana nalezo, futhi ihlangabezane nezidingo zalo mkhakha. “Ukuze ifundele iziqu zeBachelor of Veterinary Nursing , kumele ibe noMphumela wamaPhuzu Okwamukelwa angekho ngaphansi kwama28 kanye ne-NSC eneSingisi Ulimi Lwasekhaya noma IsiNgisi Ulimi Lokwengezela Lokuqala, izibalo, kanye nephysical science noma ilife sciences,” esho engezela. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi ngomkhakha, intsha ingaxhumana nezikhungo zokwelashwa kwezilwane ezizimele noma ikhulume nodokotela bezilwane bakucompulsory community service (i-CCS) abayingxenye yoMnya ngo Wezolimo, Izinguquko Kwezomhlaba kanye Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya (i-DALRRD) ezweni lonke. "Uhlelo lwe-CCS luhlose ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi yokwelashwa kwezilwane okufinyelelekayo kuyo nengambi eqolo ezindaweni ezingahlinzekelwa ngokwanele nezingenazo izinsiza ezifanele eNingizimu Afrika.

Kuyabonakala ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika banomdlandla wokuthatha izinyathelo zezepolitiki, njengoba kuveza ucwaningo lwe-Pew Research Center. Lo mbono wokuzibandakanya kumele siwusebenzise manje ekulweni noCOVID-19, lapho intando yeningi yethu izoba yisikhali esinamandla sokunqoba leli vutha. Uma sisonke sithatha izinyathelo ezinhle ngokuhlanganyela, singaqinisekisa ukuphepha kwethu sonke nokuvikela imiphakathi yethu.

Izicelo zalolu hlelo zivulelekile kubantu abakhubazeke izingalo nemilenze kanye nabakhubaze ke isingezansi asebevele benayo ilayisensi yokufundela ukushayela. "Baye bahanjiswe kudokote la wokunyakaza kwamalungu omzimba, phecelezi ioccupa -tional therapist , ukuze iqinise kise ukuthi umzimba wabo uya kwazi ukunyakaza ngendlela engabenza bakwazi ukushaye la izimoto ezenzelwe abantu abakhubazekile ngaphandle kokubabeka engozini. Kube se kubhekwa ukuthi umuntu lowo angakwazi ukukhokha imali engakanani kulolu hlelo, bese konke okunye kukhokhelwe ngabaxhasi," kuchaza u-Seirlis. Ababambiqhaza bathola uchungechunge oluphelele lwe zifundo zokushayela, kuze kube sebekulungele ukuhlolwa.

Ukuphuza utshwala ngenkathi ukhulelwe kungalimaza kakhulu impilo yomntwana ongakazalwa. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni ingane ingakhule ngendlela efanele noma ibe nezinkinga zezempilo eziningi. Uma ubhekana nobunzima bokungakwazi ukuzithiba otshwaleni, sicela ungabi namahloni okufuna usizo. Vakashela imitho yempilo eseduze nawe ukuze uthole ukwesekwa okufanele ukuze ube nokukhulelwa okuphephile.

Imikhiqizo yezilwane – efana nenyama nemikhiqizo yobisi, izidlo zasolwandle kanye nemikhi qizo emisha njengemifino nezithelo kungaba naleli gciwane. Yize noma ngubani ongatheleleka yi-Listeriosis, labo abasengcupheni enkulu yokungenwa yilesi sifo babandakanya izinsana ezisanda kuzalwa, abantu asebeluphele, abesifazane abakhulelwe, kanye naba ntu abanamasosha omzi mba antekenteke njenga-bane-HIV , isifo sikashukela, umdlavuza, isifo sezinso noma esesibindi esingumahla lakhona. Abantu abathinteka kakhulu yilabo abayizinsana ezinezinsukwana zizelwe – izinsana ezinezinsuku ezi ngama-28 zizelwe, nabantu abaneminyaka ephakathi kweyi-15 nengama-49. Aba-ntu abanale minyaka yobudala bangama-70% abantu bonke abanalesi sifo.

I-Operation Vulindlela isiqalile ukuvula indlela eya ekukhuliseni umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ngokubhekana nezithiyo ezidala ukunqongkodana kwezindima zezomnotho. Ukushoda kwamakhono kanye nezindleko eziphezulu zezinsizakalo zenethiwekhi bekuyizinto ezikhulu ezithinte kakhulu intuthuko yemikhakha ehlukene. Ngokubhekisisa lezi zinkinga, lolu hlelo luhlose ukwakha isisekelo esiqinile esizovumela umnotho ukuba ukhule ngokushesha.

UMthimkhulu usanda kuthweswa iziqu zeBachelor of Veterinary Nursing eNyuvesi yasePitoli (UP), okuyisikhungo esisodwa kuphela eNingizimu Afrika esiqeqeshela abahlengikazi bezilwane. Ungomunye wabahlengikazi bezilwane bokuqala abathweswa iziqu kuleli lizwe, okuyinto ebaluleke kakhulu emkhakheni wezokwelapha izilwane. Uzizwa emangele kakhulu ngalolu phumelelo, ethi "angikakholwa namanje."

Ibhizinisi lakhe, eliseBo tshabelo eFreyistata, iVictory Body and Nail Studio , likhula ngamandla futhi liheha abantu abaqhamuka ezindaweni ezahlukene abazela ukuzo mfanyazwa umzimba kanye nokucwalwa. Waqala ukudayisa uTupperware eneminyaka eyi-19, lona oneminyaka engama-28 njengamanje uthe wayelokhu enothando lokuba nebhizini si lakhe futhi kuyamjabulisa ukuthi waziqalela ibhizinisi lakhe. “Ngaqala ngisebenzela othile kule mboni futhi yilapho engathola khona isipiliyoni,” kusho yena, wengeza na ngokuthi wafundela ukuba yi-cosmetologist e-Motheo TVET College yaseBloem fontein. Ekugcineni wayeseku lungele ukuphuma azimele futhi akazange esabheka emuva kusukela ngaleso sikhathi.

Imizamo yokusindisa izimpilo iqhubeka ngokuzimisela, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlushwa yizifo zegazi. Ngokuka-Palesa Mokome, oyinhloko yezokumaketha nezokuxhumana e-Sunflower Fund, kukhona izinkulungwane zeziguli ezihlonzwa zinezifo ezihlobene negazi minyaka yonke. Lokhu kukhombisa ukubaluleka kokuhlonza lezi zifo kusasele isikhathi ukuze kutholakale usizo olufanele. Lolu hlelo lugxile ekusebenzelaneni nabasebenzi bezempilo ukuze kusindiswe izimpilo eziningi.

I-CACH iyinsiza yezobuchwepheshe kahulumeni ephathwe nguMnyango Wezemfundo Ephakeme kanye Nokuqeqeshwa (DHET). Lolu hlelo luhlose ukuxhumanisa abafundi namathuba amaningi okufunda nokuphumelela. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, lusiza kakhulu labo abafuna izikhala zokungena enyuvesi ngokubakhombisa imininingwane ebalulekile mayelana nemfundo ephakeme.

Phezu kwalokho, igumbi kumele lilungiswe nsukuzonke ngenkathi isihambeli sakho sisahlala khona. Ama-B&B akanakuba namagumbi ezihambeli anga phezu kwamathathu. Uma amagumbi ezihambeli engaphezu kwalokhu, ibhinizisi lakho kumele lichazwe ngokuthi i-guest house . Ngeziphi izinqubo oku mele uzilandele ukuze uqale i-B&B yakho?Isinyathelo sokuqala okumele usithathe ukuqonda kumasi pala wakho wasendaweni uye kofaka isicelo sokuthi umuzi wakho uklamwe njengesa khiwo sokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala izihambeli.

Isikhulu Sokhetho Esiyinhloko sekhomishana uSy Mamabolo uthe zonke izikhungo zokuvota eziyizi-22 612 zizovula ngempe-lasonto yangomhla ziyi-10 kanye namhla ziyi-11 kuNdasa wezi-2018, kusukela ngele-8 ekuseni kuze kube ngele-5 ntambama, ukuze kwenziwe kube lula futhi kusize abavoti ukuthi bafake imininingwane yabo yakamuva yokubhalisa noma ukuthi ba bhalise. Uma uthuthele endaweni entsha kusukela mhla ugcina ukubha lisela ukuvota, kumele ubhalise esifundeni sakho sokuvota esisha. Izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ezineminyaka yobudala eyi-16 kanye nangaphezu-lu ezinomazisi noma ikhadi elisemthethweni zingabhalisela ukuvota. Uma ungabhalisanga, angeke uze uvunyelwe ukuthi uvote ngowezi-2019.

Abaqaphi beziqiwu basebenza kanzima ukuze bavikele obhejane ezingozini zokushaywa. UNyawo, oyingxenye yabasebenzi be-EPWP, ukholelwa ekutheni kubalulekile ukufundisa umphakathi ngokunakekela imvelo. Lolu hlelo luhlose ukuvusa ukuqwashisa ukuze abantu baqonde ukubaluleka kokugcina lezi zilwane zivikelekile. Ngale ndlela, imvelo nezilwane eziyigugu zingagcinwa zivikelekile zize fike nezizukulwane ezizayo.

Ukugula nokudlula emhla beni kwamadoda nabantu besifazane abenza lo msebe-nzi ohloniphekile noyigugu kangaka kusigqeme inkamba beyibuza. Yibo abahamba phambili ekulweni nalolu bhubhane. Basebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezinencindezi enkulu futhi bathwala umthwalo owukha-thaza kakhulu umqondo ngokwazi ukuthi nabo base-ngcupheni yokutheleleka ngaleli gciwane. Bangamaqhawe namaqhawekazi eqiniso kule mpi yethu yoku-lwa negciwane lecorona .

Indawo yokudlela eKapa isidonsa amehlo amaningi ngokusebenzisa ukudla kwesintu kwesiZulu ukuze izivakashi zithole ulwazi ngokuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinjani. Lolu hlelo luhlose ukukhombisa ubuciko namasiko okudla kwesiZulu kubantu abavakashela leli dolobha. Ngokwenza lokhu, le ndawo yokudlela ikwazile ukuziveza ebalazweni njengendawo ekhethekile nebalulekile.

Bavula izinkampani ezingasebenzi ukucashisa ukungena nokuphuma kwezimali okusolisayo, bahambise izimali ngokushesha phakathi kwama-akhawunti amaningi, bahambise imi niningwane yemalingena engeyona kwizipha thimandla zokuqoqwa kwentela, futhi uma kungabasebenzi baka hulumeni, basebenzisa abangani nezihlobo uku faka izicelo zemisebenzi yamathenda ukucashisa ukubandakanyeka kwabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukuphendula kwezipha thimandla vele ngeke kuzwakale. Ngowezi-2020, sasungula isikhungo esiqondisa izigwegwe ngokwehlu kahlukana iFusion Centre njengesikhungo esisebenza ukubhekana namacala ezezimali, kubandakanya nenko hlakalo. Lesi sikhungo sihlanganisa amakhono okuphenya amacala ophikweni lukahulumeni lokugwema ubugebengu kanye nezinhlaka zezoku vikeleka nalezo Zikhungo Zobunhloli Bezezimali, ezisungula ubunhloli bama-ejensi ezomthetho obuzosetshenziswa ophe nyweni lwabo.

Umphakathi waseDouble Drift waseGrahamstown ugubha ukubuyiselwa komhlaba wabo ngesivumelwano esibize izigidi zamarandi ezingama-21. Lolu hlelo luthinta abantu abayi-1 500 abaqha muka emindenini engama-264 eyayisuswe ngenkani emhlabeni wayo ngonyaka ka-1991. Ukususwa kwabo kwakwenziwe ukuze kwakhiwe isiqiyi endaweni yabo yaseCiskei.

Umthetho Obhekelele Udlame Lwasekhaya wenzelwe ukuvikela zonke izisulu zodlame ngokugcwele. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu, ikakhulukazi abesifazane, baqonde ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwenzeka ngezindlela eziningi ezehlukene. Ukwazi lezi zinhlobo kusiza abantu ukuba bakwazi ukuzivikela nokuthola usizo olufanele ngesikhathi.

Ukubhema ugwayi kulimaza amaphaphu futhi kwenza abantu babe sengozini enkulu yokuthola izifo zokuphefumula njenge-COVID-19. Ukuvalwa kokuthengiswa kukagwayi kuzosiza ekunciwiseni abantu ababhemayo, okuzothuthukisa impilo yomphakathi wonke. Uma abantu beyeka ukubhema, amaphaphu abo aba namandla okulwa nezigciwane ezibucayi. Ngakho-ke, le nyathelo liyabalulekile ekuvikeleni nasekoseni impilo yabantu abaningi.

Umsebenzi wakhe uyimpumelelo ngoba uqashe ngokugcwele abesifazane abayi-12. Ngokusho kuka-Dkt Zulu, ukufuya izinkukhu kungumkhakha obucayi kakhulu kuleli lizwe, nje ngoba imindeni eminingi idla inyama yenkukhu kakhulu ukwedlula olunye uhlobo lwenyama.U-Dkt Zulu unamathemba okuqeqesha abesifazane abangaphezu kwe-1 000 kwezolimo kulolonke izwe ngonyaka. Uzimisele futhi ngokuba ngomunye wabakhiqizi abathembekile baseNingizimu Afrika bezinkukhu ezingavalelwa kanye nezitshalo eziphilayo. Weluleke abesifazane abafisa ukuba ngabalimi ukuthi mabaqale kancane futhi bangalindi ukusizwa nguhulumeni.

Uthi umnyango ube sewubikela i-PSC ngokutholile. “Uma sithokozile ngezinyathelo ezithathwe umnyango, sizobe sesilivala icala, kodwa uma singagculisekile, sibuyela emuva kubona.” Ukungadalulwa ku qinisekisiwe 00000 Uma ngabe ingede inga funi ukuzidalula, isikhulu esisebenza kwinombolo ephuthumayo ye-PSC sizo thatha imininingwane yayo yokuxhumana kuphela. Lokhu kubalulekile uma kudingeka imininingwane eyengeziwe, i-PSC kumele ikwazi ukuxhumana nazo. Izingede ezibika amacala enombolweni ephuthumayo ye-PSC ziyaqinisekiswa ngokuvikeleka uma zingafuni ukuzidalula, kusho u-Seloane.

UVuyiseka Arendse ungumuntu osencane oyisicishamlilo oyingxenye yethimba le-Crew Juliet. Leli thimba liyisipesheli ngoba liyithimba lokuqala lezicishamlilo zasendle elakhiwe ngabesifazane kuphela. UVuyiseka unomdlandla nokuzimisela okukhulu kokuzakhela igama elihle kulo mkhakha. Indaba yakhe igqamisa amandla nobuholi babesifazane ekulweni nomlilo zasendle.

I-BRICS isebenza njengomongo obalulekile wokukhula kweNingizimu Afrika kwezomnotho nezepolitiki emhlabeni wonke. Ngemva kokuphela kwe-Cold War, kube nokuguquka okukhulu emifelandawonye yomhlaba, okwakudinga ukuba amazwe azilungise kabusha ukuze angashiywa ngemuva. Ngakho-ke, kube kubalulekile ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika "iphose udobo lwayo" ngokungena kulolu hlanganyelo ukuze ikwazi ukuzuza ezindabeni zamazwe ngamanye. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kusebenza njengesisekelo esiqinile sokuthuthukisa ubudlelwano namazwe aqhamukayo, okuqinisa isikhundla seNingizimu Afrika emhlabeni.

Phakathi kukaNtulikazi noMandulo kowezi-2021, abantu abayizi-9 556, iningi labo kwakungabesifazane, badlwengulwa. Lesi sibalo singaphezulu ngama-7% esikhathini sombiko owedlule. Emacaleni okuhlasela alinganiselwa kwizi-73 000 abikwe ngalesi sikhathi, angaphezu kwezi-13 000 bekungamacala ahlobene nodlame lwasekhaya. Izinga lokubulawa kwezingane lenyuke ngokulinganiselwa kokuthathu uma kuqhathaniswa nesikhathi sombiko owedlule.

Hhayi nje kuphela ukuthi ababhebhezeli bayaboshwa futhi bayiswe nasenkantolo; baphinde baphucwe yonke inzuzo abayenze ngobugebengu babo. Luselude uhambo, futhi ziningi izimali zikahulumeni ezetshiwe okusamele zibuyiswe. Kodwa i-SIU neNkantolo Ekhethekile baqale ngonyawo oluhle, futhi nginethemba lokuphumelela futhi ezinyangeni naseminyakeni ezayo.

Phakathi kowe-1994 noNdasa kowezi-2018 uhulu meni unikeze amahektha omhlaba ayizigidi eziyisi-8.4 kubantu abebencishwe amathuba ngaphansi kohlelo lokuguqulwa komhlaba. Kodwa le nqubekelapha mbili ilingana nokungaphansi kwe-10% komhlaba ophelele wokulima. Enkulumweni yami Yesimo Sezwe ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka ngazibophezela ukuthi umhlaba wokulima ongapha nsi kukahulumeni uzodede lwa maduze ukuze kulinywe. Lokhu kuyingqophamla ndo ohlelweni lokuguqulwa kwezolimo, futhi lugcina isithembiso esikuSomqulu Wenkululeko esithi umhlaba kuzokwabelwana ngawo kulabo abasebenza kuwona.Umbono wethu wokuphi nde kwabiwe umhlaba uhlose ukulinganisa phakathi kobulungiswa kwezenhlalo noku lungisa, nokukhulisa imi khiqizo yezolimo ngokuletha abalimi abansundu abaningi emnothweni omkhulu.Umhlaba uyifa eliletha inzuzo futhi ungasetshenzi swa njengesibambiso ukuzu za elinye ifa.Kumele siqinisekise ukuthi umhlaba odingekayo ukuze kulinywe usetshenziswa ngendlela enenzuzo.

INingizimu Afrika izibophezele ekuthuthukiseni imfundo yentsha yayo ukuze kube nekusasa elingcono. UNgqongqoshe uPandor uqinisekisile ukuthi kuyisibophezelo sezwe ukusiza imindeni empofu kanye naleyo esengcupheni kakhulu. Lokhu kuveziwe ngesikhathi sesithangami sabezindaba lapho kukhulunywa khona ngenqubo yokwethula imfundo efanele. Le nyathelo lihlose ukunikeza wonke umntwana ithuba elifanele lokufunda ukuze aqhubele phambili empilweni.

UMashego, ovela eSebokeng endaweni yase-Vaal eGauteng, ubike ukuthi usizo lwe-NSFAS lube yisihluthulelo sempumelelo yakhe. Uthi ubengeke akwazi ukuzikhokhela imali yokufunda kanye nezinye izindleko ezibandakanya imfundo ephakeme ukuba kwaba yilo mnikelo. Ngakho-ke, ubona ukuthi le nkqubo isiza kakhulu abafundi abaswele ukuba baqinisekise ikusasa labo ngokufinyelela emaphuphweni abo ezemfundo.

Ama-SOE anendima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wezwe ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezibalulekile. Kumele aqhubele phambili ukukhula komnotho ngokuletha izinguquko ezinhle ekulawulweni nasekuphathelweni kwazo. Lokhu kuzosiza ekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi nasekuqinisekiseni ukuthi imiphakathi ithola izinsiza ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Uma ama-SOE esebenza ngendlela efanele, azoba yinsika eqinile yokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu bonke.

U-Mmaletjema Poto, iSikhulu se-FPB’s Child Protection, uthe abazali kufanele babazi ubungozi abantwana babo ababhekana nabo kwi-inthanethi, kubalwa nokubuka imifanekiso yabantwana yocansi noma yokuhlukunyezwa kwabantwana ngokocansi, kanye nokuqeqeshwa izigilamkhuba zocansi. Abantwana bangahehwa izigilamkhuba zocansi kwiinthanethi ngokuthi bangene kwi-inthanethi bebheka into ethile emsulwa bese bechofoza ilinki okungafanele bayichofe. Abantwana babe sebezithemba lezi zigilamkhuba bese ziqala ukubafundisa ngocansi. "Umntwana ujwayele ukuba namahloni ngakho-ke akakhulumi ngakho, lokho okwenza kube nzima ukuthi baphunyuke kulolu dobo lokufundiswa ngocansi," kusho u-Poto.

Indlalifa angeke neze ibe ngufakazi. • Kumele ufake iminini ngwane ephelele yama fa akho kanye nokuthi ngobani ofuna uku bashiyela wona, okufaka phakathi amagama kanye nemininingwane yabo. • Kumele ukhethe umuntu ozophatha ifa lakho (uma bi wefa). Lo muntu aka kwazi ukuba yindlalifa.

Ungqongqoshe uPandor uqinisekisile ukuthi sekubekwe eceleni izigidi zezigidi zamara ndi ezingama-4.581 kwenzelwa izitshudeni ezikwaze ukungena emanyuvesi kanye nezigidi zezigidi zamarandi eziyi-2.585 zezitshudeni zakumakolishi e-TVET. Ngowezi-2017 uhulumeni wamemezela ukuthi imfundo ephakeme izoba mahhala kuzi tshudeni ezimpofu kanye na lezo ezivela emindenini ethola umholo wonyaka ohlangene ngaphambi kwezimali eziba njwayo engaze ifinyelele kwi -zi-350 000 zamarandi. Izitshudeni zesekwa ngesi kimu semifundaze esibanzi, esingena esikhundleni sesi kimu esedlule esasinengxenye eyimalimboleko kanye nengu mfundaze esasihlinzekwa iSi khwama Sikwazwelonke Sokusiza Abafundi Ngezimali (i-NSFAS). “Ukuhlinzekwa okusisekelo kwe-NSFAS kokuxhasa izitshudeni ezivela emindenini empofu kanye naleyo ihola amaholo aphansi ezingena emanyuvesi kanye nakumako lishi e-TVET kuzokhuphuka ku suka ezigidini zezigidi zamara ndi eziyi-9.849 ngowe zi-2017/18 ukuya ezigidini zezigidi zamarandi ezinga ma-35.321 ngowezi-2020/21.

Uthi ukwelulama kuleli gciwane kushintshe indlela acabanga ngayo futhi abona ngayo impilo.“Uwubonga kakhulu umndeni wakho kanye ne-zinto ezincane empilweni. Ngiyafisa sengathi abantu kunoma yiyiphi indawo yokusebenza bengathatha isibopho ngempilo yabo futhi bafundise imindeni yabo kanye nabantwana, ikakhu-lukazi njengoba abantwana sebebuyele esikoleni. “Siza umntwana wakho ukuthi athole izindlela ezi-ntsha zokutshengisa uthando ebanganini babo, ngapha-ndle kokusondelana kanye nokuthintana nabo. Yenza ukuthi umndeni wakho ubu-lale amagciwane ngaphambi kokuba ungene endlini, shiya izicathulo egalaji uma kufanele, khumula zonke izi-ngubo zakho ugeze umzimba ngaphambi kokuba ubingelele umndeni wakho futhi qaphela kakhulu ezempilo ukuze uba-vikele,” kusho yena.Umnyango weluleke abantu abanezifo eziyimbelesela uku-ba badle ukudla okunempilo, bazivocavoce njalo, bakwazi ukulawula ukhwantalala, balandele uhlelo lwemithi yokwelashwa kwabo futhi balandele izinyathelo zokuzi-vikela ezidingekayo.

Isikhathi sokugcinwa kohla lwesaphuli-mthetho sikhushuliwe, futhi labo abafakwe kurejista kuzomele bakudalule lokho uma befaka izicelo zokusebenza nabantu ababuthaka-thaka. UMthetho-sivivinywauphinde uhlinzekele ukuthi amagama abantu aku-NRSO umphakathi uyakwazi ukuwathola. Isichibiyelo soMthetho-sivivinywa Wamacala Obugebengu kanye Nahambisana nawo sizoqinisa, phakathi kokunye, ukunikezwa kwebheyili kwezaphula-mthetho zeGBVF , futhi sichaze kabanzi ngamacala azothola izigwebo ezincane.Izichibiyelo zibeka izibopho ezi-ntsha phezu kwezikhulu zomthetho kanye nezinkantolo zethu. Uma umshushisi engasiphikisi isicelo sebheyili emacaleni eGBV , kumele abhale izizathu zakhe phansi.

Ukugwema ihlandla lesibili lokusuleleka ngeCOVID-19 , kumele silandele imihla hlandlela yezempilo yompha kathi elokhu ikhona. Uma sihluleka ukugqoka isifonyo uma sihlangene emphakathini, uma sithamele imicimbi enabantu abaningi, asibeki thina nabanye ku phela engozini. Sibeka futhi nokuvuseleleka komnotho wethu engcupheni. Masiqhubeke sidlale indima yethu.

Kukhona ithuba lokugcina lokubhalisela ukuvota ngempelasonto ezayo. Zonke izikhungo zokuvota eziyizi-22 932 zizovuleka kusukela ngo-08h00 kuya ngo-17h00. Lokhu kwenzelwa ukuvumela wonke umuntu, ikakhulukazi ababhalisa okokuqala, ukuba babhalise ukuze bakwazi ukuvota.

I-Central Application Clearing House (i-CACH) iwuhlelo olwesikhashana olusungulwe uMnyango weMfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha ukuze lusize abafundi abangakatholi izindawo ezizifanele ezinyuvesi nakamakolishi. Lolu hlelo lusebenza njengebhuloho elixhumanisa abafundi nezikhungo zemfundo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akekho umfundi okwazi ukufunda ozosala ngaphandle. Ngonyaka we-2018, i-CACH ibizwakale kakhulu ngokuvula amathuba amaningi kubafundi ababephila ngokukhathazeka ngenxa yokungabi namatheyela ezifundweni zabo.

Nokho, ngaso lesi sikhathi, sizodinga ukusebenzisa imali kakhulu ukuseka ukuhlelwa kabusha kwama-SOEs afana no-Eskom kanye no-SAA. Ngenxa yalokhu, silindele ukuncipha kwengenisomali ebanjelwe ngezigidigidi ezi ngama-R156 ekusetshenzi sweni kwemali okungena nzalo esikhathini esiphakathi. Lokhu kuzosiza ukunci phisa ukuntuleka kwemali nokunciphisa izidingo zoku thi siboleke. Ingxenye enkulu yokonga izoqhamuka ekunciphiseni isilinganiso sethu somthetho sivivinywa samaholo esi khula ngakhona.

I-B&B (Bed and Breakfast) indawo yokulala encane lapho izivakashi zithola khona igumbi lokulala kanye nokudla kwasekuseni. Ukuze uqale lebhizinisi, kumele uqinisekise ukuthi unendawo ehlanzekile, ephephile, futhi eyenza izivakashi zizizwe zikhululekile. Kubalulekile ukubhalisa ibhizinisi lakho ngokusemthethweni nokukukhangisa ukuze uthole amakhasimende amaningi. Ukunikeza ukwamukelwa okuhle nokunakekela izivakashi kuyisihluthulelo sempumelelo yale bhizinisi.

Njengezwe, sibuya kude ekupheleliseni isithunzi somuntu, okuyisimiso u-Steve Biko ayesiqhakambisa kakhulu. Kodwa, liselide ibanga okusamele silihambe. Ngaphandle komsebenzi, ngaphandle kwendlu, ugesi noma amanzi, ngaphandle komhlaba, ngaphandle kwamakhono noma amathuba, izigidi zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika basanqatshelwe impilo abayifunayo nebafanele. Yingakho uhulumeni esebenzi sana nababambiqhaza emphakathini ukwakha umnotho obandakanya wonke umuntu, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ukuvumela amabhizinisi ukuthi alwisane futhi abhekane nobubha nendlala.

I-Go George wuhlelo lwezothutho olusebenza ekuhlomiseni nokusiza abantu abakhubazekile ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba kalula. UMasipala waseGeorge ugcizelele ukuthi izinhlelo zezokuthutha umphakathi kumele zibe kufanele wonke umuntu, kuhlanganise nabakhubazekile. Lolu hlelo luyingxenye yomzamo omkhulu womasipala wokuxazulula izinkinga zokuthutha nokwandisa amathuba okuhamba. Lokhu kusiza ekutheni abantu abanesidingo bazizwe bebandakanyeka futhi babe nokuzimela emphakathini wabo.

Yize noma kungeke kube sezingeni lokuqhwagwa kombuso, lezi zenzo zobugebengu zithunaza izwe lethu kakhulu, zenze buthaka izikhungo zethu futhi zi ncisha abantu baseNingizimu Afrika izidingo-ngqangi eziningi. Inkohlakalo ingukuziphatha okubi ngokwedlulele, kepha kungukonakala okukhulu uma yenziwa kubantu ngesikhathi sosizi. Sisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bedijithali ukuqinisa ukuhlonzwa, ukuthungathwa kanye nokuhlaliswa ngabodwana kwabantu abake bahlangana nabantu abanegciwane, kanjalo nokuhlinzeka ngokwesekwa ku-labo abathola imiphumela ebika ukuthi banalo igciwane.Njengoba manje sesisondele kuvuthondaba lokutheleleka kwabantu ngaleli gciwane, sidinga ukucophelela kakhulu ekulandeleni izinyathelo zoku-phepha futhi siqinise izinyathelo ezikhona ukuze sehlisa izinga lokuthelelana ngegciwane.Izimiso ezibekiwe mayelana nokufakwa kwezimfonyo zizo-qiniswa.

Lesi sikole esiseMthatha, eMpumalanga Koloni, saqala ngokusebenza egalaji lakwaNkululeko Ralo, ilungu lomphakathi elalivumile. Eminyakeni eyedlule, isikole sabhekana nobunzima ngokuthutha izikhathi eziningi ngenxa yokuntuleka kwesakhiwo esifanele. Nokho, isimo sesishintshile njengoba i-ASIDI ingene ngokushesha yakha ingqalasizinda yesikole efanele. Lokhu kusize kakhulu ekunikezeni abafundi indawo ephikelele nephephile yokufunda.

Lezi zifundo zibandakanya ukuqeqeshwa mayelana nokuthi iyini inkampani futhi yini umqondisi, abantu abasemqoka enkampanini, amagunya abaqondisi, izinjongo zezimali zomuntu siqu kanye nokungqubuzana kwezintshisekelo, imiholo nokwabelana ngezinzuzo kwabaqondisi kanye nebhodi labaqondisi. Ukuze ubhalisele ukuqeqeshwa, vakashela ku: www.elearning@cipc.co.za. Izinkantolo Zezinkampani UDkt Mohammed Chicktay, onguSihlalo weZinkantolo Zezinkampani i-CT, wachaza ukuthi le nhlangano isiza ekuhlinzekeni ngesixazululo esisheshayo ezingxabanweni zenkampani, eziphathelene nezicelo kanye nezikhalo ezenzi we ngokoMthetho Wezinkampani wama-71 kowezi-2008. Izikhalo zibandakanya amagama enkampani, ukuphathwa kwayo kanye nokukhululwa ekusunguleni amakomidi omphakathi kanye nezimiso zokuziphatha.

Lokhu kuyenzeka ngenxa yokuthi abantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika bayilandele imiyalelo yokuvalwa kwezwe, ukuqhelelana nabanye abantu kanye nokugqoka izifonyo zo-buso. Ngiyanibonga kakhulu ngalokhu nangakho konke ukuzinikela esenikwenzile.Kulesi sigaba sokudlondlobala kobhubhane, amanye amazwe abe nenani labasulelekile eliphe-zulu ukwedlula thina. Njenga-manje – okungusuku lwama-46 selokhu sabika isigameko se-100 segciwane lecorona – sesinezi-gameko eziqinisekisiwe eziyizi-6 783. Izwe lase-Italy, elinenani labantu elifanayo nelethu, libe nezigameko ezingaphezu kwe-zi-140 000 kanye neMelika ibe nezigameko eziqinisekisiwe ezilinganiselwa ezi-700 000 esikhathini sezinsuku ezinga-ma-46.Kodwa lokhu akusho ukuthi ubungozi sebudlulile.

I-GEPF isenzile kube lula kakhulu ukuba amalungu ayo kanye nemindeni yabo bafake izikhalazo zabo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uphathwa ngendlela efanele, ibhodi lisanda kusungula iHhovisi Elilamula Ezezimpesheni Zabasebenzi elizoba nendima yokulawula nokuxazulula lezi zinkathazo. Lenyisizalo ihlose ukunikeza usizo olusheshayo nolunembile, okukhombisa ukuzibophezela kwe-GEPF ekuthuthukiseni inkonzo kubasebenzi nabaphumule.

Kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi wonke umuntu aqinisekise ukuthi ubhale incwadi yefa ukuze kuvikeleke ukungaboni ngaso linye emndeni ngokuhamba kwezinto. Uma umuntu eshona engayibhalanga le ncwadi, izimpahla zakhe zizokwabiwa ngokomthetho we-Intestate Succession Act kulabo abanelungelo lokuzithola. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni ifa lakho lingayi kubantu obukade ufisa ukulishiyela bona. Thatha isinyathelo namuhla, ubhale incwadi yefa ukuze uvikele ikusasa labathandi bakho.

Usuku Lomhlaba LweDown Syndrome lugubha ngenhloso yokukhulisa ukuqonda nokunika isithunzi abantu abaphila nale nkinga. I-Down Syndrome iyingxenye yokuphazamiseka kumachromosome okuqubuka ngesikhathi ukhulelwa, okudala ukuthi umuntu azalwe nezimo ezithile. UDkt Midah Maluleka, odokotela eMpu, uqaphela ukuthi ukwengezeka kwama-chromosome kuholela ekutheni kube nokuhlukana ekukhuleni kwengqondo nomzimba. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sisekele futhi simukele bonke abantu ukuze baphile impilo enenjabulo nentokozo.

Kuvuliwe ithuba lesibili kubantu abafuna ukuzitholela izitifiketi zabo zomatikuletsheni. Umqondisi wohlelo, uDkt Sandy Malapile, ugcizelela ukuthi isitifiketi sikamatikuletsheni sibaluleke ngendlela eyisimanga. Uthi ngaphandle kwaso, iminyango yamathuba eminingi ihlala ivalekile kubantu. Lolu hlelo luhlose ukusiza labo abafuna ukuphucula imiphumela yabo ukuze bavule amathuba amasha empilweni.

Kumele baqhubeke nokukhiqiza ubuntatheli obungale kwezihloko namakhasi okuqala futhi o bunegalelo ekuthuthukiseni uluntu. Kumele babike izindaba ezimnandi nezimbi, inqubekela-phambili esiyenzayo kanye nezinselele esibhekana nazo.Ukwethembeka kubaluleke kakhulu ekugcineni ukuthembana phakathi kwezi ntatheli nomphakathi. Uma izintatheli zivuma ukuthi zona noma izizindakusebenza zazo zisetshe nziselwe izimpi zepolitiki noma ukuziphindiselela e sikhundleni sokwenza lokhu okufanele, ukwethembeka kwazo kuyathunazeka. Uma abezindaba besabalalisa izindaba ezingelona iqiniso noma lezo abaziyo ukuthi zingamampunge, umphakathi ulahla ithemba kubona.Kukuyena wonke umuntu othanda leli lizwe futhi ofisa ukuthi liphumelele ukuthi abezindaba bakithi baya sekelwa, futhi bangaphaza nyiswa emsebenzini wabo.

Ngaphezu konyaka, sesi sebenze ngokubambisana njengomphakathi ukunqa nda lolu bhubhane. Manje njengoba sisebenzela uku linqoba, sidinga ukuphinde siqinise ukuzimisela kwethu sonke ukuthi siziphathe ngendlela eqotho neno kuqaphela. Uma senza njalo, siyobe si fezekisa imiyalezo yomhlaba yethemba, insindiso, inkulu leko kanye nobunye ezobe ikhulunywa emasontweni, kumasinagoge, emamosque kanye nasemakhaya asendaweni yakithi ezinsukwini nasemavikini azayo.

Nakuba abenzi bobugebengu bangase bacabange ukuthi baphumelele ngokudabukisa umbuso, iqiniso lithi ubugebengu abubuyiseli. Ingalo yomthetho inde, okusho ukuthi akukho muntu ongabalekela ukuboshwa noma ukuhlawuliswa ngezenzo zakhe ezimbi. Inkantolo ekhethekile iqinisekisa ukuthi ubulungiswa buyafinyelela kubo bonke abaphule imithetho, okuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu ubhekana nemiphumela yakhe.

Sizethulela isigqoko lezi zakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ezidela imizi yazo, imi ndeni kanye nabathandiweyo ziye emitholampilo, ezibhedle-la nakwezinye izikhungo zeze-mpilo mihla namalanga. Lapho ezifika zihlinzeke ngemisebe-nzi yokunakekela ngokweze-mpilo, ezokusekwa ukupha-thwa kwemisebenzi kanye neminye imisebenzi njengoku-hlanza nokuhlinzeka ngokudla. Njengoba zenza imisebenzi yazo ngobungcweti, nathi kumele sizitshathe kanye nemindeni yazo emahlombe ethu. Impilo nokuphepha kwazo kumele kube seqhulwini.

Izikhungo zokuthuthukiswa kwabantwana ziyisihluthulelo esibalulekile sokwakha ikusasa lethu eliqhakazile. Leli sikhungo lakhiwe inhlangano ye-Impande South Africa, ngokwesekwa yi-Nelson Mandela Foundation, kuye ngenjongo yokwakha isisekelo esiqinile sabantwana. Ukuzinikela okukhulu kwabasebenzi balesi sikhungo kuyinto ekhuthazayo kakhulu, okukhombisa ukuzikhandla okungaka ekukhuliseni isizwe esizayo.

Emva kwezikhukhula, kubalulekile ukuqala ngokuhlanza nokulungisa imvelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabo bonke abantu. Ukubambisana nokusekelana emphakathini kuyisihluthulelo sokwakha kabusha izindlu namabhizinisi ngokushesha nangempumelelo. Kudingeka futhi sifunde kulesi simo ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezingcono zokwakha nokulawula amanzi ukuze kuvikelwe imonakalo esikhathini esizayo. Ngokubekezela nangomqondo omuhle, kungenzeka ukwakha indlela yokuphila eqinile futhi ezimile.

Usuku Lomhlaba Lwabahlengikazi luyithuba elibalulekile lokubonga laba bantu abazidela ukusiza imiphakathi yethu. Abahlengikazi basebenza kanzima ukuxazulula izinkinga zomphakathi nokuletha ithemba kulabo abasedingeni. Ngoba baqeqeshelwe ukusebenzisana nabantu, basiza ekulungiseni imindeni nokuvikela amalungelo ababuthakathaka. Sithi siyabonga kakhulu ngothando nokuzikhandla kwenu ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu.

Umthelela kwezomnothoUkuzingelwa kobhejane kanye nokushushumbiswa kwezi lwane kunomthelela omubi ekuthuthukisweni komnotho wezwe kanye nasekudalweni kwamathuba omsebenzi, oku-hlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa komnotho onhlobonhlobo wezemvelo ohlanganisa no mkhakha wezokuvakasha. “Ukulahleka kohlobo lwezi lwane oluyingqalabutho kakhulu lwaseNingizimu Afrika olufana nobhejane, nongesinye ‘Sezilwane Ezinku-lu Ezinhlanu’ kungaba nomthe-lela omubi ngokuphathelene nenani lezivakashi eNingizimu Afrika. Izivakashi eziningi eziza eNingizimu Afrika zizela ukuzobona Izilwane Ezinhlanu Ezinkulu, nokuwubhejane, ibhubesi, inyathi, ingwe kanye nendlovu,” kusho isitatimende soMnyango Wezendawo. Ukuzingelwa kobhejane sekwaziswe njengengozi yezokuphepha ezweni, enga ba nomthelela kuamanani ezivakashi ezivakashela izwe, futhi uhulumeni usememezele ukuthi kuwubugebengu obuse qhulwini kuzwelonke.

Singeze neze sazinika ithemba lokuthi singaqeda i-HIV uma sisaziba izidingo, ukukhathazeka kanye namalungelo engxenye yenani-bantu lakithi.INingizimu Afrika kufanele ukuthi ikhuphule amasokisi ezinyathelweni zayo zokuthi kusokwe abesilisa abasha ukuze kuncishiswe ubungozi bokuthi bathole i-HIV . Ukuso-kwa okungaphephile akumele neze kugcine kunika abesilisa abasha izinkinga zempilo zangunaphakade, futhi akukho na-munye okufanele ukuthi abulawe ukusokwa. Kumele siqinisekise ukuthi abesilisa abasebasha ba-sokwa ngendlela ephephile. Sigqugquzelwa yimiphu-mela yocwaningo lwakamuva olumayelana nezindlela zoku-vikelwa kweSandulela ngculazi ipre-exposure prophylaxis( i-PrEP).

Kubanikazi abaningi bama bhizinisi, ukubona ibhizinisi olikhulisile kusuka ekuqaleni lithwele kanzima ekutheni liphokophele phambili, noma ukuphoqeleka ukuthi livalwe, kuzwisa ubuhlungu obukhulu. Kusuka kubheduka ubhu bhane lwe-COVID-19, lobu buhlungu bube yisimo esi bhekane namabhizinisi amaningi amakhulu kanye namancane, hhayi ezweni lakithi kuphela nje kodwa umhlaba wonke jikelele. Ubhubhane kanye nezinyathelo obekufanele sizithathe ukunqanda ukubhebhetheka kwegciwane le-corona zibe nomthelela omubi emabhizinisini. Ekubhekaneni nalolu bhubhane siye sadinga uku sebenzisa indlela enobufa kazi benqubomgomo kanye nokwenza, ngokubheka ucwaningo lwezesayensi, ubu ngcweti kanye namandla ezokwelapha, kanye nomthelela kuyo yonke imikhakha yomphakathi.

Izazi zezempilo zase ziqhakambise ngokukhula kwesibalo sabantu abanegciwane i-COVID-19, okusevele kwenzeka manje. Kukhonjiswe ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abangaphezu kwekota lesigidi sebetheleleke ngalesi cigawane. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba sonke sibambisane ukuze sisize ekunqandeni ukusabalala kuka-COVID-19 emphakathini.

Uma impilo ikujikijela ngolamula, ukulima kungaba yindlela enhle yokuzivusa nokuthola amathuba amasha empilweni. Uhlelo Lokwesekwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi lusiza intsha efana noWayne Mansfield ukuba ishintshe indlela yempilo yayo ngokungena kwezolimo. Ngisho noma uWayne ebisebenza njengomdayisi, manje ufunda ukuthi ukutshala kungaba yisihluthulelo sokuzimela nokuziphilisa. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ukulima kuyithuba elivulekile kubantu abafuna ukuqala kabusha nokwakha ikusasa eliqinile.

“Bengihlala ngisho ngokwami ukuthi, ukube angizange ngigonywe, ngoZibandlela lapho ngesuleleka ngeCOVID-19, mhlawumbe ngabe angimile lapha,” esika kwelijikayo. UMongameli uzinike isikhathi sokunxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi bathathe umgomo osindisa impilo futhi baqhubeke nokulandela izinyathelo eziyisisekelo sezempilo futhi bahlale beqaphile. “Sizokwazi ukuqhubeka nempilo yethu, ngisho naleli gciwane liphakathi kwethu,” usho kanje, wengeza ngokuthi lolu bhubhane selubhebhethekise uqhekeko phakathi kwalabo abasebenzayo kanye nabangasebenzi. Isikhwama Sobumbano UMongameli uRamaphosa umemezele ukuthi Isikhwama Sobumbano siqoqe izigidigidi ezi3.4 zamarandi kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nasezinkampanini ezingaphezu kwezi300 000, ngesikhathi abantu abangaphezu kwama-400 kanye nezinkampani eziyi100 bezinikele ngesikhathi nemisebenzi yabo.

Umhuhiso owengeziwe kwabamabhizinisi asemanca ne, labo abaqasha abantu abasha abaneminyaka yobu dala ephakathi kweyi-18 kuya kwengama-29, bazofaneleka Izaphulelo Zentela Zokuqa sha ezilingana ne-R1 000 nge nyanga. Abantu abasha bohlelo lweYES kufanele babe: • Neminyaka yobudala ephakathi kweyi-18nengama-34.• Ukuthi bebangasebe nzi isikhathi sezinyanga eziyisithupha. • Abantu abamnyama (Owomdabu, Oyikhala di noma oyiNdiya). • Uma kwenzeka izi nkampani zifuna uku faka isicelo seSaphule lo Sentela Sokuqasha, intsha kufanele kube ineminyaka yobuda la ephakathi kweyi-18 nengama-29.

Inkantolo ekhethekile isiqalile ukunikeza isibonelo esicacile sokuthi ubugebengu abubuyiseli. Nakuba labo abaphulaphule umthetho bengase bacabange ukuthi sebaphumelele, kumele bazi ukuthi ingalo yomthetho inde kakhulu. Akukho ndawo yokucashelwa, ngoba umthetho uzofika kuwo wonke umuntu ozama ukudlala ngalo.

Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibonakala njengomthombo omkhulu wogqozi nethemba ekusaseni lezwe. Noma ngabe bahlala kuphi futhi noma ngabe benzani, bonke ngamunye banentshi-sekelo yokushintsha umhlaba. Ngesikhathi befuna ngoku-ngangabazeki ukuthuthukisa izimpilo zabo, baphinde bafise ukubona umphakathi wakubo uthuthuka futhi ube ngcono.

Laba balimi abangama-30 bathole amatayitela obuni kazi balo mhlaba kuMonga meli u-Cyril Ramaphosa emva kokuba UMnyango Wezemisebenzi Kahulu meni kanye neNgqalasizinda unikezele ngalo mhlaba ngenhloso yokuwaba kabu sha. Lo mhlaba ubiza isamba semali esingaphezulu kwe zigidi ezingama-25.5 zama randi kodwa unikezelwe kulaba balimi mahhala. “Lolu ngusuku oluhle ka khulu impela kumphakathi wase-Tafelkop, kubantu base-Limpopo, futhi ngo kunjalo kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. “Namhlanje singofakazi bokufezwa kwephupho lalo mphakathi.

UMabitsela, ovela endaweni yase-Modimolle e-Limpopo, uhlangabezane nesimo esinzima lapho efuna imali-mboleko ebhange ngoLwezi kowezi-2020, kodwa watshelwa ukuthi usezakweletini ngokwedlulele. Lokhu kudalule ukuthi kukamazisi wakhe kwebiwe, okwenza ukuba abanye basebenzise imininingwane yakhe ukuthatha imali ngaphandle kwemvume yakhe. Le ndaba isixwayisa ngokubaluleka kokugcina imininingwane yethu eyimfihlo iphephile ukuze sigweme ukwebiwa kukamazisi okungabhulala isimo sezimali sethu. Kucelwa ukuba abantu bahlole imibiko yabo yezikweletu njalo ukuze babone noma kukhona okungahambi kahle.

Enkulumweni yakhe Echaza Ngesimo Sezwe (SoNA) yangonyaka we-2022, uMongameli uCyril Ramaphosa ugcizelele kakhulu ukubaluleka kokuthuthukisa izimpilo kanye nendlela yabantu yokuziphilisa. Ubike ukuthi lo msebenzi uzokwakhela phezu kwesisekelo soHlelo Lokwakhiwa Kabusha kanye Nokuvuselelwa Komnotho ukuze kube nokuthuthuka okuqondile. Lokhu kuhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kudalwa amathuba emisebenzi futhi kuncishiswe ububha ezweni lonke.

Luwuhlelo oluhle kakhulu oluqaliswe nguhulumeni futhi akungabazeki nakancane uku thi luzosiguqula isimo sezinto, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha njengami abagibela izithuthi zomphakathi nsuku zonke besuka eSoweto belibangise eNyuvesi yaseGoli e-Auckland Park.”“Okungenani manje sengiya kwazi ukuhlela uhambo lwami kangcono, ngokwemali engi -nayo, futhi ngenze nesilinganiso sezikhathi zokuhamba ngize ngifike lapho ngiphokophele khona.”“Ngicabanga ukuthi lolu wu hlelo-kusebenza olumangazayo impela futhi njengomuntu ongeyena owokudabuka ku lesi sifundazwe, luzongisiza kakhulu uma kufanele ngiha mbe ngezithuthi zomphakathi,” kusho uKhanyo Malunga, ngesikhathi ekhuluma no Vuk’uzenzele e-Blairgowrie. “Uma ngize lapha ngizokwe nza inhlolokhono, ngizokwazi ukuhlela kangcono futhi ngazi nendlela yami kanye nokuthi ngiyaphi,” kwengeza yena. Lolu hlelo-kusebenza lutho lakala kumadivayisi e-Android nama-iPhone, ezitolo ezihluka hlukene zezinhle lo-kusebenza zokuxhumana .

Ukulahleka kwemisebenzi okubangelwe ukuvalwa kwezwe sekwandise inkinga yezinkampani zabezindaba ezivele zibhekene nezi nselele ezifana nezimali zokukhangisa, ukusatsha laliswa kwephephandaba kanye nesabelo semakethe esesihlwithwe izindaba ezikhishwa ngomakhale khukhwini nangobunye ubuchwepheshe. Lezi zingqi namba zemali zihlasele yonke indawo, kusuka kuzindaba zaku-inthanethi kuya kulwa zi olubhalwe ephepheni kuya kubasakazi. Lolu olunye lodaba olwa phakanyiswa ngesikhathi sezingxoxo zami zakamuva nje nenkundla Kazwelonke yaseNingizimu Afrika Yabahleli i-South African National Editors’ Forum. Esikhundleni sokubalisa ngekusasa labo, kunalokho, imboni yabezindaba isebenza kanzima ukuhlela kabusha ibhizinisi, ukuza nezindlela ezintsha kanye nokugcina abasebenzi ngayo yonke indlela.

Ngokusemthethweni, i-National Health Laboratory Services (NHLS) isiqinisekise ukuthi isifo se-Monkeypox sikhona eNingizimu Afrika emuva kokwenziwa kwezivivinyo zaselabhorethri. Leli sigciwane lingahlasela umzimba, ngakho kubalulekile ukuba abantu baqaphele izimpawu ezifana nemaphuphu emzimbeni, ukushisa komzimba, kanye nokukhuluza kwama-lymph nodes. Uma ubona lezi zimpawu, sicela ukhulume nodokotela ngokushesha ukuze uthole usizo lokwelashwa okufanele.

Kwethenjwa ukuthi igu mbi leli ngeke nje ligcine ngo kweseka omama abancelisayo abasebenzayo kuphela, ko dwa lizophinde likhutha ze neminye iminyango ukuba yeseke abesifazane abancelisayo ezindaweni zomsebenzi. Abasebenzi bomnya ngo bangakwazi nokuba abazanyana babo babale thele izingane emsebenzini ngesikhathi sesidlo sasemini ukuze bazincelise ibele. Igu mbi lizophinde lisetshe nziswe nangomama abafuna ukukhama ubisi ngesikhathi somsebenzi. Omunye wabasebenzi bo mnyango uMpho Kutumela nongumama wamawele a nezinyanga eziyi-11 ubuda la, umfana nentombazane, wesese kakhulu ngale nsiza.

Abazali nabagadi bakhuthazwa ukuba baqaphele izimpawu zokuqala zomdlavuza ebantwaneni. UMxhumanisi weNhlangano Yomdlavuza Wabantwana eNingizimu Afrika (i-CHOC), u-Taryn Seegers, uthi ukwazi lezi zimpawu kubaluleke kakhulu ekusindiseni izimpilo. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba uma umdlavuza uhlo nzwe kusenesikhathi futhi welashwa, kuba maningi amathuba okwelulama ngokugcwele.

“Ngesikhathi ngikhula, ngangimbona umdlwenguli eKatlehong futhi ngaya ngokuba nolaka. Ngangingakwazi ukwe mukela ukuthi wayengazange ajeziselwe into ayenzile.”Ngesikhathi esekhulakhulile, futhi eyibhungu elinamandla, uTshepo wayengasakwazi uku gcina ngaphakathi ulaka lwakhe, futhi wayeshaya owahla sela udadewabo la embona khona. Wayeka ukuba yingane enokuthula waphenduka umuntu omusha onolaka. Zimbili izinto ezasindisa uTshepo kule ndlela yobudlova.

Abaholi bendabuko badlala indima ebalulekile ekululameni nasekuletheni ukuthula emiphakathini yabo. Ukukhothama kwezinkosi ezinkulu njengo-Goodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu kanye no-Kgoshikgolo Thulare III kukhombisa ukuthi lobu buholi buyinsika ekubumbeni izizwe. Labo baholi bayasiza ekuhambiseni isizwe ngendlela efanele ngezikhathi zobuhlungu, baqinisekise ukuthi amasiko ayahlonishwa. Ngakho-ke, ubuholi bendabuko buhlala buyisihluthulelo esibalulekile ekugcineni ubunye nokululama kwesizwe.

Eminyakeni eyi-11 selokhu sahlanganyela ne-BRICS, ubulungu bethu buthuthu kise kakhulu intshisekelo yezwelonke. Ukuba yilungu le-BRICS kukhulise izinga esikulo njengomnotho oba lulekile osafufusa. Kusenze safinyelela ku mthethonqubo nobuchwe pheshe bokusebenza kwemi notho emikhulu nethuthukile, kanjalo nokufinyelela ekwe sekweni yi -National Deve lopment Bank . Kuqinise ubushoshovu be thu enkundleni yomhlaba jikelele, ikakhulukazi maye lana nokuguqulwa kwezi khungo ezehlukahlukene.

Awukho umgomo ohlinzeka ngokuvikeleka okungama-phesenti ayi-100. Ukugonywa kwenani elanele labantu nakho kakuhlinzeki ngokuvikeleka okuphelele kulabo abangagomile. Noma kunjalo, ngokugonywa kwenani elanele labantu, laba bantu bazoba nokuvikeleka okusezingeni elikahle.Ngakube ukugoma kuphephile na?Imigomo ye-COVID-19 idlula kwinqubo enomsebenzi omkhulu, enezigabagaba zokuhlola, okubandakanya ukuhlolwa kokusebenza kwayo okufaka phakathi izinkulungwane eziyishumi zabantu.Wonke umgomo osetshenzisiwe ohlelweni lokugoma abantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika kumele ugunyazwe ukusetshenziswa inhlangano Yeziphathimandla Ezilawula Imikhiqizo Yezempilo eNingizimu Afrika i-South Afri-can Health Products Regula-tory Authority. Umgomo i-Oxford University-AstraZeneca usuvele ugunyaziwe kakade ngabalawuli abehlukahlukene emhlabeni jikelele futhi usuqalile ukukhishwa unikezwe abantu kwamanye amazwe.Ngakube iNingizimu Afrika izoyithola kuphi imigomo yayo yokuqala?Amaqoqo okuqala amabili emigomo azofika eNingizimu Afrika (abalelwa esi-gidini ngoMasingana kanye nayizi-500 000 ngoNhlolanja) ngawemigomo i-Oxford University-AstraZeneca evela e-Serum Institute of India.

Ukuze kuvikelwe ukukhula kwabesifazane abasebancane, kubalulekile ukuba banikwe imininingwane efanele nokusekelwa okugcwele emiphakathini yabo. Intombazane ngayinye kumele nikwe amandla okuthatha izinqumo ezifanele mayelana nomzimba wayo, kungaba ngokukhetha ukuzilwa kocansi noma ukusebenzisa izindlela zokuzivikela. Ukuxhumana okuhle nabazali kanye nabaeluleki kuyasiza ekutheni bagweme ingcindezi futhi benze izinqumo ezinempilo zekusasa labo. Lokhu kuvikela ukukhula kwabo kusho ukuhlonipha imingcele yabo nokuqinisekisa ukuthi bathola imfundo efanele.

Lengeze ngokuthi izakhamuzi kufanele zithole imvume ku-DWS uma zifuna ukudayisa noma ukuthenga amanzi asemapitsini/nasemithonjeni yamanzi. Njengomzamo kahulumeni wokulawula ukusetshenzi-swa kwamanzi, i-DWS ithe iziphathimandla zibeke izi-nyathelo eziqinille ukuqikelela ukuthi ukuphakelwa kwamanzi ngendlela ebekelwe imikhawu-lo kuyalandelwa. Idolobha futhi lisebenzisana nethimba eliqinisekisa uku landelwa komthetho kanye noPhiko Oluphenyayo Olu-khethekile ukuqikelela ukula-ndelwa komthetho. Ukuthathela izinyathelo abaphula umthetho Umnyango ngokuhlanganyela nedolobha usanda kugasela eMfuleni, ugxile ezenzweni zokusetshenziswa kwamanzi ngokungekho semthethweni.

Ukuze kufikeleleke intuthuko eqinisekile, kubalulekile ukuba kube nemisebenzi kahulumeni eqeqeshekile futhi enezikhwama zolwazi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abasebenzi bomphakathi kumele babe nokuqeqeshwa okusezingeni eliphezulu, babe nokuzikhandla, kanye nokulandela imithetho yokusebenza ngokwethembeka. Uma imisebenzi ihlelwa futhi iphathwe ngabantu abanolwazi, ukulethwa kwezidingo zomphakathi kuyashesha futhi kuba seqhuba. Ngakho-ke, ukugxila ekuthuthukiseni amakhono asebenzi kahulumeni kuyisihluthulelo sokwakha isizwe esiqhambayo nesiphumelelayo.

Ichweba laseThekwini libonakala liqhubeka nokuvula iminyango eminingi yezomnotho eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuvelele emva kokuxoxisana nabaphathi abakhulu bakwaTransnet, okugcine ngokuvakashelwa kwezibuko ogwini lolwandle ngesikebhe esisetshenziselwa ukuthutha impahla. Ukuthuthukiswa kwale ndawo kuzovula amathuba amaningi emisebenzi, kanti kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi izwe lethu lihlala lixhumene nomhlaba wonke ngokusebenza kahle kwezothutho. Lolu hambo luqinisekisa ukuthi iThekwini liseyisikhungo esibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ikusasa lezoqoqo zezomnotho ezizovuselela izwe.

Izinda zokwakha ziyindawo efanele kakhulu yokufundela onjiniyela abasaqeqeshwa. Kulezi zindawo, bathola ulwazi olubalulekile ngokubona nokusebenza phakathi kokuduma kwemishini nokuzikhandla kwabasebenzi. Lokhu kubasiza ukuba baqonde imisebenzi yangempela yokwakha ngendlela ecacile. Ngakho-ke, ukufunda ngokuzibonela kulezi zindawo kunika isizinda esiqinile sokusebenza.

i-RTMC ikhuthaza abashayeli ukuba bayolanda amakhadi abo elayisensi yokushayela emuva kokutholakala ukuthi amaningi asasezikhungweni. NgokweNhlangano Elawula Izimoto Emgwaqeni (i-RTMC), ngama-42% kuphela amakhadi elayisensi yokushayela kwayizi-32 748 akhiqizwe aselandiwe. UNgqongqoshe WezoThutha, uFikile Mbalula, ubiza abashayeli ukuba bayolanda amakhadi abo ngokushesha ukuze kuhleleke imisebenzi yezomgwaqo.

Ngokwe-DWS kube nokuntuleka kwezimvula futhi kwehla nezinga lamanzi emadamini. Lokhu sekwenze iziphathi mandla zibeke izinyathelo eziqi nile ukunweba isikhathi sokufika kosuku lokuntuleka kwamanzi, lapho amathangi azobe omile. IDolobha laseKapa liqala imikhawulo yezinga u-6B. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi kuzoba nomkhawulo wansuku zonke wamalitha amanzi angama-50 noma angaphansi kumuntu ngamunye, osekhaya, emsebenzini, esikoleni noma kwenye indawo.

Imithetho emithathu emisha isivele iyasebenza njengamanje ukuqinisa ubulungiswa kubugebengu kanye nokweseka labo abasindile. “Ukuqaliswa ngokusemthethweni kwalo mthetho kuzohambisana nokuqinisekisa ukuthi amacala ashushiswa ngokufanele, ukuthi labo abasindile bavikelekile futhi nokuthi ziningi izindlela ezisebenza kahle ezinganqanda lolu dlame.” Owodwa wemithetho emisha uMongameli uRamaphosa abekhuluma ngawo uMthetho Ochitshiyelwe Wobugebengu kanye Nezindaba Ezihlobene nawo ovikela abantu ababuthakathaka ekubeni yizisulu kabili. Lo Mthetho uvumela izinkantolo ukuba ziqoke abalamuli abazosetshenziswa lapho ingane encane, umuntu okhubazekile noma umuntu omdala ehlolwa lapho kuqhubeka icala. UMongameli ubephinde ebhekise eMthethweni Ochitshiyelwe Womthetho Wobugebengu (Amacala Ocansi kanye Nezindaba Ezihlobene nawo) ovimbela ukunukubezwa ngokocansi kanye nokuheha ngokocansi abantu abakhubazekile ngokomqondo.

Uhlelo lwe-YES luthulwe nguMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngenhloso yokusiza intsha ukuthi ithole imisebenzi. Lolu hlelo luhlinzeka ngamakhono asemqoka emicikilishweni edingekayo ukuze intsha ikwazi ukuzilungiselela kahle emhlabeni womsebenzi. Inhloso enkulu wukwakha umnotho othuthukisayo futhi olungisa impilo yabantu. Ngenxa yalokhu, intsha iyaluisekela lolu hlelo njengesixazululo sokulwa nokungasebenzi.

"Ungafinyelela lapho ofu na ukuya khona noma ku nini. Kumele wenze konke okusemandleni ukushintsha izimo zakho futhi uthuthu kise izimo ophila ngaphansi kwazo," kusho uMukhodiwa. Uhlelo Lwabantu Abasha Abathweswe Iziqu i-MISA lunabathweswe iziqu abangama-70, okubandaka nya abahleli bomumo wama dolobha nezifunda abanga ma-31, onjiniyela obuqodene nogesi abangama-24, onjiniyela abaqondene nezokudwe ba, ukwakha nokulungisa okwakhiwe abayi-12 kanye nabaphathi bamaphrojekthi nezinkontileka abathathu. Bonke basingethwe omasipala kuzo zonke izifundazwe eziyisishiyagalolunye nje ngengxenye yohlelo.

Iphupho lakhe lokwakhela umphakathi isikole laqala ngowe-1988, futhi ngonyaka owalandela lapho, waqala wabela umphakathi ngalo mbono wakhe. “Umphakathi wakithi wawugcwele izingane eziningi ezineminyaka okufanele ukuthi seziya esikoleni ezingenayo indawo lapho zingayofunda khona. Umbono wami wemukelwa yilungu lomphakathi uNkululeko Ralo, owani kela ngegalaji lakhe ukuthi lisetshenziswe njengegumbi lokufundela,” kusho u-Gilman. Wengeze wathi uRalo waqhubeka nokuhlela ikhonteyina yakwa-Telkom futhi yasetshenziswa njengegumbi lokufundela lokwengeza.

Ukubhalisela ukuvota kuzoba ngoNdasa wezi-2018. Isikhulu Sokhetho Esiyinhloko, uSy Mamabolo, uthe izikhungo zokuvota eziyizi-22 612 zizovuleka kulezi zinsuku. Lezi zikhungo zizovula ngempe-lasonto yangomhla ziyi-10 kanye namhla ziyi-11 kuNdasa wezi-2018, kusukela ngele-8 ekuseni.

Umphakathi wezenkolo ubambe iqhaza elikhulu ekulweni nobuhubo lwe-COVID-19 oluthathe izimpilo zabantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezi2.5 emhlabeni jikelele. Lezi zinhlangano zinikeze ukusekelwa ngokomoya kanye nezeluleko kubantu ababephakathi kwalesi simo esinzima. Futhi zisize kakhulu ekusabalaliseni ulwazi olubalulekile nokunikeza usizo kubantu abaswele. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ukubambisana kwenkolo nomphakathi kubaluleke kakhulu ekunqobeni izinkinga zezempilo.

Ukwakha umphakathi ongenakho ukuQhwagwa koMbuso kusho ukuthi sisebenza ngokubambisana ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zikahulumeni zisetshenziselwa ukusiza abantu, hhayi ukucebiswa ngabambalwa. Imisebenzi efana neyokhomishana kaJaji Raymond Zondo isizisa ekulondolozeni ubulungiswa ngokuveza iqiniso nokubonisa ukuthi akekho omkhulu kunomthetho. Kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sibe nokuthembeka nokuziphendulela ukuze sivikele izikhundla zikahulumeni ekugwinyweni nasekukhohlisweni. Ngale ndlela, singakha isizwe esiqinile lapho inkohliso nenkalukalo zingasakwazi ukubhidliza intuthuko yethu.

Ukubhalisa umshado wesintu kubaluleke kakhulu ekunikezeni imindeni uvikeleko lwezomthetho oluqinile. Lokhu kusiza ekugcineni amalungelo abashadi, ikakhulukazi abafazi nezingane, lapho kuvela imibango mayelana nobufakazi noma ifa. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izinhlangano zomshado wesintu zibhaliswe ukuze kugwemeke imibango yasenkantolo nokungaphazamiseka kwemindeni.

I-Driving Ambitions inhlangano ezinika amandla abantu abakhubazekile ngokubafundisa ukushayela izimoto. Lolu hlelo luwasiza ukuba babe nokuzimela, ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba kalula ngaphandle kokuthembele kwabanye. Njengoba kwenzeka ohlelweni lwe-QASA, lezi zinhlelo zidala amathuba okuthuthukisa impilo yabantu abakhubazekile. Ukufunda ukushayela kuvula iminyango eminingi emisebenzini nasekwakheni ikusasa elingcono.

Lesi yisihlalo seNdlovuka zi sokuqala nokuwukuphela kwaso ezweni nasezwenika zi lonkana,” kusho uMonga meli Ramaphosa. UMongameli Ramaphosa uphinde waqinisekisa uku zibophezela kukahulumeni ekubuyiselweni kwesithu nzi nenhlonipho kubaholi bendabuko. Isihlalo seNdlovukazi ya Balobedu saqala ukwaziwa ngokusemthethweni ngoNda sa wezi-2016 emva kokuba iKhomishani Yezicelo Nezi ngxabano Zobuholi Benda buko (i-CTLDC) iqhube ucwaningo odabeni lwaBa lobedu, njengokwezicelo ezalethwa phambi kwe-CT LDC. “Uhulumeni uzibophezele ekuphumeleliseni imibande la yeSahluko 12 soMthetho sisekelo, ikakhulukazi ukubuyiselwa kwesithu nzi sobuholi bendabu ko bonkana entandweni yeningi labantu ehambisana noMthethosisekelo,” kusho uMongameli Ramaphosa.

Umbiko, ohlanganisa nekota yokugcina yowezi-2017, ukhombisa inqubekela phambili ngokuphathelene nenani la-baboshiwe, uphenyo kanye nabazingela bese beshushu mbisa izimpondo zobhejane asebegwetshiwe kanye nokwe-hla kancane kwesibalo sobhe-jane abazingelwa kuzwelonke ngowezi-2017 (1028), uma kuqhathaniswa nowezi-2016 (1054). Ngowezi-2017 kwaba khona ukwemukwa kwezimpondo zobhejane okuyisishiyagalo mbili Esikhumulweni Sezindiza i-OR Tambo International futhi kwaboshwa abangama-502 abasolwa ngokuzingela obhe jane nabayi-16 abasolwa ngo kushushumbisa izimpondo zobhejane, nokwaholela eku-theni isibalo sibe ngama-518, sehla sisuka kuma-680 ngowe-zi-2016. “Kuyadumaza ukuthi, abasebenzi bethu abangama-21 baboshelwa ukuzibandaka nya nokuzingelwa kobhejane ngowezi-2017,” kusho uNgqongqoshe uMolewa. Ukunqanda ukuzingelwa kobhejaneUhulumeni kanye nabambi sene nabo sebesebenzise izi ndlela ezahlukene nokunqanda ukuzingelwa kobhejane, ezi hlanganisa izinhlelo zokuqapha eziqiwini zikazwelonke kanye nokusebenzisa ubuchwe pheshe obuguqula isimo.

Abavakashi baphesheya kwezilwandle bamangaliswe kakhulu yizibiliboco zakuleli ezibashiyile bengavali umlomo. Leli su liyingxenye yokuGubha iNyanga Yezokuvaka, lapho kuphakanyiswa khona ubuhle bamagugu nezithebe zendawo. Umasipala uqoke amathimba ayisithupha aselokishini laseThemba Lethu nasePacaltsdorp ukuze bamukele laba bavakashi ngobunono. Lolu hlelo luhlose ukukhangisa ezokuvaka nokukhombisa ukulungela kwemiphakathi yasemakhaya ukwamukela izivakashi.

Kungeniswe imithetho emisha eqinisa ukulwisana nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane (GBV) ngenxa yokwenyuka kwamacala odlwengulo nezinye izenzo zobugebengu ezocansi. Le nyathelo lithathwe njengoba abesifazane basaqhubeka nokuhlalela ovalweni, okudala ukuthi abaningi balahle ithemba emthethweni. Le mithetho ihlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abenzi bobubi bayajeziswa ukuze kubuyiswe ithemba nokuphepha emphakathini.

Izibalo zitshengisa ngokuso bala ukuthi uma singasukumi manje sishintshe izinto, kuzo ba khona izikhathi ezinzima kakhulu ezizayo. Ngokusobala, sichitha imali eningi ukudlula le esiyitho layo. Ngenxa yalokho, silokhu siphindaphinda siboleka, nezindleko zaleso sikweletu ziyakhuphuka. Eqinisweni, izindleko zesikweletu zi yizindleko ezikhula ngesivi nini esikhulu.

Namuhla, iNingizimu Afrika ibungaza amandla kanye nombandakanyeko lwabesifazane kwezomnotho. Isimo nabesifazane abakuso namuhla sehluke kakhulu kunaleso esabhekana nomama nogogo bethu ngowe-1956. Sesibuya kude kakhulu ekunikezeni abesifazane amandla nethuba lokuphumelela kwezezomnotho ezweni leNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuveza intuthuko enkulu ekubeni nabesifazane ababamba izikhundla ezibalulekile emphakathini.

Ngokulinganayo, kumele siqede ukungafani emiholweni yabesilisa nabesifazane, bese sila-ndela isimiso somholo olinganayo oqukethwe kuMthetho Wokuqa-shwa Ngokulingana.Abesifazane kumele bavikelwe ekuhlukumezweni nasekuba-ndlululweni endaweni yokusebenza. Kusemahlombe abashayeli bezithuthi, abaphathi bamanyu-vesi, ibhodi elilawula ukuphathwa kwesikole kanye nezinhlangano zezenkolo ukwenza izimo abesifazane namantombazane abazo hamba, bafunde futhi bakhonze kuzo bephephile.Kumele siphokophele pha-mbili ngemizamo yethu yokuqeda ukuthi abesilisa bakhulu kunabesifazane, ukucwasana ngokobulili kanye nokunikeza amandla abesilisa. Yiyo le ndlela yokucabanga edala ukucindezelwa kwabesifazane.Kusezandleni zethu – sonke abesilisa nabesifazane – ukugcizelela ukuthi ubugugu, isikhundla kanye nombono womuntu wesifazane awukho mncane kunalowo wowesilisa. Kusezandleni zethu njengabazali kanye nogogo no-mkhulu ukuphatha nokukhulisa amadodana namadodakazi ethu ngokufana.

Phakathi kukaMasingana kanye noZibandlela wezi-2017, kwazingelwa obhejane abanga-ma-504 e-Kruger National Park (KNP), nokungamaphesenti ehle ngama-24 kunama-662 angowezi-2016. “Ngenxa yendlela yokunqanda ukuzingelwa kobhejane e-KNP sibona yehla imizamo yokuzingelwa kobhejane esiqiwini, kuqoshwe izi-2662 ngowezi-2017 uma kuqhatha-niswa nezi-2883 ngowezi-2016. Lokhu kukhombisa ukwehla kwamaphesenti ngo-7.6,” ku-qinisa uNgqongqoshe. Noma kunjalo, sekwenyuke isibalo sobhejane abazingelwe KwaZulu-Natali, eNyakatho Kapa, eMpumalanga, eFreyi stata kanye nasesiFundazweni saseNyakatho-Ntshonalanga.

Manje sesazi okuningi ngalesi sifo nokuthi singakugwema kanjani ukubhebhetheka kwaso. Naphezu kokuba omunye angakubiza ngokuthi 'ukukhathaliswa ngubhubhane', ukuzimisela kwethu akwehlile neze njengabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi senze lokho okumele sikwenze.Njengoba sithobela kakhulu kunakuqala izinyathelo zokugwema ukusuleleka ngegciwane, sizophinde si-qalise umkhankaso omkhulu wokugoma. Uma abantu abaningi begonywa, sizosindisa izimpilo futhi siqhu-beke nokunciphisa ubungozi bokusuleleka kubantu.Ukuthola imigomo eyanele ngokushesha okukhulu no-kuqinisekisa ukuthi ifikelela kubantu abayidingayo ku-zoba omunye wemisebenzi emikhulu yonyaka. Lokhu kuzoba yinselele enkulu njengoba wonke amazwe emhlabeni aphuthumela ukuthola imigomo enqunyelwe ekhona.

UMnyango Wezempilo unezikhungo zezempilo zomphakathi ezingama-346 ezihlinzeka ngokukhishwa kwesizu okuphephile, ethasisela. Lezi zikhungo zitholakala eMpumalanga Kapa (46), eFreyistata (16), e-Gauteng (25), KwaZulu-Natali (56), e-Limpopo (54), eMpumalanga (27), eNyakatho Kapa (6), eNyakatho Ntshonalanga (26) kanye naseNtshonalanga Kapa (90). Izinkinga ezidalwa ukukhipha isisu ngokungemthe tho IBamba likaMqondisi Wezempilo Yomntwana Nabesifazane eMnyangweni Wezempilo KwaZulu-Natali, uPhalanndwa Muthuphei, uthi abesifazane bangabhekana nezinkinga eziningi uma bekhipha isisu emtholampilo ongekho emthethweni. “Inkinga yokuqala ngqa ifaka ukopha kakhulu, ukudabuka komlomo wesibeletho, ukumoshakala kwezitho zangasese nasesiswini, ukusuleleka ngamagciwane ngaphakathi esiswini kanye nobuthi egazini.

Emasikweni amaningi, kuphethe amadodafuthi abantu besifazane babo nwa njengabasezingeni elifa nayo nezingane futhi kuyinto ethathwa njengeyemukelekile ukubajezisa ngendlela efanayo,” kusho uTshepo. Wonke umuntu unendima okumele ayidlale ngokupha thelene nokuguqula indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo, kusho uTshepo. Ukholelwa ekutheni abantwana kumele bakhuliswe ngapha ndle kokubunjwa ngokobulili. Abantwana kumele bakhuliswe njengezingane, hhayi abafana kanye namantombazane; obaba kumele bazibandakanye ezimpi lweni zezingane.

Abantu baxwayiswe ngokwenyukela kwezingozi zokusha kulesi sikhathi sasebusika. UDokotela u-Gary Dos Passos uchaza ukuthi ukusha kuba mandla kakhulu ngesikhathi sasebusika. Ugcizelela ukuthi abazali nabanakekeli kudingeka ukuthi bacophelisise ukuze baqinisekise ukuphepha kwabo nokwezingane zabo.

Isikhathi sokubhalisela ukuvota sesisondele ekupheleni. UMashinini umathe zonke izikhungo zokuvota eziyizi-22 932 zizovuleka ngempelasonto yokubhalisela, kusukela ngo-08h00 kuya ngo-17h00. Lokhu kwenzelwe ukuvumela ikakhulu abaqala ukubhalisa ukuba bathole ithuba lokuzibhalisa kalula.

Izihlahla zetiye zenza owoyela abadingekayo abelapha izinkinga zesikhumba ezifana nokuqubuka.” UNgaleka wakhuthaza abantu besifazane ukuthi abangene kwezolimo ikakhulukazi njengoba kunemihlomulo eminingi. “Ungakwenza egcekeni lakho bese uyakhula. Umhlaba ugcwele amathuba abantu besifazane.”

Masibambisane ukuqinisekisa ukuthi labo ababeka phambili inzuzo kunempilo yezingane zethu abavunyelwa ukuba basebenze. Futhi masibe yisibonelo esihle ngendlela thina uqobo esiziyamanisa ngayo notshwala. Masingagcini nje kuphela ngokuba ngabagcini nabanakekeli bezethu izingane kodwa masinakekele nezomakhelwane ngokunjalo.

“Kwangimangaza ukuthi imbewu encane ingashintshaikhiqize ophepha abaluhlaza abakhulu. Ukubona ukuthi izitshalo zinakekelwa kanja ni ngomanyolo ukulwisana nezimbungulu kwangenza ngaba nothando lwezolimo kakhudlwana. Kusukela ngale so sikhathi kwangicacela ukuthi ilokhu engifisa ukukwenza,” ngokusho kukaMatlakane. Ngemuva kokuphothula umatekuletsheni uMatlakane wahlala ekhaya nakuba iNyuvesi yaseGoli (i-UJ) yabe imamukele ukuba afundele umthetho.

Ngenkathi lena kuyinqu bekela-phambili ebalu lekile, kodwa usemuni ngi umsebenzi oku safa nele ukuthi wenziwe ukuthi kubekwe ichweba laseThe kwini ezingeni lomhlaba futhi kube yichweba lokuthunye lwa kwempahla ngomkhumbi eNkabeni eseNingizimu Ye zwe. Eminyakeni yanamuhla, ichweba seliqhelile esikhu ndleni salo njengoba kade lisesikhundleni sokuqala laya kwesesithathu e-Afri ka, ngemuva nje kwechweba i-Tangier lase-Morocco kanye ne-Port Said lase-Egypt. Isikhathi sokwenziwa komsebenzi emalolini naso sithuthuke kakhulu. Ngoku fanayo, ukusebenza kahle kwezinsizakusebenza zoku phatha impahla sekutshengise ukuthuthuka ukufinyelela kuma-80% futhi kufanele kuphokophelele okungenani kuma-95% ukuze kufike esilinganisweni somhlaba jike lele.

Kuyinto engephikiswe ukuthi intsha ingumgogodla wendlela-kucabanga kanye nohlaka oluyisisekelo lwezwe lethu. Naphezu kokuthi kukhona ababona abasha njengabantu abangenalo uqotho, iqiniso lithi lolu luhlobo lwentsha luletha imibono emisha nokuqonda okujulile okudingeka ekuthuthukiseni isizwe. Bame njengengonyama egqamile ezoholela ekwakheni umphakathi ozinzile nonenqubekela phambili. Ngakho-ke, ukubaxhasa nokubanika amathuba kuwukwakha igugu elizohlala liyingonyama yezizukulwane ezizayo.

Imboni yamathuba omsebenzi ishintsha njalo ngenxa yezinguquko zomhlaba, okuletha amathuba amasha azimele. Ngaphandle kokufuna imisebenzi ekhona, abantu bangaziphilisa ngokusebenzisa amakhono abo, ukuqala amabhizinisi, noma ukusebenzisa ezobuchwepheshe obusha. Kubalulekile ukuthi singayeki ukufunda, kodwa siqhubeke nokuzithuthukisa ukuze sikwazi ukunqoba lezi zikhathi ezishintshayo.

Bangaphinde futhi belokhu bephindaphinda ukwenza into, nje ngokuchutha izimpahla abazigqokile. “Qhelisa izinto ezinobungozi bese usiza loyo muntu ukuthi aqhele eduze kobungozi. Khuluma ngezwi elipholile futhi umnike isiqiniseko,” kusho u-Dkt Gumede.

Kubikwe ukuthi kukhona abantu aba-119 abatheleleke yilesi sifo kusukela ngomhla ka-5 kuZibandlela. Ngakho-ke, abazali bacelwa ukuba baqaphele kakhulu ukudla abakunika izinsana zabo ukuze kugwemwe ukubhebhetheka kalesi sifo esiyingozi.

IPhiko likaHulumeni Kwezokuxhumana Nokudluliswa Kolwazi (i-GCIS) liyinhlangano eyisisekelo ekuxhumaniseni uhulumeni nabantu bakubo. Insenzo yalo enkulu wukudlulisa imininingwane mayelana nezinhlelo, imigomo, kanye nezinsizakazi zikahulumeni ngendlela ecacile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyakuzwa, i-GCIS isebenzisa izilimi ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa isiNgisi nesiZulu, ekudlulisaneni imilayezo. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni ukwethembeka nokubambisana phakathi kwenhlalo kanye nohulumeni.

Ezolimo ziyinsika yesisekelo sokumbiwa phansi kwe mvelo. Ukuba khona nokuse tshenziswa okusimeme kwendawo yokulima izitshalo nokufuya izilwane sizonqoba ngakho.INingizimu Afrika inomhlaba omningi kakhulu olungele umkhiqizo wezolimo, ama-37.9% omhlaba wethu wonke njengamanje usetshenziselwa ezolimo ukuze kuthengiswe.Njengamanye amazwe, umhlaba wethu ovundile usengcupheni yokuncipha kokuvunda, ukungabi namanzi ngokwanele kanye nokusetshenziswa komhlaba ukwakha kuwona. Siphinde silahlekelwe umhlaba wokulima omkhulu kakhulu ngenxa yezinguquko ekusetshe nzisweni komhlaba.Uma sibheka umlando wethu, ukunweba ukufinyelela emhlabeni wokulima imikhiqizo ezothengiswa nokulimela ukuziphilisa kuyinto eseqhulwini kuzwelonke.Yize uhlelo lokuguqulwa komhlaba lwangasemva kowe-1994 luholele ekubu yisweni komhlaba omningi wabuyiselwa kubantu aba nsundu baseNingizimu Afrika, umphumela oyingozi Womthetho wangowe-1913 Womhlaba Wabomdabu uyaqhubeka nokubonakala ebunikazini bomhlaba wokulima.Lo mthetho waqhubeka na ngaphezu kokuphuca izigidi zabantu umhlaba wokhokho babo.Njengoba ubunikazi bomhlaba busesezandleni zabayidlanzana, nokukhiqizwa kwezolimo okukhulu nemisebenzi ehambisana nokukhiqizwa iphethwe ngabalimi abamhlo phe, imiphumela ye sikhathi sethu esedlule isalokhu inathi namuhla. Ukuqhubeka nokubusa wedwa emikhiqizweni eba lulekile njengomhlaba akusiso nje isithikamezo ekwenzeni ngcono umphakathi oli nganayo; kuzodala inxu shunxushu emphakathini.

Ugcizelele ukuthi inhlosongqangi yohlelo isiyonke ukuthuthukisa isimo sezempilo kanyene - sok ondlek a k wab afun - di ababuya emindenini edla imbuya ngothi eNingizimu Afrika. Lolu hlelo luqondiswe kubafundi abafunda ezikoleni zikahulumeni eziku quintile 1-3, okungamaphesenti angama-60 ezikole ezinezingane eziqhamuka emindenini empofu eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo luphinde lusize ukuqeda ubub ha emi - phakathini ngokudala amathuba omsebenzi. "Ngenkathi kuhlolwa kutholakale ukuthi i-NSNP ihlinzeka abantu abalungiselela abafundi ukudla bengaholelwa, abangaphezu kwezi-50 000 minyaka yonke, ngethuba lokukhokhelwa isibonelelo semali yokugibela okungama-960 amarandi ngenyanga," kusho uMathe.

Sizothumela iqembu lochwephe she kuleso naleso sizinda,” kusho uMongameli.Le liqembu lizobandakanya odokotela bokwelashwa kwezifo, odokotela bezo kwelashwa komndeni, abahle ngikazi, onompilo, ongoti bezokuphathwa kwezimpilo zomphakathi kanye nabophiko lokwelashwa okuphuthu-mayo, elizosekwa ngongoti base-Cuba.“Sizoxhumanisa isizinda segciwane ngasinye nezinsizakalo zokuhlolela leli gciwane, izindawo zokuhlala wedwana, izindawo zokugonqa zalabo asebehaqekile, ukwelashwa, imibhede yasesibhedlela kanye nokuthungatha labo abake bahlangana nalowo ogulayo.“Uma ngabe kunesidingo kungenzeka ukuthi, noma yiyiphi ingxenye yezwe ibuyele esigabeni sokuqapha sesine noma sesihlanu uma ngabe ukubhebhetheka kwegciwane kungathibeki ngisho sekunge nelelwa futhi kunobungozi bokukhungatheka kwezi khungo zethu zezempilo,” kusho yena.Uhlu lwezindawo eziyizizi nda zegciwane luzobuyekezwa njalo emva kwamaviki amabili ngokuzoya ngokubhebhetheka kwegciwane. Ukuvulwa komnothoUkuqaliswa ngokusemthe thweni kwesigaba sokuqapha sesithathu, nesiqale ekuqaleni kukaNhlangulana, kufake phakathi ukubuyiselwa kokusebenza ngokujwayelekile kwemikhakha emini ngi yomnotho, ngokulandela imithetho eqinile yezempilo nokuziqhelelanisa nabantu. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni a baningi babuyelile emsebenzini ngokuhambisana nemibande la ehambisana Nokusebenza Komthetho Wezempilo kanye Nokuphepha Emsebenzini, nangokuholwa nguMnyango Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni kanye Nokuphathwa Kwayo ngokusebenzisana neminye iminyango kahulumeni.
