Ngalesi sikhathi sasebusika, kukhula ubungozi bokuba nemililo ngenxa yokusebenzisa izinto zokufudumala. UDokotela u-Gary Dos Passos uxwayisa ngokuthi ukusha kuba mandla kakhulu ngalezi zinsuku, okwenza kube kubalulekile ukuba kuthathwe izinyathelo zokuphepha. Kubizwa abazali nabanakekeli ukuba bacophelisise kakhulu ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabo nokwezingane zabo emakhaya. Masibambisane sonke ekugwemeni ukusha kuleli busika ukuze kuvikelwe izimpilo zethu.

Isikhathi seCOVID-19 sabathinta kakhulu abanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane nabathengisa emgwaqeni eNingizimu Afrika ngenxa yokuvalwa kwezwe. Lokhu kwabangela ukuthi abaningi balahlekelwe yizindlela zabo zokuziphilisa, okwenza ukuthi kube nesidingo esikhulu sokusizwa. Kwakudingeka usizo lwezimali kanye nezinye izindlela zokwesekwa ukuze laba bathengisi bakwazi ukumelana nalesi sikhathi esinzima. Lolu hlelo lwasiza ekugcineni amabhizinisi amancane evulekile nasekuvuseleleni imnotho wasendaweni.

Abafundi baseNingizimu Afrika babe nesikhathi esinzima kakhulu ngenxa yezinselele eziziswa yisifo se-COVID-19 kanye nemikhawulo yokuvalwa kwezwe. Kubalulekile ukuthi sisekele laba bafundi ngokubanika uxhaso lwezingqondo kanye nezinsiza zezokufunda ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nalo lolu shintsho olungapheliyo endimeni zemfundo. Ngakho-ke, kubizwa ukuba abazali, othisha, nohulumeni babambisane ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho mfundi oshiywa emuva kulolu hambo olunzima.

“Ukusebenzisa imali nge ndlela engafanele kufana nesikweleti esiyiphela e ndlebeni. Kuhle ukugwema ukuchitha imali ngendlela engafanele kulawa maholide kaKhisimusi ngoba kungaba nomthelela omkhulu emalini yakho kanye nakuhlelo lwakho esikhathini esizayo,” ngokusho komphathi wezokukhangisa nokudayisa e-DebtSafe u-Matthys Po tgieter. “Ubumnandi bokuthenga ngenyanga kaLwezi noZi -bandlela bobesikhashana futhi abathengi bazokuzwa ubunzima bokusaphaza ima li ekupheleni koMasingana 2019. Ungayisebenzisi imali ongenayo,” kwengeza u-Po tgieter.

Izinsana zisengcupheni enkulu yokutheleleka isifo se-Listeriosis. UMnyango wezeMpilo usekuqapha ukubheduka kwalesi sifo ngemuva kokuba kubikwe abantu aba-119 abathelelekayo. Lezi zimo zibonakale kusukela ngomhla ka-5 kuZibandlela. Kubalulekile ukuba abazali babe qaphile ukuze bavikele izinsana zabo kulesi sifo.

Indlela entsha yokulwa nenkohlakalo ezikhungweni zikahulumeni isiqala ukuthela izithelo ezibonakalayo. Lokhu kulandela isithembiso esenziwa enkulumweni yokuqala yesimo sezwe ngoMfumfu ka-2018. Inhloso kwakuwukwenza uguquko olubanzi ekulweni nenkohlakalo kanye nokulwa nokukhwabanisa nenkohliso emkhakheni ozimele.

Ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezimvula, izinga lamanzi emadamini lihlele kakhulu, okwenza kube nesidingo sokuthi sonke sisebenze ngokubambisana. Siyakhuthazwa ukuba sinciphise ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi ngokungachitha nangokulungisa yonke imigqa evuzayo. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, singakwazi ukunweba isikhathi futhi silwisane nosuku lokuntuleka kwamanzi emiphakathini yethu.

hulumeni eNingizimu Afrika yonkana abakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo wesikole ngenxa yohlelo lukahulumeni oluqinisekisa ukuthi izisu zabo zigcwele ukudla okunempilo. UMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo (i-DBE), ngokusebenzisa uHlelo Lokuhlinzeka Ngokudla Okunempilo Ezikoleni (i-NSNP), usebenze waze weqa umgomo wawo wokuhlinzeka ngokudla kubafundi bakuleli abangama-75%. Umqondisi we-NSNP kulo mnyango, uNeo Rakwena, uthe izikole eziyizi-20 619 zipheka futhi ziphakele abafundi abalinganiselwa kuzi-9 032 622 ezweni nsuku zonke. Uthe izikole ezingabandakanywanga ohlelweni kumele ziqonde emahhovisi esifunda uma zifuna ukuba yingxenye yohlelo.

Umnyango wezempilo ukhuthaza omama abane-HIV abancelisayo ukuba bathole imeluleko efanele mayelana nokudla kwengane. Ngokusho kwalo umnyango, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umama oxoxisane nomeluleki wakhe we-HIV ngezindlela ezehlukene zokupha umntwana ukudla. Lokhu kuzosiza ekutheni kuthathwe izinqumo eziqinisekisa ukuphepha kwengane nokuphila kwayo ngendlela ephephile.

Uhulumeni usebenzisa amasu amasha okusiza imindeni ehola imali encane ngokunciphisa imithwalo yentela. Inhloso yalo nyathelo wukuthi kube nesigaba sempahla yasendlini engakhokhelwa intela yokuthenga (VAT). Lokhu kuzosiza kakhulu imindeni esebenzisa ingxenye enkulu yomholo wayo ukuthenga izinto ezibalulekile zasendlini.

Isisekelo sotshalomali saqala ngokubanjwa kweNgqungquthela Yotshalomali yokuqala ngoMfumfu 2018. Le ngqungquthela ibingengxenye yomkhankaso wokubamba imali ekuhleleka ukuba ifike kwisigidigidi esi-R1.2. Le mali izosetshenziswa kutshalomali olu sha eminyakeni emihla nu. Lolu hlelo luqonde ukwakha isisekelo esiqinile sokuthuthukisa ezomnotho.

Kubuhlungu kakhulu kubanikazi bamabhizinisi ukubona imisebenzi abayikhulisile ishona noma iphukule. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokwesekwa okufanele kubanikazi bamabhizinisi kanye nabasebenzi abo ukuze bakhone ukuphokophela phambili. Lokhu kusesekwa kungaba ngokwezimali, ukwelulekwa, noma ukunikezwa amathuba amasha okukhulisa ibhizinisi. Ngale ndlela, kungenzeka ukuthi amabhizinisi avuselelwe futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bagcina imisebenzi yabo.

“Uhlelo lokufaka isicelo lwalungelula neze. Ukuba qa tha inqubo esemqoka kakhulu kulo msebenzi futhi abantu aba zoqashwa bavocavocwa kanzi -ma. Uma uphumelela lokhu ku fanele uxilongwe ngodokotela kulapho-ke uzoqala uqeqeshelwe ukuba isicishamlilo,” esala ndisa. UMokoena waqala eyisi cishamlilo esisezingeni eliphansi wasebenza wanyuselwa esikhundleni lapho engomunye wabaholi abaqavile, uhola izicishamlilo eziyi-18.

Umphakathi waseDouble Drift waseGrahamstown ugubha ngenjabulo isivumelwano sokubuyiselwa umhlaba esibiza izigidi zamarandi ezingama-21. Lolu hlelo luthinta abantu abayi-1 500 abaqhamuka emindenini engama-264 ehlanganise amandla kulo mcimbi. Le mizi isuswa emhlabeni wayo ngonyaka we-1991 uhulumeni waseCiskei ngenhloso yokwakha isiqingi sokupumula.

NgokweNhlangano Elawula Izimoto Emgwaqeni (i-RTMC), amakhadi amaningi elayisensi yokushayela asengakalandwa, lapho amaphesenti angama-42% kuphela ayakulandwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abashayeli baye ezikhungweni ze-DLTC ukuze balande amakhadi abo asengalindile. Ukuba nelayisensi lakho elisemthethweni kukusiza ugweme izinkinga nokuboshwa lapho uhamba emgwaqeni. Sicela uthathe isinyathelo manje ukuze uhambe ngokuphepha nangokusemthethweni.

UNgqongqoshe uPandor uqinisekisile ukuthi kuyisibophezelo sezwe ukweseka imindeni empofu kanye naleyo esengcupheni kakhulu. Lokhu ukushilo ngesikhathi sesithangami sabezindaba lapho eveza khona inqubo yokwethula imfundo entsha. Le nyisinyathelo ihlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi intsha yakuleli zwe ithola amathuba afanele okufunda nokuthuthuka.

Sekwenziwe lula ukufaka izikhalazo e-GEPF ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu kanye nemindeni yabo baphathwa ngendlela efanele. Ukufeza lokhu, ibhodi lisanda kusungula ihhovisi elizosingatha zonke izikhalazo ukuze kutholakale izisombululo ezisheshayo. Leli hhovisi laziwa ngokuthi yiHhovisi Elilamula Ezezimpesheni Zabasebenzi.

Uku-ba kwethu nezibalo eziphansi zabantu abadlulayo emhlabeni kungenxa yesipiliyoni nokuzinikela kwabasebenzi bethu bezempilo kanjalo nezinyathelo ezathathwa ngokushesha esasisophe ngazo ukulungiselela umkhakha wethu wezempilo uma sekwehla le nhlekelele futhi sizihlomise ngezinsiza esizidingayo.Nakuba abantu bethu abaningi benze imizamo yokuvikela igciwane, bakhona abanye abangazange bazihluphe. Bakhona abanye phakathi kwethu abangazigqizi qakala izimiso ne-mithetho ebekiwe ukuze sizame ukuqeda lesi sifo. Phakathi kwalolu bhubhane olunje, ukugibela nje itekisi ngaphandle kwesimfonyo sobu-so ukuhlangana njengabangani, ukuhamba imicimbi yobumnandi noma ukuvakashela umndeni, kungasabalalisa igciwane kalula kusimuke izimpilo zabantu. Lesi kungaba yisifo esibangwa yigciwane, kodwa sisatshalaliswa yindlela abantu abaziphatha nabaphila ngayo.Ngezenzo zethu – njengabantu ngabodwana, njengemindeni, nemiphakathi – singakwazi futhi kumele siguqule isivinini ohamba ngaso lo mbulalazwe ezweni lethu.

Uma umza li oyedwa eshonile, kepha eshiye abafowabo nodade wabo, umzali osele uzo thola isigamu sengxenye yefa kanti inzalo yomza li oshonile izothola enye ingxenye. • Uma bobabili abazali baka mufi sebashona, kodwa bashiya abantwana, ifa lihlukaniswa libe izingxe nye ezilinganayo. • Uma umufi engashiyanga owakwakhe, abantwana, abazali noma uzalo lwaba zali, isihlobo segazi esise duze sizodla ifa lonke. • Okokugcina, uma umufi engashiyanga ngisho isi -hlobo, uMbuso yiwo oqhu beka udle ifa.

Ngaphezu kwalokhu, uhulumeni kanye nalabo asebenzisana nabo bazobheka izindlela zokuqhubeka nokuseka abantu ngosizo lwezezimali ngendlela ekhonekayo ezweni isikhathi esithe ukweluleka. Ukufinyelela kumhlaba Uhulumeni uyaqhubeka loguquko kwezomhlaba futhi kulindeleke ukugunyazwa Komthethosivivinywa Wokubuyiselwa Komhlaba. Ukusungulwa kwe-Ejensi Yezolimo kanye Noku thuthukiswa Koguquko Kwezomhlaba kuzophinde kuphothulwe kulo nyaka. “UMnyango Wezemise benzi Kahulumeni kanye Nengqalasizinda uzophuthula ukudluliselwa kwamahektha ayizi-14 000 zomhlaba kahulumeni kwi-Ejensi Yokuthuthukiswa Kwezi ndlu,” kusho uMongameli.

Kuyaqhubeka nokukhombisa ukuthi lapha KwaZulu-Natali siyindawo ekahle kwaba tshala izimali. Kuthu mela nomlayezo kulabo abalokhu bengabaza ukuthi i-Durban iyindawo ekahle ngokuphathelene nokutshalwa kwezimali,” kusho Ungqongqoshe Wesifundazwe Wokuthuthu kiswa Kwezomnotho, Ezokuvakasha Nezindaba Zemvelo uSihle Zikalala ngesikhathi sokwethulwa kwemboni. Wathi amathuba okuqala okuqashwa azoqhamuka kule nkampani azoba ne-sandla ekwandiseni isibalo sabantu abanamakhono esifundazweni. Izikhungo zezempilo zikhumbuza umphakathi ukuthi kubalulekile ukugcina imithetho yokusebenzisa isifonyo sobuso ngendlela efanele. Izindlela zokukhipha isisu ngokusemthe thweni UMuthupei uthi abesifazane abafuna ukukhipha isisu banezindlela eziphephile futhi ezimahhala ukwenza lokho emitholampilo nasezibhedlela zikahulumeni.

Ezinye izingxenye kulindeleke ukuthi ziqale ukusebenza, lokho okuzokwehlisa ingcindezi kagesi. Sidinga futhi ukwelula ukuvivinywa kokuqashwa esakwethula ngoMbasa kowezi-2020 ezikhundleni ezingaphezu kwezabaphathi abakhulu. Njengoba saphawula ohla keni lomthetho osadingidwa, “isakhiwo esizigabagaba ku mele siqhubeke nokusebenza ngokuthembeka nangoku khuthala ngalokhu oku gunyazwe ngabavoti kanye neqembu, kodwa bayeke ukuthi balingise osopolitiki ngokwabo.” Siphakamisa indlela enzima kakhulu ekuqashweni nase kukhethweni kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni, ukufundiswa ngomsebenzi omusha kanye nokulawulwa ngokusebenza. Lokhu kubandakanya uku funda okuqhubekayo kanye nendlela ecacile yokuthuthu kiswa ngokomsebenzi kwabo bonke abasebenzi bakahulu meni.UHlaka lomthetho osadi ngidwa lugcizelela isidingo sabasebenzi bakahulumeni ukuthi baziphendulele uma ungenziwe kahle umsebenzi, nokuqeda nya ukungajeziswa kokungaphathi kahle kanye nokuxhashazwa kwezinsiza zombuso.

Zisitshele ngezindaba zemiphumela yokuvalwa kwezwe ezimpilweni zabantu kanye nasemabhizinisini abo. Beziphumile ziye emakhaya, emadolobheni nasemado lobhenikazi, ziletha izindaba zabantu abajwayelekile futhi zidonsa amehlo esizwe ezinkingeni okubhekenwe nazo ezibhedlela nasemitho lampilo, zigqugquzela ukuthi uhulumeni asukume. Abezindaba bakithi basikha nyisele indlela ebesingeke siyibone nje. Bayifezile indi ma yabo emphakathini ngokuvundulula izenzo zenkohlakalo nokunga phathi ngendlela, basusa inkulumo-mpikiswano enku lu kuzwelonke ekuphenywe ni kwamacala asezingeni eliphezulu.

Wengeze ngokuthi selokhu kwavulwa isikhungo, baningi abantu abasebenzisa izinsiza abazihlinzekayo futhi baphathwa ngendlela enesithu nzi abantu abayizisulu futhi bakwazi nokugeza eshaweni emva kokuxilongwa. UColonel Mtsholi Bhembe wagcizelela ukuthi kubalulekile ukuba umphakathi ubike ukunukubezwa namaphoyisa aseMpumalanga. Lolu hlelo luqeda indlala yesikhashana futhi lube negalelo esimweni senhlalakahle yabafundi. Uthe, "Izingane eziningi zibuya emakhaya adla imbuya ngothi, futhi kwabanye abafundi, ukudla kwasesikoleni yikho kuphela ukudla abakudlayo ngosuku.

Ukuqoqwa kwentela yi-SARS kubalulekile ekuvuseleleni nasekuvuleni amathuba okukhula komnotho. Kube nokuthuthuka okubonakalayo ekukhokweni kwentela, lapho kube nokukhula kwama-25% onyakeni odlule. Lokhu kulandela ukunyuka kwama-15% okwenzeka ngaphambi kokuba kuqale ubhubhane lwe-COVID-19. Le mali eqoqiwe isiza uhulumeni ukuthi asekele ukuzinzisa nokuthuthukisa umnotho wezwe.

Ukuqedwa komshado ngokomthetho kwenzeka lapho kusebenza khona ukuthi ayisekho nhlobo indlela efanelekile yokuvuselelwa kobudlelwane phakathi kwabashadile. Le nkqubo ihlinzekela ngokuhlukaniswa kwempahla ehlanganyelwe ngendlela efanele ukuze kube nokulungiseka phakathi kwabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuqinisekisa ukuphoqelela imigomo okuvunyelwene ngayo yombili ohlangothini ukuze kuqedwe yonke imibango ngokomthetho.

UNgaleka, indoda eseminyakeni yobudala, wayenothando olukhulu lokulima imifino egcekeni lakhe. Wayengazi ukuthi lolu thando lungamholela ekutheni azisebenzele ngokuvula ibhizinisi lezolimo eliphumelelayo. Namuhla, imifino yakhe ithengiswa ezitolo zendawo kanye nezinhlelo zokupha abafundi ukudla ezikoleni, okukhombisa ukuthi ukuzikhandla kuyakhokha.

Ezweni eliqhakambisa ilungelo lenkululeko yenkolo, wonke umzamo kumele wenziwe ukweseka abantu bakithi ukusebenzisa leli lungelo. Futhi uma sekusetshenziswa leli lungelo, kudingeka siqi niseke ukuthi asibeki amalungelo noma izimpilo zabanye engcupheni. Lesi yisimiso abaholi be zenkolo engihlangene nabo abaseseka ngokugcwele futhi abasibongayo. Bayasiqonda isibopho sabo bonke abantu abakholwayo – impela sabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika – ukulandela izinya thelo ezibekiwe zokuvikela impilo yabantu nokusindisa izimpilo.

Isimo sabesifazane baseNingizimu Afrika namuhla sehluke kakhulu futhi sesithuthuke kakhulu kunaleso sango-1956. Ukubungazwa kwabo manje kugcizelela kakhulu ukubabandakanya kwezomnotho ukuze baziqhenye ngokuzimela kwabo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abesifazane sebethatha iqhaza elibalulekile ekukhuliseni umnotho wezwe. Ukuhambela phambili kulokhu kusiza ekufinyeleleni ekulinganeni nasekuvikelweni kwamalungelo abo wonke.

UHlelo Loxhaso Lwezemisebenzi LukaMongameli luqhuba ngokuzikhukhumeza ekudaleni amathuba omsebenzi amasha ezweni lonke. Lolu hlelo, olwaqala ngonyaka odlule, luhlose ukudala inqwaba yamathuba emisebenzi esikhathini esifishane ukuze kusizwe abantu abaningi. Impumelelo yalo isekeleke ekusetshenzisweni kwezindlela ezintsha namasu anembane okusebenza. Lokhu kuveza ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekulweni nobubha nokuntuleka kwemisebenzi.

Alikho ikilasi elingcono konjiniyela abasaqeqeshwa kunalezo zinda zokwakha ezimahhadlahhadla. Lapha, izintuli nokuduma kwemishini kuhamba kanye nemijuluko yamadoda nabesifazane abasebenza ngokuzikhandla. Kubonakala ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bangempela bufundwa phakathi kwalolu phutha nokuxaka kwemisebenzi. Yilokhu okwakha onjiniyela abaqinile nabazwisise imisebenzi yabo ngokugcwele.

Intsha yezwe lethu iwuphawu lomdlandla, ithemba, ubumnandi, amathuba empumelelo, ingomuso kanye nenkululeko. Bangabantu abanolwazi olu nzulu ekusetshenzisweni kobu chwepheshe besimanjemanje futhi banentshisekelo yokungena emisebenzini eyabe ingekho ngisho noku ba khona ngezikhathi zabazali babo.Ngosuku olwandulela ukwe thulwa kweNkulumo Echaza Isimo Sezwe (i-SoNA), ngaba nenhlanhla enkulu ukuthi ngithole ithuba lokufakana imilomo neqenjana laba ntu abasha abanomdlandla nentshisekelo emcimbini we nkulumo-mpendulwano phakathi kwezizukulwane ezihlukahlukene zakuleli owabe uhlelwe wuPhiko Lukazwelonke Lokuthuthukiswa Kwentsha. Sabhunga ngezindaba ezibaluleke kakhulu kubantu abasha futhi sacubungula nezindlela esingazisebenzisa ukuhambelanisa indlela esibona ngayo izinto kanye nezenzo nemisebenzi yethu. Ngokusobala, ukufinyelela emathubeni emisebenzi kanye namanye yikona okwaba ngu ndaba-mlonyeni ohlwini lwezihloko okwaxoxiswana ngazo.

Ezikhathini zanamuhla, izimo zomnotho ziba nzima kakhulu, okwenza ukuthi kube kubalulekile ukuhlela izimali zakho ngobuhlakani. Kumele uqale ngokwenza ibhajethi eqondile, uhlukanise phakathi kwezidingo ezibalulekile nezifiso nje. Ukubeka eceleni imali yosizo ezimweni ezingalindelekile kuzokusiza ukuba ungancishi ngenxa yezikweletu. Uma ubheka ngeso lokhozi futhi uhlala unonise imizamo yakho yokonga, uzokwazi ukuthola inkululeko kwezezimali esikhathini esizayo.

Njengoba ngishilo eNkulumweni Echaza Ngesimo Sezwe, lezi ngezinye zezinyathelo esizithathayo njengohulumeni “ukwenza izimo ezizokwenza ukuthi umkhakha ozimele omkhulu nomncane ubonakale, ukhule, ufinyelele kwizimakethe ezintsha, udale imikhiqizo emisha, futhi uqashe abasebenzi abaningi.”Umkhakha ozimele uqashe ingxenye yokuthathu kokune kubasebenzi baseNingizimu Afrika futhi ubhekene notshalomali olungaphezulu kwezingxenye ezimbili kwezintathu kanye nezindleko zocwaningo nentuthuko. Ngokuhambisana nombuso okhonayo futhi othuthukayo, izwe lethu ngakho-ke lidinga umkhakha ozimele ophumelelayo otshala izimali kumakhono okukhiqiza. Njengoba imisebenzi kumkhakha ozimele yanda, izindlela zabantu zokuziphilisa eziningi ziyagcineka futhi ziyesekwa. Izimpahla kanye nemisebenzi yethulwa ngezinga eliphakeme futhi umbuso wentando yeningi labantu uyakwazi ukuqoqa intela eyengeziwe yokuthuthukisa umphakathi.

Ukubhema ugwayi kuyingozi kakhulu ngoba kulimaza amaphaphu nenhliziyo, okungaholela ekutheni impilo yakho ishabalale. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bayeke lolu mlutha ukuze bagwembe izifo ezibulalayo ezingavela ngenxa yalo. Ngakho-ke, funa usizo namuhla ukuze uvikele ikusasa lakho nempilo yakho.

Ngifuna ukuhalalisela bonke abafu-ndi bethu beBanga lesi-12 kanye nemindeni yabo ngesineke kanye nokuzinikela kwabo. Ngohlelo lokubuyiselwa komhlaba i-Pro-Active Land Acquisition Strategy kanye nokudedelwa komhlaba ongaphansi kukahulumeni ukuthi kulinywe kuwona, seseka abalimi abasafufusa ukuthi bakhulise amabhizinisi abo bawenze ukuthi akwazi ukuthengisa ngempumelelo. Ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokugwema izifo ezilwaneni kanye nokuqapha impilo yezilwane ezifweni ezifana nombendeni, siqinisa izindlela zokulawula ukuthuthwa kwezilwane kanye nokukhiqizwa kwemigomo yezilwane. Ukongeza ekukhuliseni umkhiqizo wokudla kuleli lizwe, uhlelo lwethu lwezibonelelo zenhlalo kanye nokungakhokhwa kwentela ekudleni okubalulekile kusiza ukuvikela labo abadla imbuya ngothi emananini enyukayo.

Kulindeleke ukuthi izinga zezifo ze-COVID-19 linyuke kakhulu kulamaviki ezayo. Uhulumeni usebenza kanzima ukulungiselela lolu shintsho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinhlelo zihamba kahle. UPhiko Lohlelo lukaHulumeni Lwezokuxhumana Nokudluliswa Kolwazi (i-GCIS) kanye ne-Digify Africa sebasingathe isithangami ku-inthanethi sabelana ne-Media Monitoring Africa (i-MMA) kanye ne-Film and Publication Board. Lolu hlelo lugxile ekugqugquzeleni nokufundisa abantu indlela yokugcina abantwana bephephile ngenkathi besebenzisa izobuchwepheshe be-inthanethi. Kuhlwaywe kakhulu ngokubaluleka kokuba abazali nabaqondisi babe nolwazi ngezingo ezihambisana nezinkundla zokuxhumana namuhla. Inhloso enkulu wukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantwana bathola ulwazi lwedijithali ngendlela ephephile neyisisekelo.

Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu e-GEPF kanye nemindeni yabo baphathwa ngendlela efanele, ibhodi lisungule iHhovisi Elilamula Ezezimpesheni Zabasebenzi. Leli hhovisi lilele ekulawuleni nokuxazulula izikhalazo zabalungeli ngendlela ehlelekile. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi ukufaka izikhalazo manje kwenzeke kalula futhi kusheshe ukuthola izimpendulo. Ngakho-ke, amalungu nemindeni yawo manje anendawo eqondile yokuthola usizo olufanele.

Ababambiqhaza banikwe ithuba lokuhola ukuze bakwazi ukuziphilisa, bafunda amakhono amasha futhi bathuthukisa abavele sebenawo, nokusebenzisa isipiliyoni sabo ukudlulela komunye umsebenzi noma ukuzidalela amathuba omsebenzi. Isibonelo, ababambiqhaza abaningi abaqashwa wuMnyango Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni Nengqa lasizinda esigabeni sokuqala sezinhlelo ba kwazi ukuthola imisebenzi emkhakheni wezemise benzi ozimele ekupheleni kukaNdasa 2021. Iningi lalabo ababa sohlelweni lokuqala lokuba ngabasizi basezikoleni, nabo, bathola imisebenzi, sebehlome ngesipili yoni, ukuqeqeshwa kanye namareferensi. Emkhakheni wezokuthutha, ukungasebenzi kahle kumachweba nakojantshi bezitimela kukhahlameze kakhulu ikhono lethu lokuthumela impahla kwamanye amazwe. Umsebenzi uyaqhubeka wokusungula ubudlelwano nomkhakha ozimele ukuthi utshale izimali kwingqalasizinda yamachweba futhi kwenziwe ngcono ukulawulwa kwemigudu yeziqukathi emachwebeni aseThekwini naseNgqura. UMthetho Odingidwayo ngeNqubomgomo Yojantshi Bezitimela Kuzwelonke, owagunyazwa yiKhabhinethi ngoNdasa, ucacisa izinhlelo zokuvuselela ingqalasizinda yojantshi bezitimela nokuvumela ukungena kwabangaphandle kulolu hlelo lwezitimela zempahla.

I-PrEP iyithuluzi elibalulekile elingasiza kakhulu ekulweni nophawu lwe-HIV, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasengozini enkulu ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa. Ngaphansi kwemizamo yokulwa nobugebengu obubhekiswe kwabesifazane (i-GBVF), kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane bafundiswe ngale ndlela yokuzivikela ukuze baphile ngokuphepha. Ukuthola leli thuluzi ezikhungweni zezempilo kungaba yisihlangu esiqinile sokugcina impilo yomzimba ngenkathi sibhekene nalezi zinselelo ezibuhlungu emphakathini.

Uhulumeni usethule isigaba sempahla engakhokhelwa intela ukuze usize imindeni ehola imali encane. Lolu hlelo luhlose ukunciphisa umthwalo wezimali kulabo abasebenzisa ingxenye enkulu yomholo wabo ekuthengeni izidingo zasendlini. Uhulumeni wethula uhlelo lwezimpahla engenantela ngo-1991 ukuze asize ama khaya anemalingeniso aphansi. Kumele sinikeze ukunaka okukhulu ekuboneni izimpawu zomdlavuza ezinganeni njengoba lo mkhuhlane uyenyuka emhlabeni jikelele. Kutholakala ukuthi ingane eyodwa kwezingama-408 itholakala inomdlavuza ngaphambi kokuba ifike eminyakeni eyi-15 yobu dala. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba abazali nabagadi baqaphele noma yikuphi ukushintsha okungajwayelekile emzimbeni bezingane. Ukuxilonga lo mhlavuza kusasele isikhathi kuyisihluthulelo sokusindisa izimpilo zabo.

Izimo zomnotho zonyaka wezi-2020 zibukeka zizoba nzima ukwedlula ezowezi-2019. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu babheke ngeso lokhozi futhi bacubungule ngokujula isimo sabo sezimali. Ukuhlela izimali ngobuhlakani kuyindlela eyodwa yokuthola inkululeko kwezezimali ngalesi sikhathi esinzima.

UZondi wengeze ngokuthi abesifa zane banekhono njengamadoda futhi inkampani yakhe isizenzele igama elihle. “Siyakuqonda ukubaluleka kwesikhathi nokuhlangabezana nezinhloso zethu sonke ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi uhamba ngendlela efanele. Sibonga ithuba futhi sethemba ukuthi amaningi asazoza ukuze inkampani yethu izokwazi ukukhula ngokwama zinga ezokwakha,” engeza. Imiklamo ephambili kaHulumeni kuzwelonke U-Matekane uthe iDurban-Free State-Gauteng Logistics kanye noku thuthukiswa kweIndustrial Cor ridor kunesabelomali esilinganiselwa kwizigidigidi ezingama-R26 futhi ingeminye yemiklamo ephambili kahulumeni kazwelonke.

Ukukhipha isisu ngendlela yokuhlinzwa kwenziwa ngumhlengikazi osemthethweni (ukuya emasontweni ayi-12) noma udokotela (kusuka emasontweni ayi-12 kuya kwangama-20). NgokoMthetho Wokuzikhethela Ukukhipha Isisu wangowe-1996 (Umthetho wama-92 wangowe-1996), ukukhipha isisu kungenziwa futhi ukusuka emasontweni ayi-13 kuya kwangama-20 uma udokotela, emva kokuxoxisana nowesifazane okhulelwe, ukholelwa ukuthi: • Ukuqhubeka nokukhulelwa kubeka engozini impilo yowesifazane ngokomzimba noma ngokwengqondo. • Kunobungozi obukhulu bokuthi umbungu ungahaqwa isimo esingajwayelekile ngokomzimba noma ngokwengqondo. • Owesifazane ukhulelwe ngenxa yokudlwengulwa noma yokulalana kwezihlobo.

Kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi wonke umuntu aqinisekise ukuthi unencwadi yefa ebhalwe ngokusemthethweni ukuze kuvikelwe impahla yakhe. Uma umuntu eshona engayibhalanga le ncwadi, izimpahla zakhe zizokwabiwa ngaphansi komthetho obizwa nge-Intestate Succession Act. Lo mthetho uqinisekisa ukuthi ifa liyofika kubantu abanelungelo ngokomthetho lokulithola. Ngakho-ke, kuhle ukuhlela kusasele isikhathi ukuze kugwemeke ukungaboni ngaso linye emndenini.

Sekuqala ukuntwela ezansi eNingizimu Afrika, lapho kumenyezelwe khona iSimo Senhlekelele Kazwelonke nguNdasa. Loluinqumo luhlose ukunqanda ukubhebhetheka kwegci wane kanye nokuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphuthumayo. Lolu sizo luzobe luqondiswe kubakha muzi kanye nemiphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabo ngalesi sikhathi sobusika.

Izikhungo zokuthuthukiswa kwabantwana zibhekwa njengokhiye wokusiza ikusasa lethu, kanti lezi zikhungo zakhiwe yinhlangano i-Impande South Africa. Lolu hlelo lusekelwa yi-Nelson Mandela Foundation ngenhloso yokunika izingane ukunakekelwa okufanele. Kukhona ukuzinikela okumangalisayo okubonakala kubabasebenzi balesi sikhungo abenza konke okusemandleni abo ukwesekela izingane. Lokhu kuzinikela kubaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile selizwe lethu.

Inhloso ngukuseka amakho no okudala, okusungula ka nye nawezikhungo akhona emphakathini ngobubanzi ukusebenzisana nabantu abenza umsebenzi ofanayo omuhle. Lo msebenzi ugamanxa ezinhlakeni ezihlukahlukene, kubandaka nya ukuvikeleka kokudla, ukuqeda udlame olubhekiswe kwabobulili obuthile, ukuthuthukiswa kwemijo ndolo nokunye.Lokhu kuzohambisana nemizamo yomkhakha kahulumeni, okuzovumela ubukhulu nokuthinteka kwenhlalo kanjalo nokwakheka kobudlelwano obusha nababambiqhaza abehlukene emphakathini.Umzamo wokusungula imisebenzi ubandakanya uhlelo olusha lukazwelonke lokuqasha abasizi bothisha nabezikole ezikoleni. Izikole kuyimanje ziyaqasha, zethula amathuba amasha kuyo yonke imiphakathi kulolonke izwe.Ukuqashwa komphakathi akuwona nje umsebenzi ongenakhono. Kugxilwe kakhulu kulabo abaneziqu, abanamathuba obuhlengikazi, abaneziqu zesayensi, abanamakhono omsebenzi wezandla kanye nabanye.Umzamo wokusungula imisebenzi uzophinde uvikele imisebenzi emikha kheni entekenteke eshayeke kanzima ngubhubhane.

• Uma ushiye oshade naye nezingane, oshade naye uzothola isabelo sengane noma izi-R250 000, noma yikuphi okukhulu, bese izingane zabelana nge mali esele. Isibonelo nje, uma ifa lingabiza izigidi ezi-R2 futhi umufi eshiye owakwakhe nezingane ezintathu, inani lesabelo sengane ngayinye lili nganiselwa kuzi-R500 000. Isabelo sengane sibalwa ngokuhlukanisa inani kane. • Uma ungenaye umlingani noma izingane, kodwa bobabili abazali besaphi la, bazodla ifa ngezabelo ezilinganayo.

INingizimu Afrika isenza imizamo enkulu yokulwa nokuntuleka kwemishini yokuphefumula ukuze kusindiswe izimpilo zabantu. Kugxilwe kakhulu emishinini ebizwa nge-CPAP, eyisiza iziguli ezine-COVID-19 ukuthi ziphefumule kalula ngokuzihlinzekela ngomfutho olungiswe kahle womoya. Lo mnyakazo uhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izibhedlela zinezinsiza ezanele zokunakekela iziguli ezibhekene lobu bhadi.

Abaholi bendabuko basesi meni esihle kakhulu ukuqini sekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zesi funda ziphendula izidingo zangempela zemiphakathi futhi zibonisa impilo eyiyona ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Njengoba i-DDM yesekela izinhlelo zendawo ezigxile kwizidingo, amandla kanye namathuba ezindaweni ezithile, abaholi bendabuko sebeqalise indlela yabo yo kubhekana nokuthuthuka komnotho wasekhaya. Sebesungule uHlelo lweInvestRural , olwethulwa e Nyakatho Ntshonalanga nge nyanga edlule. Kuyakhutha za kakhulu ukuthi abaholi bendabuko bahlanganyele ngalolu hlelo futhi bafuna ukusebenzisana neziphathi mandla zasendaweni ukuqi nisekisa ukuthi luyimpu melelo.

Ngokwesimiso soMqulu weNkululeko nomthethosisekelo wethu, iNingizimu Afrika ibelabo bonke abahlala kuyo ngaphandle kokubandlulula. Lokhu kusho ukuthi akulona okulungile ukuhlasela abantu ngenxa yokuthi baphuma ezinye izweni. Kumele sibambisane silwe nobugebengu obusisondelela sonke, hhayi ukulwa nabokufika abafuna ukuphepha. Ukuthula nokuhloniphana yikhona okuzosiza ekwakheni isizwe esiqinile nesibumbene.

imifino egcekeni lakhe wayengazi ukuthi ngelinye ilanga uzoba nebhizinisi lezolimo elithengisela izitolo zendawo kanye nezinhlelo zokupha abafundi ukudla ezikoleni. UNgaleka (oneminyaka yobudala engama-67) ngowaKwaXolo ePort Shepstone, esifundazweni saKwaZulu-Natali. Ulima isipinashi, iklabishi, izaqathi, utamatisi, u-anyanisi, ubhontshisi kanye nobhanana. Ibhizinisi lakhe liphumelele umklomelo wokhiqiza imifino ehamba phambili ngowezi-2016 ngesikhathi semiklomelo ye-Female Entrepreneurs Awards Yomnyango Wezolimo waKwaZulu-Natali.

Yize zonke lezi zimo zingaphezu kwamandla ethu, uhulumeni wenza lokho angakwazi ukukwenza ukuvikela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumanani akhuphukayo amanje nangesikhathi esizayo. Enye yezinto ezinhle njengezwe iBhangengodla lethu eliqinile, elizimele elikwazile ukugcina ukwenyuka kwamanani emile, ngaphansi kwalokho amanye amazwe amaningi abhekene nakho. Kamuva nje simemezele ukuthi intela kaphethiloli izomiswa ezinye izinyanga ezimbili ukuya kuNcwaba, lokho okuzoletha ithuba lokuphefumula kancane kubantu emakhaya. Ukumiswa kwentela kulethe usizo olumqoka kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika selokhu kwaqala ngoMbasa.

Ukukhanyiswa nokucishwa kukagesi kwenzeka lapho amandla kagesi akhiqizwayo engasanele ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zezwe lonke. Njengoba kusho uMphathi weSiteshi saseMatimba, lokhu kushoda kwamandla kunomthelela omubi kakhulu ezimpilweni zabantu nasemnothweni weNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi imisebenzi yansuku zonke yime, kanti futhi kungeza ubungozi ezindaweni eziningi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sisebenzise ugesi ngobunono kanti kuhle ukuthi kufunwe izindlela ezintsha zokukhiqiza amandla.

Kukhona ukukhathazeka okukhulu mayelana nokuxhashazwa kwesibonelelo somntwana, lapho imali ekufanele isetshenziswe ekunakekeleni izingane isetshenziswa ngenye indlela. Uma ekhuluma ne-SASSA, uPaseka Letsatsi ugcizelele ukuthi nakuba isibonelelo sikhokhelwa lowo onakekelayo, inhloso eyinhloko kumele kube wukunakekela umntwana. Okwamanje, isibonelelo singama-R480 ngenyanga umntwana ngamunye. Kubalulekile ukuthi le mali isetshenziswe ngendlela efanele ukuze kuvikelwe amalungelo amantwana futhi kugwenywe ukuxhashazwa.

UMbhishobhi uDesmond Tutu ube yisibonelo esikhulu sokulwela ubulungiswa kanye nentando yeningi esizweni lethu. Ukuze siqhubekise lo mkhuba, kufanele sisebenze ngokubambisana ukuqinisa amandla ezimvo zabantu nokuqiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazwakala. Lokhu kusho ukubambisela izinhloso zokwakha isizwe esinobulungiswa nesinokuzinza. Ngokubambisana kuphela, singaqinisekisa ukuthi intando yeningi ihlala iqinile futhi iqhubeka nokukhokhela intuthuko yethu.

I-Gauteng on the Move iyisizinda se-app esisiza abasebenzisi bezithuthi zomphakathi eGauteng. Le nkqubo ihlinzeka ngemininingwane eqondile nesheshayo ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhlela uhambo lwabo kalula. Inhloso yayo enkulu wukususa ukudideka nokungabaza okuhambisana nokusebenzisa ezithuthi zomphakathi. Ngale ndlela, ukuhamba kube lula futhi kube nohlelo olucacile kubo bonke abasebenzisi.

Sibuye sibe nohlelo-kusebenza oluqopha imiyalezo kulabo abafisa ukushayela ucingo kwinombolo yethu ephuthu mayo ngemuva kwamahora okusebenza,” kusho u-Seloane. Wengeza ngokuthi selokhu kwaqala ukuxegiswa kwezigaba zokuvalwa kwezwe, sekube nokwanda okuqhubekayo ekubikweni kokukhwaba nisa okuhlobene nezibonelelo zenhlalo, ikakhulukazi izibo nelelo Zenhlalo Zokusiza labo Abakhahlamezekile. Ukuqinisa imizamo yoku nqanda inkohlakalo, uMbuso usucije ama-ejensi ezomthetho ngabasebenzi abanekhono, futhi wasungula nesikhungo i-Fusion Centre . Isikhungo siyinhlanganisela yama-ejensi ezomthetho abelana ngolwazi kanye nezinsiza-kusebenza ekulweni nokukhwabanisa nenkohlakalo ekuthengweni kwezimpahla nezinsiza ezi hlobene neCOVID-19 .

Ngonyaka wezi-2014, izinto zabangcono kakhulu ngesikhathi uMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo, ngokusebenzisana ne-ASIDI, ukhipha ithenda yokwakha isikole samabanga aphansi iNkululeko Ralo Primary School. “Ukwakha lesi sikole kwaqala ngonyaka wezi2018 futhi kwaqedwa ukwakhiwa ngonyaka wezi-2021, siyabonga kwiASIDI,” kusho u-Gilman. Sigqugquzela ukufundisa kanye nokufunda IPhini likaNgqongqoshe Wemfundo Eyisisekelo u-Reginah Mhaule uthi umnyango ufuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ingqalasizinda isesimweni esigqugquzela abafundi ukuthi baye esikoleni futhi bafunde, futhi igqugquzela othisha ukuthi bafundise. “Ukwakhiwa kwalesi sikole kuyindlela kahulumeni yokubuyisela isithunzi ezinganeni zasemakhaya ezisafunda isikole nezintulayo kanye nothisha bazo,” engeza.

Ngaphandle kokusondelana kwesonto i-St George’s Cathedral kanye nePhalamende, okuhlanganisa le micimbi emibili ukuthi ngamunye umcimbi usikhumbuza okusihlanganisayo njengabantu baseNingizimu Afrika: intando yeningi labantu yethu. Sikhalela u-Desmond Tutu ngoba ubengubaba ngokomoya wentando yeningi labantu yethu. Siphelelwa yithemba uma sibheka indlela izakhiwo zethu zePhalamende ezice-keleke phansi ngayo ngoba ziyisizinda sentando yeningi labantu. Ziyindawo lapho uMthethosisekelo wethu wentando yeningi labantu omusha wemukelwa khona ngokusemthemthweni eminyakeni engama-25 eyedlule, futhi kulapho kwaphasiswa khona amakhulu emithetho yoguquko.

Ukushisa kuhlala amahora amaningi esihlabathini. • Faka kuqala amanzi abandayo ebhavini, bese ula ndelisa ngashisayo. Hlola amanzi okugeza ngendo lolwane yakho kuqala nja lo nje.Uma ushiswe ngamalangabi, yima kanjalo, iwa phansi bese uyagingqika ukuze kuzocisha amalangabi.“Ukushisa komlilo, amanzi ashisayo noma ukushiswa ugesi kuzoqhubeka kushise izicubu zomzimba noma nga be kudala umlilo ususiwe.” “Nqanda ukusha ngokugcina ingxenye eshile yomzimba ngaphansi kompompi wamanzi abandayo imizuzu engama-20. Ungasebenzisi iqhwa, amanzi aneqhwa, ibho tela noma ngumuphi umkhi qizo osamafutha esilondeni sokusha,” kusho u-Dkt u-Dos Passos.

UMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa uphakamise ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika kungenzeka ibe nolimi olusha olusemthethweni. Lesi simemezelo wenza ngesikhathi sokugcotshwa kweNdlovukazi yesizwe saBalobedu eNkundleni yezemidlalo iMokwakwai, eGa-Modjadji eLimpopo. ULimi olubhekwe kuleli nyathelo uKhelobedu, oluyilimi olubalulekile kulesi sizwe. Lokhu kuhloswe ukugqugquzela ukuhlonishwa kwamasiko nezilimi ezahlukene eziseNingizimu Afrika.

"Ngangingaqondi ukuthi kungani ibala lesikhumba sami lehlukile kunelabanye abantu, ukuthi kungani ngaso sonke isikhathi uma ngiphumela phandle abantu bangibize ngamagama angalungile futhi bangibuke njengomuntu ongafanelwe ukuba kuleyo ndawo."Isihlamba esihambisana nokuba nebala elimhlophe senza uSithibe awubonge kakhulu umndeni wakhe, ubonga bona ngokuba ngumuntu wesifazane onamandla nozethembayo. Ngesikhathi usihlalo wekhomishana, Iphini LeNhloko yamaJaji u-Raymond Zondo uthe kungaba nesidingo sabanye ofakazi abambalwa ukuze befakaze, umsebenzi wekhomishana awusasalelwe nsuku zingaki manje ukuthi uphothulwe. Ngaphambi kokuthi iJaji uZondo lethule lokho elikutholile kanye nezincomo kuMongameli, sonke singa vuma ukuthi umsebenzi wekhomishana ube wusizo olukhulu kakhulu. Empe leni lokhu kuphathelene nokufunda ukuhlangani sa zonke izinto ndawonye ukuze zisebenze,” kulandisa u-Maharaj.UDladla wazibandaka nya kulo msebenzi cishe ezi nyangeni eziyi-10 ngemuva kokuba yingxenye yohlelo lakwa-SANRAL lokuqeqe sha. Mayelana nomsebenzi opha thelene nokumba nokulungi sa isizinda okuzokwakhiwa kusona, siphinde sihlole ama tshe nomhlabathi wokuvala imigodi kanye nomhlabathi ongaphansi kwendawo okwa khiwa kuyona.

Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi utshwala bungalimaza kakhulu impilo yomntwana wakho ongakazalwa. Uma ubusindwa ukuzithiba kuleli nkinga, ungalokothi ube nengcindezi eyedwa, ngoba kukhona abantu abakulungele ukukusiza. Sicela uvakashele imitho lampilo eseduze nawe ukuze uthole usizo nokuphathwa kahle okudingekayo. Lokhu kuzosiza ukuvikela ikusasa lomntwana wakho nelakho.

I-Kevali Chemicals iyinkampani yokuqala yabantu abamnyama eFreyistata ekhiqiza amakhemikhali ahlukahlukene. Le nkampani ikhiqiza imikhiqizo okulanza ama-nzi, izinto zokuhlanza izindlu, kanye neglu yokunamathisela. Ngokwenza lokhu, idala amathuba emisebenzi amaningi kubantu baseFreyistata. Lokhu kusiza ekuthuthukiseni umnotho nokukhuthaza ukuzimela kwabo abamnyama emkhakheni wezemboni.

Ukuhlukumeza kwenzeka ngezindlela ezahlukene, kanti kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi abantu besifazane bazi lezi zindlela zokuhlukunyezwa. Lokhu kusiza ekutheni abantu bakwazi ukubona lapho behlukunyezwa khona futhi bafune usizo olufanele ngokomthetho.

Imithetho emisha isethulwe ukunqanda nokulwa nokwenyuka kokudlwengulwa kanye namacala ezocansi emiphakathini. I-ASIDI isenza inqubekela phambili kakhulu ngokwakha ingqalasizinda yesikole kuleli lali laseMthatha, eMpumalanga Kapa. Ngemva kweminyaka enzima yokushoda kwezakhiwo, lesi sikole manje sisebenzisa isakhiwo esisekhaya likanNkululeko Ralo ukuze kuthuthukiswe imfundo. Lokhu kwakheka ngokushesha kwalezi zingqalasizinda kuzoletha ushintsho oluhle nokuqinisekisa indawo engcono yokufunda kubafundi.

Kubikwe ukushona komuntu oyedwa eMpumalanga Kapa. Amakhaya angaphezu kwezi-4 000 amoshekile kwathi ayizi-8 300 aba nomonakalo ongemkhulu kakhulu, okushiye abantu abayizi-40 000 bengenamakhaya. UMongameli uthe uPhiko Lwamaphoyisa eNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) kanye noMbutho Kazwelonke Wezokuvikela eNingizimu Afrika (i-SANDF) bebelokhu behamba phambili emizamweni yokuthungatha nokuhlenga abantu. Mhla zingama-24 ku Nhlaba 1921, amasosha ezokuphepha amakholoni ayehlome ngezibhamu nemishini yezikhali avulela ngenhlamvu kumakholwa, kwashona abantu abanga-phezu kwe-160 kwalimala kabi abacishe bafinyelele kwabayi-130.Lesi sibhicongo sokubulawa kwabantu siveze obala isihluku hhayi kuphela esombutho wamaphoyisa weNyunyana yaseNi-ngizimu Afrika, kodwa futhi nenqubo yokucwasa ngokwebala eyabekwa icala lokusivumela.Njengengxabano endaweni i-Sheik Jarrah, isihluku e-Bulhoek sasingeyona nje ingxabano yendawo; kwakungokuphathelene nokuphucwa umhlaba ngenkani, ngokuqonelwa komhlaba, ngokubandlu lulwa ngokobuhlanga nango kucindezelwa kwabantu abangavumelani nezenzo zangaleso sikhathi.Njengoba sibheka inkinga yase-Middle East futhi ikakhulukazi ngokuhlu pheka kwabantu base-Palestine, kungakuhle sikhumbule amazwi ka-Selby Msimang, ilungu elasungula i-African National Congress.Ngemuva kwesibhicongo sase-Bulhoek wabhala wathi: "Umlando ukhombisile ukuthi umphefumulo womuntu uvukela ukungabi nabulungiswa".Imibhikisho kanye nokuvukelana kwabantu base-Ningizimu Afrika ababe cindezelwe belwa nobuqo nela nobandlululo kwa fakazela ubuqiniso balo mbono.Njengabathandi benkululeko nobulungiswa, simi nabantu base-Palestine emzamweni wabo wokuzi busa, kepha futhi ekume laneni kwabo nokuphucwa amalungelo abo kanye nokuphucwa isithunzi sabo.

• Ukuqhubeka nokukhulelwa kuzokhinyabeza izimo zenhlalo noma zomnotho zowesifazane. Ukukhipha isisu kungenzeka futhi emva kwesonto lama-20 uma udokotela, emva kokuxoxisana nombelethisi osemthethweni, ukholelwa ukuthi ukuqhubeka nokukhulelwa kuzobeka engozini impilo yowesifazane, kungaholela ekonakaleni kombungu noma kunobungozi bokulimala kombungu. Ngokusho koMthetho, bonke abesifazane, ngisho ngabe yizingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18 ubudala, banelungelo lokukhipha isisu. Abayidingi imvume yomzali noma yomnakekeli wabo.

I-BRICS ibonakala njengumongo obalulekile wokukhula nentuthuko yezomnotho eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuhambisana nezinguquko zemifelandawonye emhlabeni jikelele ezilethwe ngukuphela kwempi iCold War. Kubonakale ukuthi amazwe kumele "aphinde aphose udobo lawo" ukuze akwazi ukuzuza kabanzi ezindabeni zamazwe ngamazwe. Le nyathelo lihlose ukuqinisa isikhundla seNingizimu Afrika emhlabeni jikelele.

IMithetho-sivivinywa emithathu ebalulekile ehlobene neGBVF yethulwe ePhalamende muva nje. Ngokwethulwa kwale Mithetho-sivivinywa, sigcina isethembiso esasenza kubabhikishi ngonyaka odlule nakubobonke abesifazane bakuleli lizwe. IMithetho-sivivinywa echitshiyelwe emithathu yenzelwe ukuvala igebe elivumela izaphula-mthetho ukubalekela ubulungiswa futhi inika ngokugcwele abesifazane nabantwana bezwe lethu amalungelo. Le Mithetho-sivivinywa, uma isiphasisiwe yaba imithetho, izosiza ukubuyisa ukuzethemba kwabesifazane bezwe lethu njengoba umthetho ukhona ukuze ubavikele.

Ukuxoxisana nabantwana kubaluleke kakhulu ukuze abazali bakwazi ukuqonda imizwa nezinselelo ezibhekene nezingane zabo. Lokhu kwenza ukuba ingane izizwe ithembeke futhi iphephile, okuyikho okuyisisekelo sokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Uma abazali bexoxisana nezingane, kuba lula ukubona izimpawu zodlame noma ukuhlupheka, okusiza ekutheni zingane zivikelwe masinyane. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukudala isikhala sokukhuluma ngokuvuleka ukuze amalungelo ezingane ahlonishwe futhi avikelwe.

Ukwakha isisekelo esiqinile sotshalomali kubalulekile ekukhuliseni umnotho nasekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izimali zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Ngokubamba inkqungquthela yotshalomali yokuqala ngo-2018, saqala uhambo lokunqamulela imali engama-R1.2 billion ekuvuseleleni imikhakha emisha yokutshala imali. Lokhu kuzosiza ekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi nasekuqinisekiseni ukuthi isisekelo sezomnotho siba namandla kakhulu eminyakeni ezayo.

Ngiﬁ sa ukubonga Izinhlangano Ezizimele (NGOs) eziningi, amaqembu ezenkolo kanye nezakhamuzi zakithi ezinikele imali nokuvolontiya ukusiza ngokudla kwabalambile na-baphofu. Ukuqeda indlala akusona isenzo sokupha. Kubalulekile kunoma umuphi umphakathi ophila ngokuhlonipha amalu-ngelo abantu. Sisesikhathini empini yethu nalolu bhubhane lapho uku-thatha izinto kalula kungaba yingozi enkulu.

INingizimu Afrika isondele ekupheleni kwesimo senhlekelele kuzwelonke. Uhulumeni ukwazise ukuthi kuyinhloso yakhe ukuqeda lolu simo ngokushesha, kodwa lokhu kuncike ekwenzeni izinyathelo ezithile ngaphansi koMthetho Wezempilo Kuzwelonke. Kumele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izidingo nemithetho yokunqanda lolu bhubhane seziqedile ngaphambi kokuba kuthathwe lolu nyathelo.

Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu e-GEPF kanye nemindeni yabo ba phatheka ngendlela efanele, ibhodi lisanda kusungula ihhovisi elizosingatha izi khalazo. Ihhovisi Elilamula Ezezimpesheni Zabasebenzi bakaHulumeni (i-GEPO) iyi hhovisi langaphakathi kodwa elizimele le-GEPF. I-GEPF ibalwa kanye nezinye izikhwama ezinkulu zempe sheni emhlabeni, inamalungu angaphezulu kwesigidi esi1.2 futhi inabantu abahola impesheni nalabo abahlo mulayo abangaphezulu kwezi-450 000. Lesi sikhwama sasungulwa futhi silawulwa ngokoMthetho Wezimpesheni Zabasebenzi bakaHulumeni.

“Kuzoba bucayi kakhulu, njengoba siqalisa lo msebenzi, ukuthi zonke izinsiza esizitholayo zisetshenzi-selwe lokho okuhlosiwe ngazo futhi zifinyelele kulabo ezibafanele. Angeke siyivumele inkohlakalo, ukungaphathi kahle noma ukukhwabanisa kwanoma iluphi uhlobo," kugcizelela uMongameli. Uzoqale agxile ekusizeni abantu ngokushesha, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu othintekile uphephile futhi izidingonqangi zabo zikhona.

Intsha iyigugu elibalulekile elithwala ikusasa lesizwe sethu. Kukhumbuleka ngobuhlungu ukuthi abasha abaningi balahlekelwa izimpilo zabo ngenxa yombuso onesihluku owawungabi nandaba nezimpilo zabantu abamnyama. Lokhu kusifundisa ukuthi inkululeko yanamuhla ithengwe ngegazi lezi zigugu zethu. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibahloniphe futhi sibaqondise ukuze baqhubeke nokwakha ikusasa elingcono.

Kodwa-ke ukuze siqinisekise impumelelo kulokhu, kuzo fanele kube nesivumelwano phakathi kwamabhizinisi, ezabasebenzi kanye no mphakathi hhayi nje kuphela ezinguqukweni ezidingekayo, kodwa ekuhwebelananeni okudingekayo ukufeza izinjongo zethu. Ngesikhathi umnotho wethu uthatha isikhathi ukuvuka futhi nohlelo lwethu lwezi nguquko luqala ukusebenza, sizoqhubeka nokubheka uchungechunge lwezi ngenelelo ezizohambisana nokuseka ukusungulwa kwe misebenzi. Ngokuhambisana nezinyathelo ezeseka uku khula komkhakha ozimele, sizokwandisa amathuba emi sebenzi emphakathini futhi siqinisekise ukuvikeleka ngokwezenhlalo kulabo aba-buthakathaka kakhulu. Ukukhula kwamathuba emisebenzi, kanjalo nezi nye izimpawu ezibuyisa ithemba zokuvuka komno tho, kufanele zisigqugquzele ukuphokophelela pha mbili nezinguquko futhi siqalise ukusebenza koHlelo Lokwakha Kabusha Noku vuselela Umnotho ukuze sizovula indlela yotshalomali nokukhula komnotho.

Lolu hlelo lunikeza abantu ithuba lesibili lokuthi bakwazi ukuthola isitifiketi sabo somatikuletsheni. Ngaphandle kwaso, amathuba emisebenzi nezemfundo ayihlala avalekile kubantu abaningi. Ngakho-ke, lolu hlelo lunikeza abantu ithemba lokwakha ikusasa elingcono.

I-PrEP iyisikhali esibalulekile sokuvikela ukugubha kwesifo se-HIV emzimbeni. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu kubantu abahlushwa udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nokubulawa kwabesifazane (i-GBVF), njengoba lolu dlame luvame ukuhambisana nokugubha kwesifo. ISikhwama Esibhekele uDlame Olubhekiswe Kwobulili (GBVF) sihlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyaqeda nya lolu dlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nabantwana. Ngakho-ke, ukufinyeleleka kwe-PrEP kuyingxenye ebalulekile yokuvikela impilo yabantu abasedukweni ngesikhathi kuthathwa izinyathelo zokunqanda udlame.

UHlelo Loxhaso Lwezemisebenzi LukaMongameli luqhubeka nokudala amathuba omsebenzi emiphakathini. Lolu hlelo luqale ngonyaka odlule ngenhloso yokudala inqwaba yemisebenzi ngesikhathi esifushane. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kusebenzisa izindlela ezintsha namasu ahlukile okusebenza. Lokhu kusiza kakhulu ekunciphiseni izinga lokungasebenzi ezweni.

Onyakeni owedlule, u-SARS uphothule ucwaningo lwezindlela zokuphila okuholele ekuqoqweni kwezinye izigidi ezingamaR474. Njengoba siphokophelele phambili nemizamo yokuqinisa amandla ombuso nokwakha kabusha izikhungo ebeziqedwe amandla ukuqhwagwa kwamandla ombuso, kuningi okusafanele sikufunde kulokho okuzuzwe ngu-SARS esikhathini esifushane. Uma izikhungo zikahulumeni zilawulwa kahle futhi ngempumelelo, uma zibonisa ukuthembeka nokuba neqiniso ekusebenzeni kwazo, lokhu kufaka isandla ekwenyuseni ukuthembeka kuhulumeni. Ukuzithemba kumabhizinisi nakubatshalizimali nakho kuba ngcono, kugqugquzeleka utshalomali olukhulu kanye nokukhula komnotho.

Ubhejane busengozini enkulu ngenxa yokuzingela ukuze kutholwe izimpondo zawo. Umbiko wekota yokugcina ka-2017 ukhombisa inqubekela phambili ekuboshweni nasekugetshweni kwabazingela, okuyinto eyethisayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sibambisane ukuze sivikele lezi zilwane azinyamalali. Masisebenze ngokuzikhandla ukusindisa obhejane bakithi ukuze zigcinele izizukulwane ezizayo.

Kusekuningi kakhu-lu okumayelana nalolu bhu-bhane lwegciwane okungazi-wa. Kungcono ukuphambukela ohlangothini lokucophelela kunokuthi kusasa silahlekelwe ngokwahlulelwa. Ngesikhathi kusenokwehluka kwemibono kwezinye zezi-nqumo esizithathile – kwesinye isikhathi lokhu kunombono owehlukanisa abantu – uhu-lumeni wenza yonke imizamo ukukwenza ngendlela ezokwe-nza ngcono amalungelo empilo nesithunzi sabobonke abantu bakithi.Ekulaleleni abantu bakithi nokukhathazeka kwabo ngalesi sikhathi kube ngeye yezinto ezehlukile esinazo zokuthi uhu-lumeni ululawule kanjani lolu bhubhane. Siyaqhubeka uku-lalela ukukhathazeka kwabantu bakithi futhi sizimisele ukwenza izinguquko ezizohambisana nokukhathazeka kwabantu ngezingqinamba abahlangabe-zana nazo nesidingo sokuphe-phisa izimpilo.Kulesi sikhathi esinzima, ama-ndla ethu sonke kumele siwa-bhekise ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ezempilo nempilo kuyagcinwa, ukuthi ukuthuthwa kokudla, amanzi, usizo lwezempilo, ukuphepha komphakathi no-kwesekwa komphakathi aku-phazamiseki.

Ama-Enterprise okuhleliwe uhulumeni (Ama-SOE) adlalela indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wezwe. Ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezibalulekile njengezombane namanzi, la mabhizinisi aqhuba ukukhula kwezomkhizana kanye namabhizinisi amancane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-SOE kumele aqinisekise ukuthi kukhona izinguquko ezibambekayo ngokudala amathuba emisebenzi nokulwa nobumpofu emiphakathini. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuba abe nokuphathwa okuphumelelayo nokuziphatha ngokuqotho.

Ukuqedwa komshado ngokomthetho kusho ukuphela kobudlelwane phakathi kwabantu abashadile ngokusemthethweni. Lokhu kwenzeka lapho kutholakala ukuthi ayisekho nhlobo indlela efanelekile engasetshenziswa ngayo ukuze kuvuselelwe ubudlelwane. Le nqubo ihlinzekela ngokwahlukaniswa kwempahla ehlanganyelwe noma ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imigomo abavunyelwane ngayo iyalandelwa.

UPhiko Lohlelo lukaHulumeni Lwezokuxhumana Nokudluliswa Kolwazi (i-GCIS) kanye ne-Digify Africa sebebambe isithangami ku-inthanethi kanye ne-Media Monitoring Africa (i-MMA) kanye ne-Film and Publication Board. Lolu hlelo luhlose ukuqwashisa nokufundisa ngendlela yokugcina abantwana bephephile lapho besebenzisa inthanethi. Lezi zinhlangano zigcizelele ukubaluleka kokuthi abazali baqaphele imisebenzi yabantwana abo ku-inthanethi ukuze bavikeleke ezingozini ezahlukahlukene.

Lapho kudingeka khona, ilawula ukwesekwa kweminyango ngokobuchwepheshe. Umbiko wekota wakamuva ucacisa inqubekelaphambili eyenziwe iOperation Vulindlela kanye neminyango ebhekene nalezi zinguquko. Kuwona wonke uhulumeni, sigxile kwizinguquko eziyisisekelo futhi eziguqukayo; ezakha kabusha indlela umnotho wethu osebenza ngayo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufakwa endalini kobuxhakaxhaka bezokuxhumana ngamagagasi omoya okudingeka kakhulu, obekumiswe iminyaka engaphezu lwelishumi nokuze kwagcina sekuphothuliwe ngoNdasa.

Sifuna ukuqhubeka nezimpilo zethu. Sifuna abangani bethu nabathandiweyo bethu bahlale benempilo futhi be phephile. Njengesizwe, asiqhubeke sisebenze ngokubambisana ukuqinisekisa ukuthi siqhubekela phambili. Ukwehlela esigabeni sesi2 sokuvalwa kwezwe akuyona nje ‘inkululeko kawonkewonke.’ Imithetho yokuqhelelana, ukugqokwa kwezifonyo, imibuthano yomphakathi kanye noku vakashela amanye amazwe isamile.

Bekumele sicabange ukuthi ukuvaleleka emakhaya amavi-ki kuzosho ukuthini kubantu abasebenzayo abangezukukhokhelwa amaholo ajwayele-kile, kubantu abangasebenzi nakulabo abasafuna umsebe-nzi, kulabo abatohozayo, ku-labo abathengisa emgwaqeni, kulabo abaphofu nalabo ababuthaka. IKhabhinethi izoqedela iqoqo lamaqhingasu azosetshenziswa ukubhekana nomthelela woku-valwa kwezwe ezimpilweni zabantu bakithi. Lokhu kwa-ndulelwe imihlangano ehlukahlukene nalabo abathinteka-yo kubandakanya amabhizini-si, abasebenzi, izinhlangano zezenkolo, umphakathi kanye noMkhandlu Oyala uMonga-meli Kwezomnotho. Esisebenzisana nabo empha kathini sebelethe izicelo eziningana zokungenelela ezi ngasiza ebuthakathakeni kwalabo abadla imbuya ngothi, iningi labo abaphila ngokusi-zwa ngumphakathi.

Ngesikhathi imikhakha ye-zomnotho eminingi ikwazile ukusebenza futhi izinyanga eziningana, kuzothatha isikhathi ukuthi umnotho uphinde usimame nokubuyiselwa kwemisebenzi elahlekile. Njengoba unyaka omusha uqala, imindeni eminingi isakhahlamezekile ngenxa yobhubhane ezimpilweni zabo nasendleleni yabo yo-kuphila.Umhlaba usungena onya-keni wesibili wobhubhane lwegciwane le-corona. INingizimu Afrika, njengamanye amazwe amaningi emhlabeni jikelele, unyaka wezi-2021 uzoba nenselele kakhulu. Ihlandla lesibili lokusu-leleka nge-COVID-19 linga-landelwa ngezinye izigaba zokwesuleleka, okuzobeka engcupheni impilo yabantu bakithi kanye nokuvuselelwa komnotho wethu.Noma ngabe lo nyaka uzoba nzima kangakanani, ngiqini-sekile ukuthi sizolunqoba lolu bhubhane sibeke izwe lethu endleleni eya ekulula-meni.Ukuzithemba kwami ku-vela kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

Ngempelasonto eyodwa nje, abantu abayisikho mbisa babulawa, okwaholela emibhikishweni. Lokhu kulahleka kwempilo kuyadabukisa, njengoba kungukubulawa komuntu wase-Afrika ophuma e-Zimbabwe ezandleni zezingqapheli ezizibeke zona. Ubugebengu buyinkinga enkulu kuleli lizwe. Buthinta yonke imiphakathi futhi nabantu kuyezwakala ukuthi sebekhathele ukuphila ngokusaba izigebengu.

Njengomqashi wesikhungo sokuthuthuka kwabantwana, kunemisebenzi yomthetho okumele uyenze ukuze uqinisekise ukuphepha kwezingane. Usuku Lomhlaba Lokunqanda UkuzibulalaUsuku Lomhlaba Loku-nqanda Ukuzibulala lwabekwa ngokuse-mthethweni yiNhlangano Yomhlaba Jikelele Yoku-nqanda Ukuzibulala mhla ziyi-10 kuMandulo 2003. Izinhloso zayo kwakungu kunqanda ukuzibulala kanye nendlela yokuziphatha enga holela ekuzibulaleni, isiza ngokunciphisa umthelela wakho futhi ihlinzeka ngenkundla yezifundiswa, ochwepheshe bezempilo abelapha ngokwengqondo, abasebenzi bezimo ezibucayi, amavolontiya nabasinde ekuzibulaleni. Ngokusho kweThimba laseNingizimu Afrika Lokukhathazeka kanye Nexhala (i-SADAG), zingama-23 izi gameko zokuzibulala kanti futhi zingama-230 izigameko ezinzima zokuzama ukuzi bulala eziqoshwa nsuku zonke eNingizimu Afrika. “Ukuzibulala kusalokhu kuyisihloko esingumhlola ongamukelekile emphakathini wakithi – akekho namunye ofuna ukukhuluma ngakho; akekho owaziyo ukuthi kukhulunywa kanjani ngakho futhi abazali abafuni ukukhuluma ngakho kubantwana babo besabela ukuthi kungahle ‘kutshale umqondo othile wokuzibulala’.

Izakungelele zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi baqaphele kakhulu ukuze bangabi izisulu zokushushumbiswa kwabantu. Kunconywa ukuba ugweme ukuhamba wedwa, ikakhulukazi ebusuku noma emigwaqeni engenabantu. Futhi, kubalulekile ukuthi uhlale uqapile futhi wazi ukuthi kwenzakalani endaweni okuyo ngazo zonke izikha ukuze uqinisekise ukuphepha kwakho.

Abafundi babhekene nezinselele eziningi ngenxa yesifo se-COVID-19 kanye nemikhawulo yokuvalwa kwezwe. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni kube nokuguquka okukhulu endimeni yezokufunda nokufundisa. Kubalulekile ukuba abazali nabagadi babone izimpawu zomdlavuza ezinganeni kusasele isikhathi ukuze kutholakale usizo olusheshayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu abambisane namaphoyisa ukuze kulwe nobugebengu obubhekene nethu. Ngokubika izinto ezibonakala zingekho emthethweni, sisiza ekugcineni ukuphepha kwezindawo esihlala kuzo. Uma sisebenzisana, kuba lula ukubamba abenzi bobugebengu nokuvimbela izenzo eziyingozi. Abavumelanga ukuntuleka kwezinsiza kubaphazamise. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, ngiphosela inselele intsha yezwe lakithi ukusungula nokuqamba izinhlelo ezizo-sisiza ukufezekisa amaphupho ethu okuthuthuka.Ngowe-1961, i-Cuba eguquki-leyo yathumela ibutho la-bafundi abangamavolontiya abasebasha ezintabeni nasezi-godini ukuyokwakha izikole, bafundise ukufunda nokubhala nokuqeqesha othisha abasha. Namanje usathathwa njengo-mkhankaso oyimpumelelo kakhulu kunayo yonke emla-ndweni wesimanje.Abantu bakithi abasha kumele basungule imizamo yo-kuthuthukiswa komphakathi futhi kumele kube yibona abayiholayo.Njengoba benza emzabala-zweni wokulwela ukulinga-na emfundweni ephakeme, umfutho omkhulu wentsha yakithi kumele usetshenziswe ukulwela ukufinyelela oku-linganayo ekunakekelweni ngokwezempilo, ekuguquleni nakubunikazi bomhlaba futhi, okubaluleke kakhulu, ubu-lungiswa ngokobulili.Njengabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ngi-phazamiseke kakhulu ukwe-nyuka kwezinga lokubulawa kwabesifazane abasebancane bebulawa ngamadoda.

Abanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane nabathengisa bemigwaqo bahlangabezana nobunzima obukhulu ngenxa yokugwinywa kwezwe ngesikhathi seCOVID-19. Ukuze baphume kulesi simo, kube khona imizamo yohulumeni kanye nezinhlanganiso zabamabhizinisi yokunikeza izinkcesho nemishwana yezimali. Lokhu kusekwa kube kubaluleke kakhulu ekuvikeleni imisebenzi nasekuqinisekiseni ukuthi lezi zinkampani zingaphinda zime ngezinyawo.

Esikhathini esingangekota yeminyaka elikhulu sisebe nzile ukwakha umphakathi onjalo. Senze inqubekela-pha mbili engephikwe, kodwa si senazo izinqinamba eziningi futhi usemuningi umsebenzi okusamele wenziwe. Njengoba sibungaza ukwa mukelwa koMthethosise kelo wentando yabantu, masikhumbule ukuphumula okungujuqu esakuthola kuhlelokusebenza olwalwe sekelwe ukubandlulula ngo kobuhlanga, ukuxhashazwa, ukuphucwa impahla kanye nokucindezelwa olwalukho na ngaphambili. Masikhumbule futhi ukuthi kukithi ukufeza umbono oqukethwe kuMthethosise kelo wethu.

Abasebenzi abaningi bakahulumeni banamakho no akhethekile adingeka ekuhlinzekweni kwezinsiza ngempumelelo. Ngakho-ke akusikho ukuthi sidinga abasebenzi bakahulumeni abambalwa: esikudingayo ngempela abasebenzi baka hulumeni abafanelekile ngumsebenzi abanamakhono afanelekile, ukuziphatha ngo mthetho kanye nokuzinikela ekusebenzeleni abantu. Amadoda nabesifazane abasebenzela uhulumeni ku mele bacijwe ukuze bezodlala indima yabo ekuthuthukiseni nasekuqiniseni intando ye ningi. Lokhu kuyisiqinisekiso sethu sombuso okhonayo osebenzela izidingo zezakha muzi.

Ukusabalala kwegciwane le-corona, okubangela isifo esaziwa nge-COVID-19, sekudlondlobale ngokushesha okuyisimanga, njengamanje selithathwa njengobhubhane emhlabeni jikelele. Lolu bhubhane alukhethi, lucindezela wonke umuntu ngaphandle kokubheka iminyaka noma isimo somuntu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sibambisane ngokulandela imithetho yezempilo ukuze sikwazi ukulwisana nalesi sifo sibe phumelele.

Uma ngabe ingane eguliswa uku hluleka uku gxilisa umqondo kanye nokugula kokungakwazi ukuzilawula (i-ADHD) noma ukuhluleka uku gxilisa umqondo (i-ADD) ingalashwa, lezo zimo zingaba nomthelela omubi ongathatha isikhathi eside kakhulu esimweni sempilo saleyo ngane. Lokhu sikuzwa ngo-Dkt. Khatija Jhazbhay, okunguye ongumphathi Wophiko Lwezokulashwa Kwesimo Somqondo Sezingane Ezincane Nezikhulile esibhedlela i-Townhill eMgungundlovu (i-Child and Adolescent Psychiatry).Uchaze wathi uma sezizi ndala, lezi zingane zingaba sengcupheni yokuhlaselwa ngezinye izimo ezingapha zamisa umqondo, njengesifo sexhala nokhwantalala, futhi zingasebenzisa izidakamizwa ngendlela engafanele. I-ADHD ne-ADD ingaphazamisa impumelelo kwezemfu ndo futhi nendlela yokuzi phatha kwazo ingabacasula abanye abantu.

Uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika, ngaphansi koMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo, uhlinzeka ngokudla okunempilo ezikoleni. Lolu hlelo lwenzelwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bakwazi ukugxila ezifundweni zabo ngaphandle kokuhambiselwa wukulamba. Ukudla okwanele kunika abafundi amandla nengqondo evulekile ukuze bakwazi ukusebenza kanzima. Ngakho-ke, izisu ezigcwele ziba yisisekelo sokuthola imiphumela engcono kwezemfundo.

Manje sesinomthetho owodwa wesizwe esisodwa. Sisonke, sizikhethele thina ngokwethu uhulumeni onikeza iqiniso lokuthi iyini iriphabhulikhi. Sithe kwiriphabhulikhi yethu yentando yabantu, wonke umuntu uyalingana ngaphambi komthetho futhi unelungelo lokuvikelwa ngokulinganayo kanye no kuzuza kumthetho. INingizimu Afrika iyizwe lapho ukwenza ubulungi swa kubekwe ezinkantolo ezizimele kanye nohlelo lwe zinkantolo olusebenza ngo koMthethosisekelo.

Iphesenti elifanayo like lezwa ngazo kodwa lazi okuncane kakhulu noma alazi lutho ngazo. Noma kunjalo, ucwaningo luphinde lwathola ukuthi abantu abasha balesi sizukulwane bavulelekile uku-thi bafunde ngezigameko zomlando futhi bakholelwe ekubalulekeni kwazo okuqhubekayo.Kumele senze okuthe xaxa njengezwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umyalezo wangowe-1976 udluliswa ngokwe-qiniso. Lokhu kungukuzinikela okuhlanganisile kukahulu-meni, izikole, izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, abazali, imindeni, abaculi, amaciko, kanye nawo wonke umphakathi.

Intsha iyinhliziyo nekusasa lezwe lethu. Amandla abo nemibono emisha bakhuthaza intuthuko nokushintsha kwendlela yokusebenza emphakathini. Kubalulekile ukuba sibaqeqeshe futhi sibafundise ukuze bahole ngokuhlakanipha nokuzinikela. Ngakho-ke, abantu abasha bayingo muso negolide lezwe lethu elidinga ukunakekelwa.

Amaphupho omphakathi wase-Tafelkop asefezekile emva kokuba abalimi abangama-30 bamukela amatayitela obunikazi omhlaba wabo. Lawa matayitela anikezwe abalimi uMongameli uCyril Ramaphosa. Ngesikhathi ngivakashele eThekwini ngoMfumfu kowe zi-2019, maningi amabhizini si alapha ekhaya futhi bani ngi abasebenzisi bechwe ba abaphakamise izikhala zo zabo mayelana nendlela ichweba laseThekwini elise benza ngayo. Izinkampani ezithutha izi mpahla ngomkhumbi, ikakhu lukazi, zikhathazekile kakhu lu ngesiminyaminya samaloli kanye nesikhathi esilindwayo, isikhathi sokungeniswa ko mkhumbi siyabambezeleka kanye nesikhathi sokukhumu la umkhumbi, ukunganakeke lwa kwezinsizakusebenza nokuba phansi komkhiqizo owenziwa echwebeni.Ukuvakasha kwami kwa kamuva ukuyobheka ukuzini kela okwenziwe ukubhekana nalezi zikhalazo ukuthi kuqa lisiwe. Ngempela kukhona inqu bekela-phambili ebonakala yo eseyenzekile eminyakeni eyedlule ukuguqula indle la yokusebenza echwebeni, ngale komthelela weCOV ID-19 . Le mizamo ibisivele itshengi sa imiphumela enentuthuko yokuphathwa kwezinsizaku sebenza, ukwehla kwesimi nyaminya, ukwenza umsebe nzi ngesikhathi esibekiwe kanye nokwenyuka kokuse tshenziswa kwezithuthi zika jantshi esikhundleni salezo ezihamba emgwaqeni.

UNgqongqoshe uPandor uthe kuyisibophezelo sezwe ukweseka imindeni empofu kanye nesengcupheni kakhulu. Wayekhuluma ngesikhathi sesithangami sabezindaba lapho aveza khona inqubo yo kwethula imfundo ephakeme yamahhala eNingizimu Afrika. UNgqongqoshe uPandor ume -mezela ukuthi uhulumeni usetshale izigidi zezigidi zamara ndi eziyi-7. 166 ukuze ukho khele imifundaze yezingane ezivela emindenini empofu kanye nezasemindenini ena bondli abenza imisebenzi eholela amaholo aphansi ezi ngena emanyuvesi kanye naku makolishi e-TVET kulo nyaka.

Ngabe sengibheka futhi ngafaka isicelo sendawo lapho sizogcina sesakhe khona isikole sethu. Sathola amahektha ama hlanu omhlaba ngowe1998,” kusho u-Gilman. Amagumbi okufundela esikhashana amathathu anikelwe kulesi sikole yinhlangano ezimele engenzi nzuzo ebizwa ngokuthi yi-Kats and Spaks, kanti futhi umphakathi wakha izindlu zokufundela ezinhlanu zodaka. Kuyo yonke le minyaka, uGilman waqhubeka nokugqugquzela ukuthi isikole sithuthukiswe futhi ekugcineni, kwatholwa amagumbi okufundela amahlanu evela eHhovisi likaNdunankulu wase Mpumalanga Kapa.

“Ngaphezu kokudala ama thuba emisebenzi kubantu bendawo, sinohlelo lokutshala izimali ngokuphathelene neze nhlalo esisiza ngalo abesifazane baselokishini kanye nase-zindaweni zasemakhaya ukuthi baqale amabhizinisi amancane agxile ekwakheni imikhiqizo yokuhlanza ikhaya kanye nokuhlanza izindlu zangasese,” kusho yena. Uthe osomabhizinisi abasebancane kumele bazi ukuthi akukaze kwaba lula ukuqala ibhizinisi kodwa akumele badikibale ngoba bazothokozela inzuzo yalokho ekuhambeni kwesikhathi. Usekelangqongqoshe Wo mnyango Wezohwebo Nezi mboni uBulelani Magwanishe uthe i-Kevali Chemicals ibe yinkampani yokuqala ewungoti ngokuphathelene nomkhakha wamakhemikhali, ukukhiqizwa kwezemithi kanye namaplastiki eyagunyazwa ukuthi ixhaswe kusukela ekusungulweni kwe-BIS ngowezi-2016. “Le nkampani izohlinzeka ngamathuba emisebenzi adinge ka kakhulu emiphakathini eya-khele i-Harrismith enamazinga aphezulu kakhulu okwentuleka kwemisebenzi,” kusho Usekela ngqongqoshe uMagwanishe.

Kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi wonke umuntu abhale incwadi yefa ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi impahla yakhe izokwabiwa ngendlela ayifisayo. Uma umuntu eshona engayibhalanga le ncwadi, izimpahla zakhe zizokwabiwa ngokomthetho obizwa nge-Intestate Succession Act. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umthetho uzonquma ukuthi ubani ozothola ifa kunokuba kube yizifiso zomuntu oshonile. Ngakho-ke, bhala incwadi yefa ukuze uvikele ikusasa labantu obathandayo.

Uhulumeni kanye nezinhlangano zezempilo zigqugquzela umphakathi ukuba ubambisane ekulweni nengubo ye-COVID-19. Kubalulekile ukulandela imithetho yezempilo, okuhlanganisa nokugqoka imaski kanye nokugeza izandla njalo. Ukuthatha imigapha yokugomela kubonakala kuyindlela ephumelelayo yokunciphisa ukubhebhetheka kwalesi sifo. Ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukuvikela abantu ababuthakathaka futhi sibuyele empilweni ejwayelekile.

I-ASIDI isakhulisa ingqalasizinda yesikole ngokushesha okukhulu, okuveza ukuzibophezela kwayo ekuthuthukiseni imfundo. Lesi sikole, esizinze eMthatha eMpumalanga Kapa, siqale umsebenzi wokwakha isakhiwo segalaji emzini wakwaNkululeko Ralo, oyiLungu lomphakathi okuthiwa usisize kulo msebenzi. Nakuba eminyakeni eyedlule isikole sabhekana nezinselelo zokuhleleka kwemisebenzi, manje intuthuko ibonakala ngokusobala.

INingizimu Afrika isaqhubeka nokuzikhandla ukuze ifeze yonke imibono ebekwe phansi nguMthethosisekelo wayo. Nakuba iriphabhuli ichazwa njengombuso lapho amandla amakhulu ephethwe ngabantu kanye nalabo abakhethiwe, kwakungekho lapho iNingizimu Afrika ibe kulo ngaphambilini. Ngakho-ke, uMthethosisekelo wamanje usebenza njengesisekelo sokwakha isizwe esilungile lapho wonke umuntu ethola amalungelo ayo ngokulinganayo.

Amaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika acele ukuba imiphakathi ibambisane nawo ekulweni nobugebengu ukuze kwengezwe ukuphepha. Kubalulekile ukuthi abazakhelwane babike zonke izinto ezisolayo ngokushesha ukuze kuvinjwe izigameko zobugebengu. Lokhu kubambisana kuzosiza ekutheni kube nokuphepha okukhulu ezindaweni zethu zohlala. Uhulumeni ugcizelela ukuthi ukuphepha kwelizwe kuwumthwalo wabo bonke abaqhamuka kuleli.

Lokhu kusho ukuthi imisebenzi kahulumeni kumelwe yenziwe abantu abaqeqeshekile nabazibophezele ekusebenzeni ngokuzikhandla. Ubuqotho nokusebenza ngobuchule kuqinisekisa ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi zifezeka ngendlela efanele nangokushesha. Uma abasebenzi bahlale bezivuselela ulwazi lwabo, kube lula ukuxazulula izinkinga ezinkulu ezibhekene nezwe. Ngakho-ke, ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi kahulumeni kuyinsika ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu bonke.

Emthethweni wakhe we-SoNA yangowezi ngo-2022, uMongameli uCyril Ramaphosa ugcizelele ukuthuthukiswa kwezinga lempilo kanye nemisebenzi yabantu. Lokhu kuzimisela kusekelwe oHlelo Lokwakhiwa Kabusha kanye Nokuvuselelwa Komnotho ukuze kuthuthukiswe isisekelo sezomnotho sesizwe. Inhloso enkulu wukubhekana nezinkinga zobumpofu ngokunikeza abantu amathuba amaningi okuziphilisa nokwakha isizwe esiqinile.

Kubalulekile ukuba abantu abasululame ekugulweni nge-COVID-19 balandele imigomo yezempilo eqinile ngaphambi kokubuyela emsebenzini. Ngisho noma izimpawu sezihambile, kumele kuhlonishwe isikhathi sokuzihlela ukuze kuvikelwe abanye osebenza nabo. Futhi, labo abahlonzwe ngethuluzi kodwa babe ngaphandle kwezimpawu, kumele baqhubeke nokuzivikela ngokuqapha. Lokhu kuzosiza ekutheni indawo yokusebenza ihlale iphephile futhi kuvikelwe ukusabalala kwalesi sifo.

Noma kunjalo, akakwazanga ukuqhube ka nohlelo lwakhe ngoba indawo yayinqunyelwe ukusetshenziselwa ezolimo. Wabe esenquma uku nweba ibhizinisi lakhe elincane lezolimo. Inqubo yesikhathi eside Ukwentuleka kwengqa lasizinda efana nocingo lokubiya, amathangi amanzi kanye nogesi kwenza ukuthi aqale ukusebenzisa lo mhlaba ngowezi-2016. Oneminyaka engama-49 ubudala wakhumbula indle la ayeyisebenzisa ngakho na injini yobuchwepheshe yokwenza ucwaningo i-Google eyamelekelela ukwenza ucwaningo lwezolimo.

Umukhodiwa, odabuka esigodini saseLuheni eLimpopo, uthole iziqu ze-Urban and Regional Planning eNyuvesi yaseVenda ngo-2016. Ungomunye wabahlomule bohlelwu lwe-MISA olusekela nokuxhasa abahleli bomumo wedolobha. Lolu hlelwu luhlose ukunika abahlomulele amathuba okusebenzisa imfundo yabo ekuthuthukiseni imiphakathi.

Imithetho emisha esanda kwethulwa inhloso yokunqanda ukubhubhaka kwobulili (GBV) kanye nokuvikela abesifazane nabantwana. Le mithetho iqinisekisa ukuthi abenzi bobubi bakhokha izimpendamlando ezimatshatshatsha futhi baphiliswe ngendlela eqinile ngokomthetho. Ngokusebenzisa le mithetho, kukhona ithemba lokuthi ukudlwengulwa kanye nezinduku ezithinta isithunzi somuntu kuzokuncipha. Kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu azi amalungelo akhe ukuze akwazi ukulwa nalesi sihlava ngendlela efanele.

Isikole futhi siqinisekisa ukuthi kunezinsiza zokudla ezanele ezilawulwa ngokufanele, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlale kunokudla ukuqhuba lolu hlelo. “Isibonelo, sinesivande sokudla esisinika izitshalo ukwengeza ekudleni kweNSNP," kuchaza u-Sejake. Abahlomule Imiklomelo Esigabeni Sezikole Ezihamba Phambili, isikole i-Grootdrink Intermediate, esiFundeni i-Mgcawu eNyakatho Kapa, sithathe indawo yesibili; kwathi i-Aaron Gqedu Primary School, ese-Nelson Mandela Bay eMpumalanga Kapa, yaphuma isithathu. Zizothola impahla yasekhishini evela kuMnyango Wemfundo Eyisisekelo.

Kubalulekile ukuba abazali nabaqeqeshi bakhumbule ukuthi kumele bavikele abantwana ezingozini ezikhona emhlabeni we-inthanethi. Kufanele baqhubeke nokubabheka nokubafundisa mayelana nokuphepha ngenkathi besebenzisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana. Ngokusebenzisana, singaqinisekisa ukuthi abantwana bethu bagcina bephephile ekuhlukunyezweni nasekuboneni okuqukethwe okungalungile emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe.

Iflegi laseNingizimu Afrika lihlukile. Ladizayinwa i-State He rald saseNingizimu Afrika, uFred Brownell, futhi laqalwa ukuse tshenziswa ngomhla zingama-27 kuMbasa we-1994. Imibala yeflegi ayinancazelo ethile ngakho-ke akukho ngqikithi jikelele okumele iyamaniswe nemibala yeflegi. U-‘V’ eflegini ukhombisa uku hlangana kwabantu abahlukene baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nokuthatha indlela ephambi kwethu ndawonye ngobunye.

Ngifuna futhi ukugqugquzela ukuthi isilwane sidliwa kusuka ekhanda kuya emsileni, ukuze ngizoqhubela phambili le ndlela yokudla,” kusho uMolefe.I-Emazulwini iphinde yahlabana ngesicoco se-African Restaurant of the Year emcimbini waminyaka yonke wesine we-Luxe Restaurant Awards phambilini kulo nyaka. UHlelo Lokwakha Kabusha Nokuvuselelwa Komnotho I-Emazulwini iqashe abantu abane futhi uMolefe unezinhlelo zokukhulisa ibhizinisi lakhe. Uthi ingcebo yamagugu aseNingizimu Afrika iyona eludobo lwezivakashi.Njengengxenye yoHlelo Lokwakha Kabusha Nokuvuselelwa Komnotho, uhulumeni usekhethe umkhakha wezokuvakasha njengomunye odinga ukungenelela futhi ohamba phambili ekuvuselelweni komnotho. UMnyango Wezokuvakasha, umkhakha ozimele kanye nabanye ababambiqhaza babambisene ukusungula uHlelo Lokuvuselela uMkhakha Wezokuvakasha, oluzosiza ukuqhamuka neqhingasu lokusebenzisana phakathi kukahulumeni kanye nemboni ukuze kuzoqinisekiswa indlela engcono yokuphathwa kwezivakashi.
