Cela umbelethisi ukuthi akunikeze umntwana wakho singakapheli isigamu sehora emuva kokubeletha, ukuze uzobeka umntwana ebeleni.

Kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezizinzile manje njengoba ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19 kukhula ngokushesha ezweni lethu. Kuyisibopho sethu sonke ukulandela imithetho nezikhombiso ezisishayelwe yizazi zezempilo ukuze sivikele imindeni yethu. Izinyathelo ezilula njengokugeza izandla nokugqoka imaski zingasiza kakhulu ekunciphiseni ukutheleleka kwalolu gciwane. Masibambisane sonke ukuqinisekisa ukuthi sivikela impilo nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

Amabhizinisi amancane anconywa ukuba afake izicelo zokuthola usizo ukuze akwazi ukukhula nokuzimela. UNgqongqoshe uNdabeni-Abrahams ugcizelele ukuthi amabhizinisi amancane ayinsika ekukhuliseni umnotho nasekulweni nobubha. Lokhu kushiwo kwiNgqungquthela ye-SheTradesZA lapho kukhulunywa khona ngezindlela zokubhekana nokuntuleka kwemisebenzi.

Uma singaphu-melela ekwenzeni lokho, hleze singakwazi ukuqeda i-AIDS njengenye yezinsongo zesihlava esibi kwezempilo yomphakathi ngonyaka wezi-2030.Ngeshwa, asikafiki laphookwamanje. Kusamele sikhuphule amasokisi ukuze siqi nise-kise ukuthi abantu abasha ba-yakhuthazwa ukuthi banqande ukwesuleleka, kubandakanyaukushintsha indlela yokuzi-phatha, ukufinyelela kuma-khondomu kanye nokuhlala ngokuhlolela leli gciwane. Ku-fanele siqinisekise ukuthi noma ngubani osehaqwe yileli gciwane uyakwazi ukuﬁ nyelela ekwela-shweni kanye nasekunakeke-lweni.Kufanele ukuthi sisebenze ngokuzikhandla ekunqandeni i-HIV phakathi kwabantu abahamba phambili ekwesule-lekeni, okubandakanya aba-dayisa ngomzimba, abesilisa abazibandakanya ocansini na-banye besilisa, kanye nabantu abazijova ngezidakamizwa. Kumele siqede ukucwaswa kanye nobandlululo olubhe-kiswe kulaba bantu.

I-Operation Vulindlela iyinhlelo ehlose ukukhulisa umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ngokuxisa izithiyo ezivimbela intuthuko. Le nhlelo ibhekisela ezinkingeni ezifana nokuntuleka kwamakhono kanye nezindleko eziphezulu zezinsizakalo zenethiwekhi. Ngokulungisa lezi zinkinga, kuhleliwe ukuthi kuvuleke amathuba amasha emisebenzi nokuthuthuka kwezemali. Lokhu kuzosiza ekutheni umnotho wezwe ukhule ngendlela efanele nengqalasizinda eqinile.

Ukwengeza ezibonelelweni zethu ezikhona, ezitholwa ngabantu abangaphezu kwe zigidi eziyi-17 nyanga zonke, sengeze Izibonelelo Zabantu Abadala, Ezabantu Abaphi la Nokukhubazeka kanye nesibonelelo Sabantwa na. Saqalisa iSibonelelo Sokusiza Esiyisipesheli se-COVID-19 , esesitholwe ngabantu abayizigidi eziyi sithupha kuze kube manje. Lokhu kwenzeka emavikini okumenyezelwa kweSimo Senhlekelele Kazwelonke. Umsebenzi ongaka angeke wabukelwa phansi neze.

IPhiko Olukhethekile Kwezokuphenywa Kwamacala (i-SIU) likhiphe umbiko wokugcina olubika ngokusebenzisa budedengu kwezimali ezinikezelwe ngesikhathi se-COVID-19. Lolu phando lubonise ukuthi abantu abathile baphumelele ngenkohlakalo ngokuntshontsha imali eyayibhekiswe ekusizeni abantu abadinga usizo. Manje, ababhebhezeli benkohlakalo kumele babhekane nomthetho ukuze kubekwe obulungiswa futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akukho okwenzeka futhi. Lokhu kubalulekile ekugcineni ukuthi imali yomphakathi isetshenziswe ngendlela efanele.

Lesi sifo sake sabikwa emazweni ase-Afrika anjengaseNigeria, eDemocratic Republic of the Congo, eCentral African Republic kanye naseGhana ekuqaleni kweminyaka yezi-2000. Ukuqubuka kwaso kwakamuva kunezibalo eziphezulu e-Europe njengoba i-UK ihamba phambili ngezigameko ezingama-700, iSpain inezingaphezudlwana kwama-500, kulandele iGermany, iPortugal neFrance. UNgqongqoshe uthe i-National Institute for Communicable Disea ses (i-NICD) iqeqesha abasebenzi bezempilo ngeinthanethi besemsebenzini ukuze bakwazi ukusibona lesi sifo futhi ukuze kwenziwe nokuhlolwa kwaselabhorethri okudi ngekayo. "Lesi sifo sisabalala ngokuthintana ngqo, ngakho angeke usithole ngokuba segunjini elilodwa nomuntu osulelekile," kusho uNgqongqoshe.

Izimpawu zokuqala zeSiluan yilezi: • Thola usizo uma kune zimpawu zokuqala futhi ezibelesele. • Ihlo: Ichashaza elimhlophe ehlweni, ukuqhunsula amehlo, ukungaboni, ukukhukhumala kwamehlo.• Isigaxa: Esiswini nasokhalweni, ekhanda nasentanyeni, ezithweni, emasendeni nasezindlaleni. • Okungachazeki: Imfiva engapheli emavikini ama bili, ukwehla kwesisindo somzimba, ukuphapha-theka kwesikhumba, ukukhathala, ukusheshe ulimale noma wophe masinyane. • Ukuqaqanjelwa: Kwa mathambo, amalunga omzimba, iqolo nokushe-sha ukuphuka.• Izimpawu zezinzwa: Ukushintsha noma ukwehla ekuhambeni, ukuzimela noma ukukhuluma, ukubuyela emuva kokukhula kwengane, ikhanda elibuhlungu elithatha ngaphezu kweviki elihambisana noma elingahambisani nokuhlanza kanye nokukhula kwekhanda.

Izinhlelo ze-Vuk Talks, ezihlelwe wuPhiko Lohlelo LukaHulumeni Lwezokuxhumana Nokudluliswa Kolwazi, zigqugquzelele ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abantu. Lezi zinhlelo zinikeza ukuqeqeshwa kwamahhala okuqondiswe ekusizeni abantu ukuba baqale futhi bakhulise amabhizinisi abo. Futhi, kuhlinzekwa nezinsiza ezibalulekile ezisiza ekwenzeni amabhizinisi abe seqinisweni futhi aphumelele emakethe. Inhloso enkulu yikuba abantu bathole ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze baziqhakambise ngokuzimele.

Ukuqoqwa kwentela kukhule kakhulu, okufaka isandla ekubuyiseni umnotho nasekuvuseleleni ukukhula kwawo. Lokhu kukhonjiswa wukuphakama okungama-25% uma kuqhathaniswa nonyakathi odlule, kanye nokunyuka okungama-15% uma kuqhathaniswa nangesikhathi saphambi kobhubhane lwe-COVID-19. Lokhu kubonisa ukusebenza kahle kwe-SARS ekunikezeni uhulumeni izimali ezidingekayo zokuthuthukisa umnotho.

Isomiso siyisikhathi eside lapho izimvula ziyivela kancane, okudala ukuntuleka okukhulu kwamanzi emiphakathini. NgokukaDkt Mathieu Rouault, ongusolwazi eNyuvesi yaseKapa eMnyangweni Wezifundo Eziphathelene Nolwandle, kubalulekile ukuthi sisebenzise amanzi ngendlela eqanile ukuze sinqande le nkinga. Kudingeka ukuthi imiphakathi ibambisane ekufundeni izindlela ezintsha zokulondoloza amanzi nokuvikela imvelo ukuze kubhekane nalesi simo esinzima.

Uhlelo lokudla ezikoleni luqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi abalali, ikakhulukazi labo abaphuma ezikoleni ezincishwe amathuba. Lolu hlelo luhlose ukuthuthukisa ikhono labantwana lokufunda ngokunciphisa ukungondleki kahle nendlala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, leli nyathelo lenza ngcono ukuya kwabo esikoleni, okuqinisekisa ukuthi abantwana bathola imfundo efanele ngaphandle kokuhlukumezeka wukulamba.

Izibalo ezisanda kumane zibonisa ukuthi umnotho wezwe usiqala ukuvuka ngemuva kwezikhathi ezinzima kakhulu. Lokhu kuza ngemuva kokubhekana nezinkinga zobhubhane, ukuvukela umbuso ngoNtungazwe ngo-2021, kanye nezikhukhula ezilimazile ezithinte iKwaZulu-Natal, iMpumalanga Kapa naseNyakatho Ntshonalanga. Ukubuyiselwa kwemisebenzi kubonisa ukuthi isizwe sinamandla okuzivuselela ngisho noma kunezithiyo eziningi eziqhubekayo.

Inkampani i-BP Southern Africa isithengile umgudu kawoyela owawuse-East London kuwoyena i-Wasaa, inkampani ezimele emkhakheni wamakhemikhali kaphethiloli. I-Wasaa izuze yonke impahla kanye nezabelo zalo mgudu kule nqubo yokuthenganiswa. Lolu hlobo lokushintsha kwabaqashi lukhombisa ukubaluleka kokuthuthukisa umnotho ngokunikeza amandla amasha emakethe. Lokhu kuyingxenye ebalulekile yokukhulisa umnotho wonke.

Ukuhlaselwa kwabantu be sifazane kuyaqhubeka nokuba yinto ejwayelekile, noma ku njalo, futhi-ke uTshepo wayeya ngokukhathazeka ngalokhu. Ngesikhathi eyisitshudeni sasePretoria Technikon, wasiza ukusungula ithimba eliqwashi sa amadoda mayelana nendi ma yawo emphakathini fu thi ngowezi-2004, wabhalisa i-South African Men's Action Group (SAMAG) njengenhla ngano engekho ngaphansi kuka hulumeni. Namhlanje, i-SAMAG isina basebenzi abasebenza ngoku gcwele abayi-10 futhi inamhho visi eGauteng, eFreyistata, eNyakatho Ntshonalanga, eLimpopo kanye naseMpumala nga. Izinikele ekugqugquzeleni izi-nguquko.

Funda imitha yamanzi ngaphambi futhi ngemuva kwesikhathi esingamahora amabili, uma engekho amanzi aseke asetshenziswa. Uma imitha yamanzi ingasafani, kuchaza ukuthi kukhona lapho econsa khona. Izakhamuzi ziyacelwa ukuba zilungise ompompi abaconsayo. Umpompi oconsa ngesilinganiso seconsi elilodwa umzuzwana umosha amanzi alinganiselwa kumalitha ayizi-10 220 ngonyaka.

Njengoba izwe libungaza Inyanga Yentsha, iVuk’uze nzele ibukisisa ukuthi intsha yezwe ihlinzekwa kanjani ngamathuba nguMnyango wezeMfundo ePhakeme Nezokuqeqesha ukuze i phumelele. Njengoba aqokwa ngoNhlo lanja njengoNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo ePhakeme No kuqeqesha, uNaledi Pandor unikezwe umsebenzi wo kuqalisa uhlelo lwemfu ndo yamahhala kwaba mpofu kanye nalabo abazi wa njengezitshudeni ezingo ndingasithebeni. Kulandela izibhelu zika zwelonke ngaphansi kwe siqubulo esithi: #FeesMu stFall , kwamenyezelwa ngoZibandlela ukuthi intsha evela emindenini lapho u mholo wakhona ungapha nsi kwezi-350 000 zamarandi ngonyaka izothola imfundo yamahhala ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme nokuqeqeshwa. Ukuqali swa kokusebenza kwalolu hlelo kuyaqhubeka futhi kuzoqhutshwa esikhathini seminyaka emihlanu.

Ukubhema ugwayi kuyingozi kakhulu futhi kungashabalalisa impilo yomuntu ngokuphelele. Isibonelo sikaKatlego Makhanda sikhombisa ukuthi kunzima kangakanani ukuphuma kulo lolu lulutho olubamba umzimba nengqondo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqaphele imiphumela emibi yogwayi ukuze bavikele impilo yabo. Ukuyeka ukubhema kunikeza ithemba lokuphila impilo engcono futhi enempilo.

Konke kubalulekile kulesi sikhathi, ikakhulukazi ngoba kusondela isikhathi samaho lide, ukuthi kungabi yithina esisonga izandla. Ukuqaphelisisa okukhulu kuyadingeka kithina sonke ukugcina igciwane liphansi. Ukukhuphuka kwegci wane kuye kunoma iliphi izinga angeke nje kuhlehlise esesikuzuzile kwezempilo. Kuzodicilela phansi imizamo esebenzayo yokuvuselela umnotho ebisikhona, futhi kusibuyisele emuva sisuka kwintwasahlobo siye ebu sika.

Usuku lokugcina lwezicelo zoxhaso lwe-NSFAS ususondele. Lolu xhaso luhlinzekwa uMnyango Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqeshwa kubantu abasha asebeqedile izifundo zabo noma abafunda kunoma isiphi isinga ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. Abafundi bakhuthazwa ukuba bafake izicelo zabo ngokushesha ukuze bangashayiwa yisikhathi.

Noma ngabe bahlala kuphi futhi noma ngabe benzani, bonke ngamunye banentshi-sekelo yokushintsha umhlaba.Ngesikhathi befuna ngoku-ngangabazeki ukuthuthukisa izimpilo zabo, bafuna futhi ukuba nomphakathi ongcono kanye nomhlaba ongcono. Bazibona bengamanxusa engu-quko eyisisekelo.Emlandweni abantu abasha bebelokhu behola ukuletha uguquko. Emashumini emi-nyaka embalwa edlulile, abantu abasha sebelwe izimpi eziningi zomzabalazo belwela ukungabikho kobulungiswa, kusuka ngowe-1968 kumbhiki-sho wabafundi e-Paris, kuya kumkhankaso ophikisana nempi eMelika ngowe-1960, kuya kumzabalazo ophikisana nobuqonela emazweni amani-ngi ase-Afrika nase-Asia, kuya ekulweni nobandlululo, kuya kumibhikisho yokulwela inkululeko yama-Arab i-Arab Spring.Kungekudala nje, abantu abasha bebephambili ku-mkhankaso we #BlackLivesMa-tter ozuze ukwesekwa umhlaba jikelele emva kokubulawa kuka-George Floyd eMelika. Emavikini ambalwa adlule, izishoshovu emhlabeni jikelele bezilokhu zifuna kususwe imifanekiso etusa ubulwane nodlame lokuhweba ngezigqila kanye nobuqonela.Embhikishweni waseNyuvesi yase-Oxford muva nje umbhi-kishi wayephethe uqwembe olunamagama athi 'Rhodes must Fall", ukukhala okuhla-ngene kwabafundi ezweni lethu eminyakeni emihlanu eyedlule.Abantu abasha emhlabeni jikelele bathole isisusa esiso-dwa.

Abahlali bayakhunjuzwa ukuthi kusekhona ithuba lokugcina lokubhalisela ukuvota ngempelasonto ezayo. Kukhuthazwa bonke abezakhi okungakabhalisanga ukuba bazisebenzise lezi zikhungo ukuze baqinisekise ilungelo labo lokuvota.

Isitifiketi sikamatikuletsheni sibaluleke kakhudlwana ngoba sivula iminyango eminingi yamathuba empilweni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi labo abangaphumelelanga kuqala bathathe leli thuba lesibili lokuzitholela lolu phawu. Lokhu kuzovula indlela yokuba ukwazi ukungena emanyuvesi noma uthole imisebenzi engcono. Ungayeki ukuzama ngoba imfundo iyisihluthulelo sempumelelo yakho yakusasa.
